raw.description:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.

Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

raw.description:
Why TrueML?

TrueML is a mission-driven financial software company that aims to create better customer experiences for distressed borrowers. Consumers today want personal, digital-first experiences that align with their lifestyles, especially when it comes to managing finances. TrueML’s approach uses machine learning to engage each customer digitally and adjust strategies in real time in response to their interactions.

The TrueML team includes inspired data scientists, financial services industry experts and customer experience fanatics building technology to serve people in a way that recognizes their unique needs and preferences as human beings and endeavoring toward ensuring nobody gets locked out of the financial system.

About This Role:

TrueML is on a mission to humanize the recovery process for distressed borrowers through AI and machine learning. As our Senior Product Manager you will be the person who brings conversational AI to life inside our platform — across voice, chat, and the messaging channels our consumers and clients already use.

What You'll Do:

  • Roadmap & Strategy: Define and own the conversational AI roadmap across voice and chat, balancing consumer impact, client demand, operational readiness, and platform build-vs-adopt decisions.

  • Conversation Design & Omnichannel Integration: Establish behavior standards for AI agents—including authentication, intent recognition, hardship handling, and human handoffs—ensuring a unified consumer experience across voice, chat, SMS, and email.

  • Partnerships & Technical Surface: Manage vendor relationships and specify requirements for telephony and CRM/servicing system integrations.

  • Performance & Compliance: Drive operational metrics (latency, containment, cost per resolution) while partnering with Legal and Compliance to adhere to regulatory frameworks like FDCPA, Reg F, and TCPA.

  • Cross-Functional Operational Readiness: Prepare Operations, Client Success, and Compliance teams with training, runbooks, escalation paths, and key metrics prior to feature launches.

Who You Are:

  • Experience: 5+ years of 0-1 Product Management experience, with a track record of shipping products that moved business metrics. Fintech, collections, lending, or other regulated financial services experience is a strong plus.

  • LLM Experience: You have shipped LLM-based capabilities in production. You can reason about prompting, retrieval, evaluation, guardrails, latency, and failure modes well enough to partner credibly with engineers — and to know when an impressive demo is not yet a product.

  • Conversational AI Fluency (hard requirement): Hands-on experience with voice agents, chat agents, IVR, or contact center technology.

  • Strong Analytical Skills: When you have a question about conversation or outcome data, you answer it yourself.

  • The "Double-Sided" Mindset: Experience with B2B2C products, balancing what the client configures against what the consumer experiences.

  • A Master of Ambiguity: You thrive in "roll-up-your-sleeves" environments where the path isn't always marked, turning conflicting inputs into solid, actionable plans.

What We Offer (Perks & Benefits)

  • Flexible vacation

  • Medical/dental/vision insurance

  • Traditional/Roth retirement savings options

  • Company-paid disability and life insurance

  • Flexible Spending Account & Limited FSA

  • Family-friendly parental leave, volunteer and voting time off

  • On-demand wellness platform access for you and 5 friends and family

  • PerkSpot discount program for 900+ merchants nationwide

Remote Work, Travel Expectations & Physical Requirements:

This role supports a global, cross-functional business and operates primarily in a Remote-First environment. However, flexibility outside of standard business hours and occasional local or international travel may be necessary for global operations support, company meetings, training, offsites, and collaborative projects.

This position primarily involves computer-based work, requiring extended periods at a computer, participation in virtual meetings, and use of standard office technology. We will consider reasonable accommodations to enable individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.

Maintaining a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment is expected. The ability to protect confidential company, employee, customer, and business information while working outside of a company office is also required.

Personally Identifying Information

We collect personal information for employment purposes. We do not sell personal information. Most of the information we have is provided to us by you and/or collected as part of the employment process. For more details on how we use, share, and delete personal information see our Privacy Policy.

Dedication to Diversity & Inclusion

We are an equal opportunity employer. We promote, value, and thrive with a diverse and inclusive team. Different perspectives contribute to better solutions and this makes us stronger every day. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics.

Senior Financial Analyst

OUR MISSION

At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.

ABOUT US

Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.

CORE VALUES

  • One Team. One Redwood
  • Make Your Own Weather
  • Obsess over Customer Success
  • Work the Problem
  • Be Curious
  • Own the Outcome
  • Respect Each Other

YOUR IMPACT

Join our Finance team as a Senior Financial Analyst focused on financial modeling for a growing infrastructure software business. You will build forecasts and scenario analyses that connect recurring revenue, customer trends, cloud delivery costs and investment decisions to Redwood’s financial outlook. Partner with Finance and business leaders to turn complex data into clear recommendations.

This hands-on role spans annual planning, long-range modeling, performance analysis and executive reporting. Your work will help leadership assess growth opportunities, improve SaaS unit economics and make informed decisions as the business scales.

Financial Modeling & Planning:

Build and maintain integrated financial models for revenue, gross margin, operating expenses and cash flow, with clear assumptions and sensitivity analyses.

Model SaaS revenue drivers, including bookings, renewals, expansion, churn and annual recurring revenue (ARR), in partnership with Sales, Revenue Operations and Finance.

Support annual budgets, rolling forecasts and long-range plans; evaluate scenarios for growth, pricing, customer demand and infrastructure investment.

Performance Analysis:

Analyze actual results against forecast and plan across revenue, cost of revenue and operating expenses; identify the drivers of material variances.

Track SaaS metrics such as ARR, net revenue retention, gross margin and customer economics, and explain what changes mean for future performance.

Prepare concise analyses and presentations that help leadership evaluate trade-offs, risks and opportunities.

Collaboration & Communication:

Partner with Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, Product and infrastructure leaders to validate model assumptions and inform business decisions.

Present financial findings clearly to non-financial stakeholders and translate complex analyses into practical recommendations.

Work with the broader Finance team to improve forecasting processes, data quality and consistency in financial reporting.

YOUR EXPERIENCE

3–5 years of experience in financial planning and analysis, ideally in a SaaS or infrastructure software business

Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting or a related field

Experience with Workday or Adaptive Planning is a plus, but not required

Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets; ability to work across Google and Microsoft productivity tools

Strong financial modeling skills, including revenue forecasts, scenario analysis and SaaS metrics; experience modeling cloud costs or gross margin is a plus

If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

THE LEGAL BIT
Redwood is an equal opportunity employer. Redwood prohibits unlawful discrimination based on race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, marital or veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics (or those of a family member), sexual orientation, pregnancy or any other consideration made unlawful by regional or local laws. We also prohibit discrimination based on a perception that anyone has any of those characteristics or is associated with a person who has or is perceived as having any of those characteristics. All such discrimination is unlawful and will have a zero tolerance policy applied to it.

Redwood will comply with all local data protection laws, including GDPR when it comes to the handling and processing of personal data. Should you wish for us to remove your personal data from our recruitment database, please email us directly at

raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
Position Title: Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer
Location: Remote (In the U.S)

Other Considerations: U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Required)

Position is contingent on contract award

POSITION SUMMARY

Sprezzatura is seeking a Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer to support cybersecurity modernization for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) VA.gov Platform.

The Security Automation / Data Engineer will design, develop, and implement automation that improves how security compliance data is collected, assessed, measured, and reported across a large-scale digital platform. This role will help transform repeatable, manual security and compliance activities into sustainable, engineering-driven capabilities that provide greater visibility into security posture and reduce the operational burden associated with maintaining compliance.

Working alongside security, DevSecOps, infrastructure, and product engineering teams, this position will focus on automated evidence collection and controls assessment, security data integration, compliance measurement, vulnerability and remediation reporting, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) capabilities, and security posture dashboards.

The ideal candidate combines cybersecurity knowledge with strong automation and data engineering skills and is comfortable integrating information across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tools, APIs, and compliance systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated processes for collecting security and compliance evidence from authoritative system, infrastructure, configuration, and security data sources
  • Develop automation to support security control assessment and continuous monitoring, including OSCAL-based evidence collection and control-assessment capabilities
  • Build integrations and data pipelines that aggregate and normalize security information from multiple tools, platforms, and APIs
  • Develop security metrics and dashboards that provide near-real-time visibility into control posture, remediation status, vulnerabilities, and other security indicators
  • Automate recurring security and compliance reporting for security teams, engineering teams, program leadership, and government stakeholders
  • Develop capabilities for measuring security-control and security-tooling coverage across applications, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Automate vulnerability and remediation reporting to support prioritization, ownership, aging analysis, and tracking through closure
  • Support implementation and operation of an SBOM capability, including collection and analysis of software dependency and third-party component data
  • Integrate SBOM and software supply-chain information with vulnerability management and security reporting capabilities
  • Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to ensure security controls implemented within CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure generate usable, repeatable compliance evidence
  • Identify manual security and compliance processes that are candidates for automation and implement scalable solutions where feasible
  • Support the development of repeatable processes that enable product and engineering teams to demonstrate continued compliance with defined security standards
  • Ensure automated security evidence, metrics, and reporting are traceable, maintainable, and usable during ongoing compliance activities and independent controls assessments
  • Document automation, integrations, data sources, processes, and technical solutions to support long-term sustainment by the Platform Security team
  • Collaborate with security engineers, cybersecurity/RMF specialists, DevSecOps engineers, software engineers, product teams, and government stakeholders

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate's degree and four (4) years of relevant experience, or Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of relevant experience.
  • Five (5) years of experience as a Cyber Security Engineer may be substituted in lieu of a degree
  • Experience developing automation using Python, JavaScript, or another scripting/programming language
  • Experience integrating data from APIs, cloud platforms, CI/CD systems, security tools, or other technical systems
  • Experience designing or developing automated workflows, data pipelines, dashboards, metrics, or reporting solutions
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including security controls, vulnerability management, continuous monitoring, and compliance
  • Experience working with modern software development and CI/CD practices
  • Ability to analyze security and technical data and translate it into meaningful metrics and actionable information
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across security, engineering, product, and program teams
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the background investigation and access required to support Department of Veterans Affairs systems

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting federal cybersecurity programs or systems operating under the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF)
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security controls
  • Experience with OSCAL or other machine-readable approaches to security compliance and control assessment
  • Experience automating security evidence collection, continuous monitoring, or compliance assessment
  • Experience with AWS security and configuration data, including services such as AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, or similar cloud-native security tooling
  • Experience integrating security capabilities into or extracting security data from GitHub Actions or other CI/CD platforms
  • Experience with SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), secrets detection, container scanning, or other application security tooling
  • Experience implementing or working with Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) standards and tooling
  • Experience with software supply-chain security and dependency or third-party component risk analysis
  • Experience developing security posture, vulnerability management, or compliance dashboards
  • Familiarity with federal ATO processes, POA&Ms, control implementation evidence, and independent controls assessments
  • Experience working within large-scale cloud platforms or environments supporting multiple independent product and engineering teams

ABOUT THE WORK

The VA.gov Platform supports a large ecosystem of systems, components, and product teams operating within a shared ATO boundary. This effort is focused on improving the Platform's security posture while establishing sustainable approaches for maintaining and demonstrating compliance over time. This SOW specifically calls for moving toward a modern, engineering-first cybersecurity model and implementing automated solutions where appropriate so that security improvements are durable and scalable rather than one-time fixes.

This role will be a key contributor to that effort by building the automation and data capabilities that allow security requirements, implementation evidence, vulnerabilities, remediation progress, and overall security posture to be measured and understood continuously rather than assembled manually in preparation for an assessment or ATO renewal. That directly supports the SOW's goal of establishing processes that allow the steady-state Platform Security team to maintain compliance iteratively.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Standard Business hours are Monday through Friday. Occasional extended or weekend hours may be required based on operational needs. Must have reliable internet service that allows for effective telecommuting.  Travel may be required from time to time for customer meetings and industry events.

PAY RANGE

The base salary range for this position is $135,000 to $160,000 annually, depending on geographic work location, relevant experience, skills, education, internal equity, security clearance, and contract requirements. Geographic salary ranges are determined in accordance with the company's compensation practices and represent a good-faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting.

BENEFITS

Sprezzatura offers a comprehensive and flexible benefit package to include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Health Saving Account (when enrolled in eligible plan) with Company contribution
  • Company paid Life, Accidental Death, Short-term & Long-term Disability
  • Voluntary Accident, Hospital Indemnity, & Critical Care Insurance
  • Voluntary Medical & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Accrued Paid Time Off & Company Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company match

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Sprezzatura participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Sprezzaturais a mission-driven, Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) that thrives at the intersection of technology, innovation, and impact. We specialize in secure, scalable, and human-centered digital solutions that accelerate government transformation. Our work spans DevSecOps, health IT modernization, intelligent automation, benefits delivery, and digital communications. We partner with agencies ready to evolve—delivering not just strategy, but measurable execution. Rooted in operational excellence and driven by curiosity, we help our clients navigate complexity with clarity—turning ambitious ideas into real-world outcomes. No buzzwords. Just impact.

EEO STATEMENT

Sprezzatura is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Applicants have the right to discuss, disclose, or inquire about compensation without retaliation. Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities.

This job description is not intended to be an employment contract and does not guarantee employment for any specific duration.

  • Proficiency with Linux command-line interface and experience with SQL databases (e.g., Sybase, PostgreSQL, MS SQL).

DVT is one of the top software development companies on the continent. Our software engineers are consulting on cutting-edge applications at top companies in South Africa, as well as consulting globally. You will have the opportunity to work alongside some of the most established developers in the country and globally with the latest technologies.

DVT is committed to continuously training our staff and we are very proud of our culture of learning, internal speaking and training at a variety of sponsored technical events across the AWS ecosystem.

We are looking for a Senior AWS Cloud Engineer to join a strategic cloud transformation programme. This is a hands-on consulting role requiring deep AWS engineering expertise, strong technical leadership, and the ability to design and deliver production-grade cloud platforms.

This role is not suited to candidates whose experience has primarily involved deploying applications into AWS environments designed by others. We are specifically looking for an engineer who has personally designed, built, configured and operated AWS infrastructure in production and can confidently own architecture, security, networking and operational decisions.

You'll play a key role in shaping AWS architecture, driving CI/CD transformation, enabling Salesforce integrations, improving observability, and providing technical leadership across multiple workstreams.

Requirements

AWS Cloud Engineering & Architecture

  • Own AWS solution architecture, platform design and environment configuration.

  • Design, build and operate AWS infrastructure supporting production workloads.

  • Make key decisions around AWS service selection, security, networking, scalability, resilience and operational management.

  • Drive infrastructure automation and standardisation using Infrastructure as Code.

  • Ensure cloud solutions are secure, maintainable and aligned to AWS best practices.

  • Lead technical design discussions and provide architectural guidance across delivery teams.

Salesforce ↔ AWS Integration

  • Design and build integrations between Salesforce and AWS-hosted systems.

  • Implement synchronous API integrations, EventBridge event-driven integrations and S3-based batch processing solutions.

  • Design secure, reliable and supportable integration patterns.

  • Extend Salesforce capabilities through AWS-native services where required.

CI/CD & DevSecOps

  • Lead the migration from GitFlow to trunk-based deployment and promotion patterns.

  • Design and implement secure CI/CD practices within GitLab.

  • Improve security scanning capabilities using Snyk and related tooling.

  • Drive DevSecOps best practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Observability & Reliability

  • Establish and enhance observability across AWS and Salesforce platforms.

  • Implement monitoring, tracing, dashboards and alerting capabilities.

  • Leverage Amazon CloudWatch and recommend additional tooling where appropriate.

  • Improve operational visibility and platform reliability.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead and mentor engineers across the programme.

  • Establish technical standards, engineering practices and architectural governance.

  • Provide technical direction while remaining actively involved in delivery.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts to both engineering and business stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with cloud, CRM, platform and business teams to ensure successful delivery.

Google Cloud for Data Teams

  • Support the setup and configuration of Google Cloud environments used by the data teams.

  • Assist with IAM, project configuration and foundational infrastructure for BigQuery and Google Analytics workloads.

Required Experience and Skills

Must-have

  • 8+ years in infrastructure/cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and operating production AWS.

  • Proven experience as an AWS Cloud Engineer, AWS Platform Engineer or AWS Solutions Architect.

  • Extensive experience designing, building and operating production AWS environments.

  • Demonstrable ownership of AWS infrastructure and architecture decisions.

  • Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting AWS services directly.

  • Experience making architectural, security and operational decisions for cloud platforms.

  • Strong knowledge of AWS networking, IAM, compute, storage, monitoring and security services.

  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (preferred), CloudFormation or AWS CDK, including testing and validation of IAC.

  • Experience building integrations using services such as API Gateway, Lambda, EventBridge and S3.

  • Hands-on observability experience using CloudWatch, monitoring, tracing and alerting solutions.

  • Independent technical ownership and mentoring experience is a plus.

  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

Advantageous

  • Salesforce integration experience, including Platform Events, Change Data Capture and REST/Bulk APIs.

  • Google Cloud Platform experience, particularly IAM, BigQuery and project setup.

  • Strong GitLab CI/CD experience, including trunk-based deployment approaches.

  • Experience with Snyk or similar SAST/SCA tooling.

  • AWS X-Ray, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana or similar observability tooling.

  • AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect Associate, Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional.

  • Experience delivering large-scale cloud transformation or platform modernisation initiatives.

What will make you successful?

You'll stand out if you can demonstrate that you have:

  • Personally designed and built AWS infrastructure that is running in production today.

  • Made architectural decisions regarding security, networking, scalability and resilience.

  • Owned cloud platforms rather than simply consumed infrastructure built by others.

  • Driven Infrastructure as Code adoption and cloud automation initiatives.

  • Led technical teams while remaining hands-on.

  • The ability to clearly explain why specific AWS services and patterns were chosen and how they operate in practice.

raw.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

A Note on How to Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.

Demand generation strategy & execution

  • Proven track record leading demand generation through a period of rapid company growth, ideally including experience operating through M&A or platform/product integration
  • History of consistently meeting or exceeding pipeline and revenue targets at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company
  • Strong command of account-based marketing (ABM) strategy and execution
  • Experience marketing B2B SaaS into government buyers, particularly at the local and state level
  • Highly metrics-driven, with fluency in attribution and funnel/pipeline reporting
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building process from the ground up as a segment scales
  • Strong collaborator — experience working closely with Content, Product Marketing, Events, and Sales/RevOps to drive integrated demand generation
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States

Nice to have

  • Experience in adjacent regulated or mission-driven verticals (nonprofit, education, public sector tech)
  • Experience with grant management or grantmaking software, or adjacent nonprofit tech
  • Experience in demand generation at a rapidly growing government focused B2B SaaS company
  • Familiarity with public sector procurement processes, budget cycles, and messaging tailored to government stakeholders at the local and state level particularly
  • Relationships within government and public sector networks and associations relevant to grantmaking
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:

Strategic Thinking

Translates Foundant's North Star into a concrete strategy for scaling into government, public sector, and other emerging segments — building the playbook, list, and pipeline from scratch rather than inheriting an existing one

Performance Advancement

Sets a high bar for pipeline and revenue performance in a brand-new segment, using attribution and funnel data to catch what's working — and what isn't — before quarterly targets are at risk

Decision-Making

Uses evidence and a test-and-learn approach to make fast, well-reasoned calls on new channels and tactics in a segment with no existing playbook to fall back on

Collaboration and Learning

Builds real working relationships across Content, Product Marketing, Events, Sales, and RevOps — because a segment this new only scales if the whole team is pulling in the same direction

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Remote (US-based) · Independent contractor · ~15–20 hrs/week ongoing · Reports to the Senior Medical Director

About Shapely

Shapely is transforming the weight loss industry through an innovative physician-led approach that makes weight loss care affordable for everyone. With evidence-based care, industry-leading support, and a seamless integrated app, we help thousands of patients across California, Florida, New York, and Texas access GLP-1 therapies and comprehensive weight management, all covered by insurance, including Medicare. Most of our patients are over 65.

Our care model is longitudinal and includes MDs/DOs, NPs, PAs, and RDNs. We bill fee-for-service and also participate in MIPS.

The role

You'll be the person who makes sure what we document supports what we bill, and that we're capturing everything we legitimately earn. This is a hands-on coding and auditing role reporting to the Senior Medical Director — not a policy, billing-clerk, or general compliance position.

You'll work in two modes. Prospectively, you'll help us assess which codes are safe to use for a given visit type as well as what documentation needs to be present to use teh coe compliantly. Retrospectively, you'll audit charts to confirm the documentation holds up with high accuracy, and turn opportunities for improvement into templates, workflow fixes, and education.

What you'll do

Audit

  • Conduct a baseline documentation audit (10–20 charts per billing provider) across encounters, and deliver a findings report with error rates by provider and service line

  • Run ongoing quarterly audits (10 charts per provider) plus focused service-line reviews.

  • Perform 100% pre-bill review during new-code rollouts until the error rate is under 5%

  • Place any provider above a 10% error rate on monthly review with targeted education until they're back under threshold

Code evaluation

  • Evaluate appropriateness of unused or underused codes for our care model and define the documentation each requires before we bill it

  • Write documentation guidance for our clinical staff and billing team.

MIPS

  • Assist with success with MIPS, including determining appropriate measures and ensuring our documentation exceeds requirements.

  • Provide suggestions on enhancing our templates to optimize accuracy and compliance with MIPS


Requirements

Required

  • CPC (AAPC) or CCS-P (AHIMA)

  • CPMA strongly preferred, or equivalent demonstrated chart-audit experience

  • 5+ years coding outpatient E/M, with direct auditing experience

  • Strong knowledge of Medicare telehealth rules

  • Experience with MIPS reporting and quality-measure documentation

  • US-based, with strong Medicare experience

Nice to have

  • Obesity medicine, endocrinology, or primary care background

  • Prior work with OIG self-disclosure or payer audit response

  • Experience building documentation templates or clinician cheat-sheets

Position: Conveyancing Paralegal

Salary: £1,000 per month

Working Hours: UK business hours

Holidays: UK public holidays

About the Role:

We are seeking an adaptable, highly reliable Conveyancing Paralegal to join our UK based client as a dedicated, full-time remote team member based in South Africa or the Philippines.

Our UK based client is an established East London law firm handling approximately 100 residential conveyancing matters per month. To relieve pressure across the department, free up existing UK fee earners, and ensure seamless service, the firm is creating a flexible, "floating" offshore conveyancing resource.

In this role, you will act as an essential operational engine—supporting multiple fee earners, taking complete ownership of routine and post-completion work across the department, and stepping in to cover active caseloads during periods of high volume or annual leave under UK supervision. Whether assisting with initial searches, reviewing documents, or managing post-completion requirements, you will take work away from the team without creating additional management burden.

Key Responsibilities

Core Conveyancing Support & Departmental Workflow

  • Floating Fee-Earner Support: Move seamlessly across multiple fee earners' files, providing operational support where demand is highest across sales, purchases, re-mortgages, and transfers of equity.
  • Searches & File Setup: Order, track, and perform initial reviews of property search packages (local authority, environmental, drainage) and ensure onboarding compliance documents (KYC/AML, TA forms) are logged.
  • Legal Drafting: Prepare standard contracts, transfers of title (TR1), property questionnaires, and mortgage documentation under UK fee-earner guidance.

Department-Wide Post-Completion Ownership

  • End-to-End Post-Completion: Take complete ownership of post-completion duties across the entire firm, including preparing completion statements, drafting and submitting SDLT returns, and submitting Land Registry applications (AP1).
  • Requisition Management: Monitor and respond to Land Registry requisitions promptly, ensuring clear title registration without delays.

Caseload Coverage & Continuity

  • Active File Progressions: Substantially progress active conveyancing files under supervision, keeping matters moving when fee earners are away on leave or experiencing workload spikes.
  • Multi-Party Communication: Communicate clearly, professionally, and articulately with UK colleagues, estate agents, lenders, redemption departments, and opposing conveyancers.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • England & Wales Conveyancing Experience (Essential): Direct, practical experience handling residential conveyancing specifically under English and Welsh law. (General SA/PH legal qualifications without UK conveyancing experience will not be considered).
  • Full Process Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the complete UK conveyancing lifecycle—from file opening, search ordering, and contract drafting to exchange, completion, and post-completion.
  • Post-Completion Competence: Proven track record of independently handling AP1 Land Registry submissions, SDLT filings, and resolving requisitions.
  • Case Management Tech: Confident operating legal Case Management Systems (CMS) and keeping digital audit trails up to date.
  • Ego-Free & Adaptable Attitude: Zero hesitation towards administrative tasks; comfortable serving as a floating resource supporting multiple team members.
  • Professional Communication: Clear, articulate spoken and written English, suited for professional collaboration with UK legal teams and third parties.

What Success Looks Like

The firm's UK fee earners have significantly more time to focus on complex legal matters and firm growth; post-completion tasks are executed flawlessly on time; caseloads progress uninterrupted during staff absences; and the department operates smoothly without creating added management oversight for the Managing Directors.

raw.title: Business Insights Analyst, Remote US
raw.excerpt: About CarewellAre you an impact-driven problem solver who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of others while contributing to a fast growing start-up?
raw.description:
About Carewell

Are you an impact-driven problem solver who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of others while contributing to a fast growing start-up? Join Carewell and be a part of a team that creates impactful solutions for caregivers and their unique challenges. We're looking for hardworking individuals committed to raising the bar and striving for impact, scalability, and simplicity. Build your career with Carewell, a category-defining business dedicated to making caregiving easier.

Our Data Philosophy

We build for leverage, not volume. That means self-service by default — stakeholders should be able to answer their own questions, with us as partners on the analysis that actually requires one. It means building everything so it can be used by LLMs, not just people; AI tooling isn't perfect, but we'd rather work at its edge than wait for it to be easy. And it means impact above all: we prioritize work with a measurable effect on the business, and we say no to work that doesn't move it forward.

About the Role

Carewell runs on a mix of e-commerce fundamentals and service delivery — merchandising, marketing, and revenue on one side; Care Services and customer support on the other. As the Business Insights Analyst, your role exists to make sure every part of that business can see, in numbers, whether it's working.

You won't be reporting the news. You'll be figuring out what's actually driving the number to move, building the report or tracker that lets a stakeholder self-monitor going forward, and helping them land on the levers worth pulling next. You'll work across financial reporting, marketing efficiency, merchandising and margin, customer cohort behavior, and Care Services productivity — not as a subject matter expert in any one of them, but as someone who's demonstrated, repeatedly, that they can get fluent in a new part of a business fast enough to build something useful in it.

This role reports to the Sr. Director of Analytics & Data Engineering, who owns the canonical data model and BI architecture. You won't own that architecture — but you'll work inside it daily, and you'll need to understand table structure well enough to direct how existing tables should be re-engineered to support the analysis you're building.

This is a role built for someone who wants to go deep on the analysis and the business itself, not climb toward people management. We're looking for 3–5 years of experience and someone who's genuinely excited about spending the next several years getting better at this craft, not treating it as a one-year stepping stone.

What You’ll Do

Build Reports That Drive Action, Not Just Reporting

  • Design and build reports and dashboards that help stakeholders self-monitor their part of the business
  • Go beyond "what happened" to "what's driving it" — identify the underlying business drivers behind metric movement
  • Partner with stakeholders to use data to drive strategic business decisions
  • Help identify the KPIs a given team or function should actually be watching, and build the reporting that tracks them on an ongoing basis
  • Build and maintain monthly financial reports, incorporating light financial analysis across revenue, margin, and cost lines
  • Retire or simplify reports that no longer drive decisions, so stakeholders aren't left sorting signal from noise

Work Across the Business

  • Marketing efficiency analysis: CAC, LTV, spend efficiency, channel-level performance
  • Merchandising, revenue, and profit/margin analysis: product- and category-level performance, margin drivers
  • Customer cohort behavior: retention curves, repeat purchase patterns, Autoship performance
  • Care Services productivity analysis: throughput, service-level metrics, staffing efficiency
  • No single one of these needs to be a specialty coming in — you'll need to show you can ramp into a new analytical domain and produce something useful, not just competent, in it

Turn Feedback Into Measurable Levers

  • Take stakeholder input — a hunch, a complaint, an open question — and turn it into a concrete, testable hypothesis about what lever to pull
  • Build the tracking needed to measure results once that lever is pulled, before the lever is pulled, not after
  • Close the loop — report back on whether the lever worked, and adjust the tracking or the hypothesis if it didn't
  • Flag when a stakeholder's request points to a bigger underlying question worth raising, rather than just answering exactly what was asked

Communicate Across the Organization

  • Work directly with stakeholders at every level, from individual contributors to senior leadership
  • Strong, clear written and verbal communication is required; polished presentation skills are not
  • Translate technical or data-heavy findings into plain language a non-analytical stakeholder can act on

Work With the Data Foundation (Not Own It)

  • Understand table structure and data model design well enough to give clear direction on how existing tables should be re-engineered to support your analysis
  • Write complex, efficient SQL to build and maintain your own analytical queries independently
  • Use AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Claude Cowork) and Hex as part of your everyday workflow — from day one, not as a learning curve
  • Escalate data model or table-structure issues to rather than working around them repeatedly

Outcomes You’ll Drive

  • Actionable, Not Just Accurate: Reports and dashboards that lead stakeholders to a decision or a lever to pull, not just a status update
  • Trusted Monthly Financials: Monthly financial reporting that's accurate, timely, and consistent enough for leadership to rely on without re-checking it
  • KPIs That Stick: Self-monitoring metrics and dashboards that teams actually keep using — not built once and abandoned
  • Levers Tracked to Results: A clear record of levers identified from stakeholder input, with tracking in place to show whether each one worked
  • Cross-Functional Fluency: Demonstrated ability to ramp into a new part of the business (Marketing, Merchandising, Finance, Care Services) and produce useful analysis within it, without requiring deep subject-matter ramp-up time
  • Day-One AI Leverage: Visible, practical use of AI tools in the analytical workflow from the start — faster turnaround and broader coverage than a comparable analyst working without them

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a closely related analytical role
  • Demonstrated experience working across multiple functional areas of a business (i.e. marketing, product, finance, operations)
  • Strong SQL skills — comfortable writing complex analytical queries independently, including joins across multiple tables and aggregations at different levels of grain
  • Working understanding of relational table structure and data modeling concepts — able to read an existing schema and identify where it should change to support new analysis
  • Proven experience with modern reporting tools (Hex, Looker, Omni, Etc.)
  • Practical, hands-on experience using AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate analytical work — able to apply this productively from day one, not as something to be trained on
  • E-commerce or DTC experience strongly preferred; service-business experience (support, care, or operations) also valuable given Carewell's Care Services function
  • A specific example, from a past role, of a report or metric you built that changed a stakeholder's decision — not just informed it
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfort presenting findings to stakeholders at all levels
  • A track record that suggests genuine interest in going deep on analytical craft over the next several years, rather than using this as a fast step toward a management track
  • Degree in a quantitative, business, or related field preferred

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Health, Dental, and Vision insurance
  • Short-term Disability and Life Insurance (100% employer-sponsored)
  • Long-term Disability
  • Supplemental Life Insurance (employee-sponsored)
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • 100% Remote
  • Generous paid time off and 6 paid holidays
  • Employee discount

Learn more about the Carewell story.

Carewell is a category-defining business that is dedicated to providing the most trusted and reputable retail source for caregiving products. Our vast selection of expert-vetted products includes incontinence supplies, wound care, nutrition, mobility aids, and more, all available at the best prices with fast, reliable shipping. We are proud to have been recognized as one of the fastest-growing companies in the US, ranked on the Inc. 5000, and named one of the most customer-centric companies in the world by Forbes in 2022. At Carewell, we understand the importance of caregiving, and we strive to provide the highest quality products to help caregivers provide the best care possible for their loved ones.

As the number of older adults in the US grows, the need for caregiving solutions will only increase. By joining Carewell, you will have the opportunity to work in a space that is constantly evolving, with new challenges and opportunities for growth. We are committed to being architects of our own success, always striving to improve our teams, partnerships, and solutions to ensure impact, scalability, and simplicity. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with like-minded individuals, using customer insights, data, research, and feedback to make decisions and create the most effective solutions. If you are ready to join a team of dedicated individuals who are committed to making a difference in the world, Carewell is the place for you.

raw.description:
Photonics Layout Engineer (Remote)

About us:

Voyant Photonics is bushing the boundaries of silicon photonic chips that steer and switch light at high speed. They power next generation, chip-scale FMCW LiDAR for robotics and autonomy, and optical circuit switches (OCS) for AI data centers. Based in NYC, we’re a hands-on team designing, building, and deploying frontier hardware to solve problems that matter, from how machines see to how AI scales.

Why Join Us?

At Voyant, you'll help develop some of the most sophisticated silicon photonic chips, spanning two applications: optical circuit switching for AI data centers and chip-scale LiDAR sensing.

You'll tackle challenging problems in large-scale photonic integration, including dense waveguide routing, multilayer photonic layouts, and complex die- and reticle-level floorplanning. Our PICs integrate hundreds to thousands of optical components, requiring innovative layout approaches that balance optical performance, chip dimensions, and manufacturability.

As a Photonic Layout Engineer, you'll take ownership of PIC layouts from initial floorplanning through tapeout. You'll have the opportunity to develop automated layout methodologies, solve complex routing challenges, and work closely with photonic designers and other engineering teams in a fast-paced startup environment.

What You'll Do:

  • Develop and implement layouts for complex photonic integrated circuits, from component-level test structures to large-scale system PICs.

  • Translate photonic schematics and design requirements into efficient, manufacturable GDSII layouts.

  • Implement dense waveguide routing, multilayer optical interconnects, and die- and reticle-level floorplanning.

  • Develop and maintain parameterized photonic component cells (PCells) and reusable layout libraries.

  • Create Python-based scripts and automation tools for layout generation, routing, and design verification.

  • Integrate photonic and electrical layouts, including electrical routing, contact pads, and packaging interfaces.

  • Perform and debug physical verification, including DRC, LVS, and optical connectivity checks.

  • Collaborate with photonic designers, packaging engineers, and foundry partners to optimize layouts and support tapeout submissions.

What We're Looking For

  • B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Photonics, Physics, Optical Engineering, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in photonic integrated circuit layout, preferably in silicon photonics or a similar platform.

  • Proficiency with photonic layout tools such as GDSFactory, IPKISS, KLayout, or equivalent.

  • Strong Python scripting skills, including experience with layout automation or parameterized designs.

  • Experience with photonic waveguide routing, component placement, and chip-level layout integration.

  • Familiarity with silicon photonics foundry PDKs, design rules, and tapeout processes.

  • Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with large-scale PIC layout, optical switching networks, or complex photonic routing architectures.

  • Experience with multilayer silicon/silicon nitride photonic platforms and interlayer optical transitions.

  • Experience developing automated routing, placement optimization, or layout generation algorithms.

  • Familiarity with Cadence Virtuoso, SKILL, or electrical layout and EDA integration.

  • Experience with photonic-electronic co-layout, packaging interfaces, or commercial silicon photonics foundry tapeouts.

Life at Voyant

We build frontier hardware & systems from our lab and office in Midtown Manhattan, where optical tables, lab benches and electronics sit alongside traditional office space. Our work is hands-on and primarily in person, but we don’t run on a rigid 9-to-5. We partner with customers across time zones, so some calls start early or run late, and we adjust schedules around them. We run a high-trust, high-accountability environment: you’ll own meaningful work, move quickly and often wear more than one hat. Voyant provides catered lunch every day at HQ, and we’re a diverse group of food lovers from around the world who enjoy sharing food, culture and technical ideas around the lunch table.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Voyant Photonics is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, marital or partnership status, age, national origin, citizenship, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $120K - $190K

About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.


Position Overview


Vantage is seeking an accomplished and visionary Director of Solutions Engineering to help advance our Solutions Engineering function.


Join the world’s leading data center experts and help design infrastructure solutions for some of the most innovative customers on the planet. As a Director of Solutions Engineering, you will play a critical role in the pre-sales process by providing technical expertise and designing tailored data center solutions that meet customer requirements for space, power, cooling, and connectivity.


Acting as a site-specific Subject Matter Expert (SME) for North America and new emerging markets, you will collaborate closely with Sales, other Solutions Engineers, Design Engineering, Design Management, Operations, Commercial Management, Construction and legal teams to drive successful outcomes—from initial customer engagement through seamless handoff to Construction Delivery and Technical Solutions and Delivery.


This role blends customer-facing engagement, technical design excellence, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver optimized, scalable solutions aligned with customer needs and company standards.

Essential Job Functions


Customer Engagement & Pre-Sales Support

  • Engage with customers to understand business objectives, technical requirements, and operational challenges.
  • Conduct site surveys, assessments, and onsite due diligence to gather detailed infrastructure and whitespace requirements.
  • Support customer RFPs, RFIs, and technical due diligence activities with a focus on site-specific solutions.
  • Present solutions to customers through technical presentations, workshops, demos, and site visits, clearly articulating features, benefits, and competitive advantages.
  • Provide technical expertise during customer tours and solution presentations.

Technical Excellence

  • Design customized data center solutions optimizing space, power, cooling, airflow, connectivity, telecoms, security, office, and storage as applicable.
  • Act as the local SME for campuses, including whitespace design, inventory, pathways, connectivity, and capacity management.
  • Develop detailed technical documentation, proposals, and Scopes of Work (SOW) including clarifications and risk considerations, in collaboration with Regional Design Engineers, and Asset management.
  • Perform Service Order reviews and cost validation activities to ensure accuracy and alignment with customer requirements.

Commercial & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Obtain pricing and delivery timelines by working closely with design and construction teams along with commercial issuing Sales Engineering Pricing Requests (SEPRs) to Design, Engineering & Construction (DE&C) teams as required.
  • Support sales forecasting, pipeline development, and market analysis efforts.
  • Facilitate smooth transitions from sales to implementation by ensuring technical accuracy, consistency, and completeness of handoff documentation.

Market & Product Insight

  • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in data center design through ongoing training and certifications.
  • Serve as an asset and market expert, relaying insights to the Product, New Site Development, Market Development, Global Design, and company leadership teams.
  • Gather and communicate customer and sales feedback to support continuous improvement of products, solutions, and go-to-market strategies.

Additional Duties:

  • Handle additional duties as assigned by Management.

Job Requirements


Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, required.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in solutions engineering or a related field, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership role.
  • Proven experience in managing engineering teams and delivering complex technical solutions.

Technical Expertise

  • Proven experience designing high-density data center solutions, including power, cooling, airflow, and space optimization.
  • Familiarity with AI and high-performance computing (HPC) environments, including GPUs and specialized processors.
  • Knowledge of liquid cooling technologies and industry best practices.
  • Strong understanding of data center power distribution, UPS systems, and electrical standards.
  • Strong understanding of network architecture, fiber optics, and connectivity solutions.
  • Strong technical background with a deep understanding of engineering principles, software development, and system architecture.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to think strategically and make data-driven decisions.
  • Proficiency in software development methodologies, project management, and quality assurance practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud computing, data center operations, networking, and cybersecurity.
  • Experience with modern programming languages, development frameworks, and tools.
  • Travel required is expected to be up to 30% but may increase over time as the business evolves.
  • Proficiency with CAD tools such as AutoCAD, Visio, or similar (CFD modeling experience preferred).
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and Adobe Acrobat.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details


  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.
  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

#Remote


We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.


Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.


Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.


We’ll be accepting applications for at least one week from the date this role is posted. If you're interested, we encourage you to apply soon—we’re excited to find the right person and will keep the role open until we do!
