raw.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Position Title: Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer
Location: Remote (In the U.S)

Other Considerations: U.S. Citizen or Permanent Resident (Required)

Position is contingent on contract award

POSITION SUMMARY

Sprezzatura is seeking a Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer to support cybersecurity modernization for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) VA.gov Platform.

The Security Automation / Data Engineer will design, develop, and implement automation that improves how security compliance data is collected, assessed, measured, and reported across a large-scale digital platform. This role will help transform repeatable, manual security and compliance activities into sustainable, engineering-driven capabilities that provide greater visibility into security posture and reduce the operational burden associated with maintaining compliance.

Working alongside security, DevSecOps, infrastructure, and product engineering teams, this position will focus on automated evidence collection and controls assessment, security data integration, compliance measurement, vulnerability and remediation reporting, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) capabilities, and security posture dashboards.

The ideal candidate combines cybersecurity knowledge with strong automation and data engineering skills and is comfortable integrating information across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tools, APIs, and compliance systems.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated processes for collecting security and compliance evidence from authoritative system, infrastructure, configuration, and security data sources
  • Develop automation to support security control assessment and continuous monitoring, including OSCAL-based evidence collection and control-assessment capabilities
  • Build integrations and data pipelines that aggregate and normalize security information from multiple tools, platforms, and APIs
  • Develop security metrics and dashboards that provide near-real-time visibility into control posture, remediation status, vulnerabilities, and other security indicators
  • Automate recurring security and compliance reporting for security teams, engineering teams, program leadership, and government stakeholders
  • Develop capabilities for measuring security-control and security-tooling coverage across applications, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Automate vulnerability and remediation reporting to support prioritization, ownership, aging analysis, and tracking through closure
  • Support implementation and operation of an SBOM capability, including collection and analysis of software dependency and third-party component data
  • Integrate SBOM and software supply-chain information with vulnerability management and security reporting capabilities
  • Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to ensure security controls implemented within CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure generate usable, repeatable compliance evidence
  • Identify manual security and compliance processes that are candidates for automation and implement scalable solutions where feasible
  • Support the development of repeatable processes that enable product and engineering teams to demonstrate continued compliance with defined security standards
  • Ensure automated security evidence, metrics, and reporting are traceable, maintainable, and usable during ongoing compliance activities and independent controls assessments
  • Document automation, integrations, data sources, processes, and technical solutions to support long-term sustainment by the Platform Security team
  • Collaborate with security engineers, cybersecurity/RMF specialists, DevSecOps engineers, software engineers, product teams, and government stakeholders

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Associate's degree and four (4) years of relevant experience, or Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of relevant experience.
  • Five (5) years of experience as a Cyber Security Engineer may be substituted in lieu of a degree
  • Experience developing automation using Python, JavaScript, or another scripting/programming language
  • Experience integrating data from APIs, cloud platforms, CI/CD systems, security tools, or other technical systems
  • Experience designing or developing automated workflows, data pipelines, dashboards, metrics, or reporting solutions
  • Working knowledge of cybersecurity concepts including security controls, vulnerability management, continuous monitoring, and compliance
  • Experience working with modern software development and CI/CD practices
  • Ability to analyze security and technical data and translate it into meaningful metrics and actionable information
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate across security, engineering, product, and program teams
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the background investigation and access required to support Department of Veterans Affairs systems

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience supporting federal cybersecurity programs or systems operating under the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF)
  • Knowledge of NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security controls
  • Experience with OSCAL or other machine-readable approaches to security compliance and control assessment
  • Experience automating security evidence collection, continuous monitoring, or compliance assessment
  • Experience with AWS security and configuration data, including services such as AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, or similar cloud-native security tooling
  • Experience integrating security capabilities into or extracting security data from GitHub Actions or other CI/CD platforms
  • Experience with SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), secrets detection, container scanning, or other application security tooling
  • Experience implementing or working with Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) standards and tooling
  • Experience with software supply-chain security and dependency or third-party component risk analysis
  • Experience developing security posture, vulnerability management, or compliance dashboards
  • Familiarity with federal ATO processes, POA&Ms, control implementation evidence, and independent controls assessments
  • Experience working within large-scale cloud platforms or environments supporting multiple independent product and engineering teams

ABOUT THE WORK

The VA.gov Platform supports a large ecosystem of systems, components, and product teams operating within a shared ATO boundary. This effort is focused on improving the Platform's security posture while establishing sustainable approaches for maintaining and demonstrating compliance over time. This SOW specifically calls for moving toward a modern, engineering-first cybersecurity model and implementing automated solutions where appropriate so that security improvements are durable and scalable rather than one-time fixes.

This role will be a key contributor to that effort by building the automation and data capabilities that allow security requirements, implementation evidence, vulnerabilities, remediation progress, and overall security posture to be measured and understood continuously rather than assembled manually in preparation for an assessment or ATO renewal. That directly supports the SOW's goal of establishing processes that allow the steady-state Platform Security team to maintain compliance iteratively.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Standard Business hours are Monday through Friday. Occasional extended or weekend hours may be required based on operational needs. Must have reliable internet service that allows for effective telecommuting.  Travel may be required from time to time for customer meetings and industry events.

PAY RANGE

The base salary range for this position is $135,000 to $160,000 annually, depending on geographic work location, relevant experience, skills, education, internal equity, security clearance, and contract requirements. Geographic salary ranges are determined in accordance with the company's compensation practices and represent a good-faith estimate of the compensation for this position at the time of posting.

BENEFITS

Sprezzatura offers a comprehensive and flexible benefit package to include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision
  • Health Saving Account (when enrolled in eligible plan) with Company contribution
  • Company paid Life, Accidental Death, Short-term & Long-term Disability
  • Voluntary Accident, Hospital Indemnity, & Critical Care Insurance
  • Voluntary Medical & Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Accrued Paid Time Off & Company Paid Holidays
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company match

WORK AUTHORIZATION

You'll play a key role in shaping AWS architecture, driving CI/CD transformation, enabling Salesforce integrations, improving observability, and providing technical leadership across multiple workstreams.

Requirements

AWS Cloud Engineering & Architecture

  • Own AWS solution architecture, platform design and environment configuration.

  • Design, build and operate AWS infrastructure supporting production workloads.

Salesforce ↔ AWS Integration

  • Design and build integrations between Salesforce and AWS-hosted systems.

CI/CD & DevSecOps

  • Lead the migration from GitFlow to trunk-based deployment and promotion patterns.

  • Design and implement secure CI/CD practices within GitLab.

  • Improve security scanning capabilities using Snyk and related tooling.

  • Drive DevSecOps best practices throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Observability & Reliability

  • Establish and enhance observability across AWS and Salesforce platforms.

  • Implement monitoring, tracing, dashboards and alerting capabilities.

  • Leverage Amazon CloudWatch and recommend additional tooling where appropriate.

  • Improve operational visibility and platform reliability.

Technical Leadership

  • Lead and mentor engineers across the programme.

  • Provide technical direction while remaining actively involved in delivery.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts to both engineering and business stakeholders.

  • Collaborate with cloud, CRM, platform and business teams to ensure successful delivery.

Google Cloud for Data Teams

  • Support the setup and configuration of Google Cloud environments used by the data teams.

  • Assist with IAM, project configuration and foundational infrastructure for BigQuery and Google Analytics workloads.

Required Experience and Skills

Must-have

  • 8+ years in infrastructure/cloud engineering, including 5+ years designing and operating production AWS.

  • Proven experience as an AWS Cloud Engineer, AWS Platform Engineer or AWS Solutions Architect.

  • Extensive experience designing, building and operating production AWS environments.

  • Demonstrable ownership of AWS infrastructure and architecture decisions.

  • Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting AWS services directly.

  • Experience making architectural, security and operational decisions for cloud platforms.

  • Strong knowledge of AWS networking, IAM, compute, storage, monitoring and security services.

  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform (preferred), CloudFormation or AWS CDK, including testing and validation of IAC.

  • Experience building integrations using services such as API Gateway, Lambda, EventBridge and S3.

  • Hands-on observability experience using CloudWatch, monitoring, tracing and alerting solutions.

  • Independent technical ownership and mentoring experience is a plus.

  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills.

Advantageous

  • Salesforce integration experience, including Platform Events, Change Data Capture and REST/Bulk APIs.

  • Google Cloud Platform experience, particularly IAM, BigQuery and project setup.

  • Strong GitLab CI/CD experience, including trunk-based deployment approaches.

  • Experience with Snyk or similar SAST/SCA tooling.

  • AWS X-Ray, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, Grafana or similar observability tooling.

  • AWS certifications such as Solutions Architect Associate, Solutions Architect Professional or DevOps Engineer Professional.

  • Experience delivering large-scale cloud transformation or platform modernisation initiatives.

What will make you successful?

You'll stand out if you can demonstrate that you have:

  • Personally designed and built AWS infrastructure that is running in production today.

  • Made architectural decisions regarding security, networking, scalability and resilience.

  • Owned cloud platforms rather than simply consumed infrastructure built by others.

  • Driven Infrastructure as Code adoption and cloud automation initiatives.

  • Led technical teams while remaining hands-on.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

A Note on How to Reach Us

We're truly grateful that so many people have Foundant on their radar — it means a lot that our work resonates with others. That said, due to the high volume of direct messages and emails we receive, cold outreach isn't the preferred way to be considered for a role, and we're not able to prioritize applications submitted this way. To apply for open positions, please visit our careers page, which is the fastest and most effective route to being considered.

About Foundant

At Foundant, we build mission-critical software for the social good ecosystem — helping foundations, grantmakers, nonprofits, and community organizations streamline their work, strengthen relationships, and maximize their impact. We serve the giving community worldwide with a comprehensive suite of solutions spanning grant management, community foundation software, and giving analytics.

We're a unified company shaped by strong roots across our product portfolio, and we operate with intention and purpose. Our team of ~350 people across six countries is connected by a shared North Star: to be the trusted partner and strategic advisor to the communities we serve.

Where You’ll Work:

  • As a remote-first workplace, we believe in offering flexibility and the freedom to work where it suits you best, while staying connected through technology. Our global network of talent is supported by physical office hubs and virtual collaboration, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation and growth thrive.
  • With office locations in Bozeman, MT, Toronto, Canada, and Dublin, Ireland, you'll be part of a globally connected team. Whether you're working remotely or from one of our office locations, you'll be contributing to a vibrant, collaborative culture focused on driving meaningful impact across the world.
WhatYou’llDo:

Demand generation strategy & execution

  • Own and execute the demand generation strategy for our government and public sector segment, plus other new segments, building lists, driving MQLs and creating pipeline that consistently meets or exceeds targets
  • Build and run integrated, multi-channel campaigns (email, paid, events, content) tailored to segment buyer behavior and budget cycles
  • Bring an inventive, test-and-learn approach, piloting new channels and tactics rather than relying solely on established playbooks

Account-based marketing

  • Lead ABM strategy and execution for targeted accounts, including account selection, personalization at scale, and close alignment with Sales on account engagement
  • Partner with Sales to define and refine target account lists across assigned segments including local and state government prospects

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work closely with Content, Product Marketing, and Sales to ensure messaging and campaigns resonate with buyer pain points
  • Partner with Events on segment-focused field and virtual events, from conference presence to webinars and roundtable lunch and learns
  • Align with Sales and RevOps on lead scoring, channel metrics, and handoff to ensure marketing-sourced conversions

Metrics & reporting

  • Take a highly metrics-driven approach to pipeline generation, with fluency in attribution, funnel conversion, and pipeline efficiency reporting
  • Report regularly on segment performance against pipeline and revenue targets, adjusting strategy based on results
  • Other duties as assigned
WhatYou’llNeed:
  • Proven track record leading demand generation through a period of rapid company growth, ideally including experience operating through M&A or platform/product integration
  • History of consistently meeting or exceeding pipeline and revenue targets at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company
  • Strong command of account-based marketing (ABM) strategy and execution
  • Experience marketing B2B SaaS into government buyers, particularly at the local and state level
  • Highly metrics-driven, with fluency in attribution and funnel/pipeline reporting
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and building process from the ground up as a segment scales
  • Strong collaborator — experience working closely with Content, Product Marketing, Events, and Sales/RevOps to drive integrated demand generation
  • Must be legally eligible to work in the United States

Nice to have

  • Experience in adjacent regulated or mission-driven verticals (nonprofit, education, public sector tech)
  • Experience with grant management or grantmaking software, or adjacent nonprofit tech
  • Experience in demand generation at a rapidly growing government focused B2B SaaS company
  • Familiarity with public sector procurement processes, budget cycles, and messaging tailored to government stakeholders at the local and state level particularly
  • Relationships within government and public sector networks and associations relevant to grantmaking
WhatYou’llBring to our Team Dynamics:

Strategic Thinking

Translates Foundant's North Star into a concrete strategy for scaling into government, public sector, and other emerging segments — building the playbook, list, and pipeline from scratch rather than inheriting an existing one

Performance Advancement

Sets a high bar for pipeline and revenue performance in a brand-new segment, using attribution and funnel data to catch what's working — and what isn't — before quarterly targets are at risk

Decision-Making

Uses evidence and a test-and-learn approach to make fast, well-reasoned calls on new channels and tactics in a segment with no existing playbook to fall back on

Collaboration and Learning

Builds real working relationships across Content, Product Marketing, Events, Sales, and RevOps — because a segment this new only scales if the whole team is pulling in the same direction

Why You’ll Love Working at Foundant:
  • At the heart of everything we do is a commitment to innovation and making a positive impact. Whether you’re working on projects that empower not-for-profits, community foundations, or corporations, your contributions will help drive real-world change.
  • We offer competitive salary and benefits, including tuition, and lifestyle reimbursements, and bespoke mindfulness and fitness initiatives.
  • With our Flexible PTO policy, you’ll have the freedom to manage your time in a way that supports your personal well-being and professional success.
  • We’re committed to your professional and personal development. With our merger, you'll have the chance to collaborate across teams, giving you exposure to diverse ideas, expertise, and projects that span multiple industries.
  • As part of a larger organization, you’ll have even more opportunities to grow your career. Whether it’s exploring new roles, leadership opportunities, or shifting to a different department, we support internal mobility to help you achieve your career goals
  • You’ll enjoy autonomy and responsibility, empowering you to approach your work creatively and independently, fostering innovation and independent thought.
  • Employee recognition is a core part of our culture. When you do a great job, we make sure everyone knows about it!

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Remote (US-based) · Independent contractor · ~15–20 hrs/week ongoing · Reports to the Senior Medical Director

About Shapely

Shapely is transforming the weight loss industry through an innovative physician-led approach that makes weight loss care affordable for everyone. With evidence-based care, industry-leading support, and a seamless integrated app, we help thousands of patients across California, Florida, New York, and Texas access GLP-1 therapies and comprehensive weight management, all covered by insurance, including Medicare. Most of our patients are over 65.

Our care model is longitudinal and includes MDs/DOs, NPs, PAs, and RDNs. We bill fee-for-service and also participate in MIPS.

The role

You'll be the person who makes sure what we document supports what we bill, and that we're capturing everything we legitimately earn. This is a hands-on coding and auditing role reporting to the Senior Medical Director — not a policy, billing-clerk, or general compliance position.

You'll work in two modes. Prospectively, you'll help us assess which codes are safe to use for a given visit type as well as what documentation needs to be present to use teh coe compliantly. Retrospectively, you'll audit charts to confirm the documentation holds up with high accuracy, and turn opportunities for improvement into templates, workflow fixes, and education.

What you'll do

Audit

  • Conduct a baseline documentation audit (10–20 charts per billing provider) across encounters, and deliver a findings report with error rates by provider and service line

  • Run ongoing quarterly audits (10 charts per provider) plus focused service-line reviews.

  • Perform 100% pre-bill review during new-code rollouts until the error rate is under 5%

  • Place any provider above a 10% error rate on monthly review with targeted education until they're back under threshold

Code evaluation

  • Evaluate appropriateness of unused or underused codes for our care model and define the documentation each requires before we bill it

  • Write documentation guidance for our clinical staff and billing team.

MIPS

  • Assist with success with MIPS, including determining appropriate measures and ensuring our documentation exceeds requirements.

  • Provide suggestions on enhancing our templates to optimize accuracy and compliance with MIPS


Requirements

Required

  • CPC (AAPC) or CCS-P (AHIMA)

  • CPMA strongly preferred, or equivalent demonstrated chart-audit experience

  • 5+ years coding outpatient E/M, with direct auditing experience

  • Strong knowledge of Medicare telehealth rules

  • Experience with MIPS reporting and quality-measure documentation

  • US-based, with strong Medicare experience

Nice to have

  • Obesity medicine, endocrinology, or primary care background

  • Prior work with OIG self-disclosure or payer audit response

  • Experience building documentation templates or clinician cheat-sheets

Position: Conveyancing Paralegal

Salary: £1,000 per month

Working Hours: UK business hours

Holidays: UK public holidays

About the Role:

We are seeking an adaptable, highly reliable Conveyancing Paralegal to join our UK based client as a dedicated, full-time remote team member based in South Africa or the Philippines.

Our UK based client is an established East London law firm handling approximately 100 residential conveyancing matters per month. To relieve pressure across the department, free up existing UK fee earners, and ensure seamless service, the firm is creating a flexible, "floating" offshore conveyancing resource.

In this role, you will act as an essential operational engine—supporting multiple fee earners, taking complete ownership of routine and post-completion work across the department, and stepping in to cover active caseloads during periods of high volume or annual leave under UK supervision. Whether assisting with initial searches, reviewing documents, or managing post-completion requirements, you will take work away from the team without creating additional management burden.

Key Responsibilities

Core Conveyancing Support & Departmental Workflow

  • Floating Fee-Earner Support: Move seamlessly across multiple fee earners' files, providing operational support where demand is highest across sales, purchases, re-mortgages, and transfers of equity.
  • Searches & File Setup: Order, track, and perform initial reviews of property search packages (local authority, environmental, drainage) and ensure onboarding compliance documents (KYC/AML, TA forms) are logged.
  • Legal Drafting: Prepare standard contracts, transfers of title (TR1), property questionnaires, and mortgage documentation under UK fee-earner guidance.

Department-Wide Post-Completion Ownership

  • End-to-End Post-Completion: Take complete ownership of post-completion duties across the entire firm, including preparing completion statements, drafting and submitting SDLT returns, and submitting Land Registry applications (AP1).
  • Requisition Management: Monitor and respond to Land Registry requisitions promptly, ensuring clear title registration without delays.

Caseload Coverage & Continuity

  • Active File Progressions: Substantially progress active conveyancing files under supervision, keeping matters moving when fee earners are away on leave or experiencing workload spikes.
  • Multi-Party Communication: Communicate clearly, professionally, and articulately with UK colleagues, estate agents, lenders, redemption departments, and opposing conveyancers.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • England & Wales Conveyancing Experience (Essential): Direct, practical experience handling residential conveyancing specifically under English and Welsh law. (General SA/PH legal qualifications without UK conveyancing experience will not be considered).
  • Full Process Knowledge: Thorough understanding of the complete UK conveyancing lifecycle—from file opening, search ordering, and contract drafting to exchange, completion, and post-completion.

raw.excerpt: About CogstateAt Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.
raw.description:
About Cogstate

At Cogstate, we’re advancing the science of brain health - making it faster, easier, and more accurate to assess cognition across clinical trials, healthcare settings, and everyday life.

Our digital cognitive assessments are trusted by researchers, clinicians, and pharmaceutical partners around the world, helping to drive breakthroughs in neuroscience and improve outcomes for people living with neurological conditions. Founded on decades of cognitive science and backed by rigorous validation, Cogstate’s assessments are used in more than 150 countries and over 2,000 clinical trials.

Our global team of experts - spanning psychology, data science, operations, and technology - works together to solve complex challenges in brain health assessment, always with a patient-first mindset. Whether we’re supporting a multinational Alzheimer’s trial or developing tools to bring cognitive testing into routine care, our work is meaningful, collaborative, and constantly evolving.

At Cogstate, we’re not just imagining the future of brain health - we’re building it.

About the Clinician Network

By joining the Cogstate Clinician Network, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute your clinical expertise to research studies around the world.

Depending on your background, scales experience, and therapeutic area expertise, we may have an opportunity for you immediately - or it may take some time before a study opens that is the right fit.

Cogstate is continuing to grow and expand our clinical research initiatives, so new projects and opportunities are always on the horizon.

All applicants to the Clinician Network are kept in our active pipeline, and you’ll also receive our monthly Clinician Network newsletter, which shares updates and upcoming openings.

About the Role

Cogstate Clinicians are clinical psychologists or neuropsychologists responsible for delivering remote clinical interviews and cognitive assessment batteries to subjects with preclinical dementia, enrolled in a pharmaceutical clinical trial.

Cogstate provides all consultants with comprehensive, fully compensated training on general Cogstate operational policies, study-specific procedures, customized clinical interviewing skills and virtual cognitive assessment prior to performing remote scale administrations. Regular supervision and ongoing recalibration of clinical skill set will be provided.

*These are contract position.

*They are fully remote.

*Hired employee will work on an as needed basis based on their schedule.

- MADRS Administration Experience Required
- Hungarian Fluency Required

Key Responsibilities

Central Rating

  • Remotely administering semi-structured clinical interview assessments and cognitive battery of tests to study subjects and caregivers.
  • Remotely delivering computerized and traditional cognitive assessments via a tele-health platform.
  • Scoring completed scale administrations.
  • Participating in regular clinical skill recalibration activities.

Central Monitoring

  • Providing reviews of completed neuropsychological test batteries for central monitoring of data to ensure accuracy in administration and scoring and contribute to the overall success of a clinical trial.
  • Reviewing response forms and recordings of remote scale administrations and offering feedback to raters via email and telephone communications.

Qualifications & Expertise

  • MD, DO, MBBS or PhD, PsyD in Psychology or RN, APRN, PA, MA/MS/MSW in Psychiatry (or equivalent)
  • Formal training in clinical interviewing and cognitive assessment
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant experience with direct clinical interviewing and psychological assessment in clinical research industry, academic or clinical settings
  • Direct experience with cognitive/behavioral/functional assessment of neurological/psychiatric populations
  • Ability to meet deadlines, being highly organized and methodical, with attention to detail to ensure delivery
  • Proficiency with MS Office, including Word and Excel, email, teleconference platforms such as Skype, Zoom or other similar applications, and cloud-based storage service.
  • Hungarian Fluency
  • MADRS Administration Experience Required

Our Culture
We bring our whole selves to work every day. We’re courageous and we deliver together. We’re passionate individuals who enjoy working together. We’re brave enough and care enough to have the right conversations to get the best outcome and are famous for our can-do attitude. We see challenges as opportunities and move with pace to achieve our goals.

If you’re ready to help us in our journey to optimize the measurement of brain health around the world, please apply now!

A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on the company. If you need assistance in applying please email .

Cogstate is committed to protecting your personal data. We collect and process your information for recruitment purposes in compliance with applicable laws, including the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), Virginia Consumer Data Protection Act (VCDPA), Colorado Privacy Act (CPA), and similar laws in other jurisdictions.

Job Description:

Join General Dynamics IT and be a part of a team that solve some of the world's most complex technical challenges. We are seeking a Fiber Lead tojoin our team in support of the Army TEN-M program.


This is a remote position but you must be within 50 miles of a major airport as the requirement is 25-50% travel.


The Fiber Lead conducts comprehensive site surveys, develops optimized fiber‑ and wireless‑focused network designs, and prepares all required technical documentation to ensure compliance with DoW guidelines and industry standards.


This role directs end‑to‑end deployment activities encompassing fiber construction, wireless network integration (Ericsson, Nokia, and other OEMs), and validation testing of optical transport systems including DWDM and ROADM. The Lead manages subcontractor teams and ensures that all installation, integration, and testing efforts meet project performance, quality, and compliance requirements.


The Fiber Lead:


  • Conducts detailed site surveys to assess environmental conditions, site topology, available fiber assets, power availability, wireless coverage needs, and overall infrastructure readiness. Produces site‑specific designs aligned with PWS requirements and program objectives.
  • Develops site survey, design, installation, and testing plans and processes from the ground up in collaboration with OEM partners, GDIT engineering teams, and government stakeholders.
  • Leads on‑site survey walks to oversee OTDR testing, validate network design details, review A&E drawings, and coordinate all related survey and engineering activities.
  • Performs end‑to‑end fiber design using platforms such as Vetro, ArcGIS, or equivalent fiber engineering tools. Leads integration of fiber backhaul with private 5G wireless nodes (Ericsson, Nokia, etc.) and verifies performance across all transport layers.
  • Develops and delivers the Test Network Modernization Plan (TNMP), ensuring alignment with ATEC requirements, DoD directives, and applicable technical standards.
  • Creates a comprehensive Life‑Cycle Plan (LCP) to ensure all fiber, wireless, and optical transport components remain covered under warranty, maintainable, and fully supportable throughout the system lifecycle.
  • Develops an Acceptance Test Plan for all deployed fiber, optical, and wireless technologies, including DWDM, ROADM, and OEM‑specific wireless integrations.
  • Oversees subcontractor fiber crews for aerial and underground deployments, ensuring proper execution of OTDR testing, fiber characterization, and integration into transport and wireless networks.

Basic Qualifications:


  • Education: BS degree; additional relevant years of experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
  • Required Experience: 8+ years of experience in fiber network engineering, deployment, wireless integration, or related telecommunications fields.
  • Required Experience: Deploying cellular networks for Tier‑1 carriers, DoD, or comparable large‑scale telecom customers.
  • Security Clearance Level: Active Secret Clearance desired.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Travel: Position requires 25%–50% travel. Candidate must reside within 50 miles of a major airport.

WHAT CAN GDIT OFFER YOU?


  • Excellent customizable health benefits (Medical, Dental and Vision)
  • 401K with company match
  • Educational Assistance and eLearning
  • Flexible work week
  • Internal mobility team dedicated to employee advancement
  • Rewards and Recognition programs
  • Innovative and collaborative environment encouraging of highly motivated critical thinking

Total Rewards at GDIT:

Our benefits package for all US-based employees includes a variety of medical plan options, some with Health Savings Accounts, dental plan options, a vision plan, and a 401(k) plan offering the ability to contribute both pre and post-tax dollars up to the IRS annual limits and receive a company match. To encourage work/life balance, GDIT offers employees full flex work weeks where possible and a variety of paid time off plans, including vacation, sick and personal time, holidays, paid parental, military, bereavement and jury duty leave. GDIT typically provides new employees with 15 days of paid leave per calendar year to be used for vacations, personal business, and illness and an additional 10 paid holidays per year. Paid leave and paid holidays are prorated based on the employee’s date of hire. The GDIT Paid Family Leave program provides a total of up to 160 hours of paid leave in a rolling 12 month period for eligible employees. To ensure our employees are able to protect their income, other offerings such as short and long-term disability benefits, life, accidental death and dismemberment, personal accident, critical illness and business travel and accident insurance are provided or available. We regularly review our Total Rewards package to ensure our offerings are competitive and reflect what our employees have told us they value most.

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

raw.title: Project Manager (ERP Automation)
raw.excerpt: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!
raw.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Project Manager, most of your implementations are not multi-year global programs. They are for companies that want blp running in their finance or supply chain organization within weeks, and who want somebody who knows what they are doing to take them through it. You are that person. You run the kick-off, work with them on scope and process, configure blp, coordinate the integration, take them through testing, and get them across the line at go-live.

You work in three modes, and many of our Project Managers move between them:

  • Guided onboarding for our commercial customers: you run configuration days for several customers at once, guide them while they configure, and answer the questions that come up.

  • Leading yourself on enterprise customers: you own the project end to end, including the sponsor meetings.

  • Alongside a Senior Project Manager on our largest programs, where you take a country, an entity or a workstream and own it.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

For the Project Manager level

  • Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 2+ years of experience in consulting, technical implementation, process automation, or project management.

  • The ability to run several projects at once without losing control of any of them.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at .

Who we are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost and Network Solutions. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.


Our company is the leading destination for the simplest, yet most powerful solutions for websites and web services. We offer do-it-yourself and professional website design, website hosting, e-commerce, web marketing and e-mail. The Account Services team is responsible for completing customer interviews to capture quality business information needed to fulfill our Professional Service products and making outbound calls to review and ensure satisfaction of the final product delivered.


What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark.

  • Must be available for all shifts (Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM), including holidays.
  • Communicate with customers via inbound, outbound calls and e-mail.
  • Effectively capture accurate and detailed business information, meeting our quality expectations, in order to build their Professional Website or Online Marketing Campaign.
  • Manage a book of accounts during the onboarding process providing a seamless customer experience.
  • Must be able to multi-task and work well in a fast paced environment.
  • Apply and understand new technical material quickly.
  • Promote the benefits of newly established services to reduce early-life churn and increase customer satisfaction.
  • Make text and image changes to Web.com Websites via web-based design tools and provide customers with suggestions for improvement using knowledge of industry best practices.
  • Openly accepts and incorporates qualitative feedback.
  • Participates in cross-functional team meetings to improve processes.
  • Identify and cross-sell additional professional service offerings based on customer needs.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed.

  • Basic understanding of Excel, Microsoft Word, and Outlook.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to type 40 words per minute (WPM).
  • Detail-oriented, problem solver, and dynamic.
  • Dedicated, organized, and team oriented.
  • Strong conflict resolution, critical thinking and trouble-shooting skills.
  • High school (or equivalent) is required.
  • College/University degree with 2-3 years professional experience, a plus.
  • Web design experience with templated platforms, such as WordPress (preferred)
  • Customer facing experience, required

Why you’ll love us.

  • Work-life balance. Our work is thrilling and meaningful, but we know balance is key to living well.
  • We celebrate one another’s differences. We’re proud of our culture of diversity and inclusion. We foster a culture of belonging. Our company and customers benefit when employees bring their authentic selves to work. We have programs that bring us together on important issues and provide learning and development opportunities for all employees. We have 20 + affinity groups where you can network and connect with Newfolders globally.
  • We care about you. We provide excellent Health Insurance options to fit you, HSA, Medical, Dental, Vision, Matching 401K, Life/AD&D/STD/LTD, Tuition Reimbursement, Pet Insurance, Generous vacation policy, and much more!
  • Where can we take you? We’re fans of helping our employees learn different aspects of the business, be challenged with new tasks, be mentored, and grow their careers. Unfold new possibilities with #teamnewfold!

raw.description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!
Citizens Against Government Waste (CAGW) offers a wide variety of opportunities to college students across the country. Unpaid research, communications, and government affairs internships are available on a year-round basis and can vary in length from a semester to a few weeks in duration. Interns can choose to work part-time or full-time, as hours of work are extremely flexible. Our daily work with Capitol Hill and the White House, as well as government agencies and other nonprofit organizations, provides a close and invaluable look at how Washington works. Since CAGW maintains a small staff, interns gain hands-on experience in all aspects of CAGW’s activities. Many projects involve working closely with staff members, while others require a great deal of independence. Interns are considered important members of our staff and actively participate in staff meetings and other events. While interns will also be required to perform clerical duties from time to time, much of the work will be substantive.

Research Internship

Assist in formulating policy papers and collect data for original investigative studies. Research and write for CAGW’s annual publications, which include the Congressional Pig Book, Prime Cuts, Government WasteWatch eNews, and special projects, including issue briefs, and policy papers. Interns will have the opportunity to initiate projects. Research internships are also available in specific areas, including healthcare and science, technology and telecommunications, federal regulations and taxation.
Stand Together Fellowships believes that diversity in experiences, perspectives, knowledge and ideas fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success. Our admissions office treats all program participants and applicants with honesty, dignity, respect and sensitivity. We welcome all qualified applicants regardless of color, race, religion, religious creed, sex, gender or gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, ethnicity, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy (including medical needs which may arise from pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), military and veteran status, genetic information, marital or familial status, political affiliation, or any other legally recognized protected basis under federal, state or local laws, regulations or ordinances.

raw.title: Lead Engineer - Stock Trading App
raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Job Title:

Lead Technical Analyst - Real Estate Applications (Yardi)

Company:

Prologis

A day in the life

As the Lead Technical Analyst – Real Estate Applications (Yardi), you will partner with business and IT teams to design, develop, integrate, and support technology solutions across Prologis’ real estate application environment. You will provide technical leadership across platforms including Yardi Voyager, Yardi Advanced Budget, Yardi Forecast Manager, Yardi Commercial Café, and Argus Enterprise, translating complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions. The role will combine deep application and data expertise with automation, AI-assisted diagnostics, and modern development practices to improve system reliability, streamline workflows, and evolve support from a reactive to a more proactive, insight-driven model. You will collaborate with stakeholders and globally distributed technology teams to deliver solutions that support critical business processes and continuous improvement.


Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead development, integration, and ongoing technical support for Prologis’ real estate application platforms, ensuring solutions support critical business functions, project objectives, and business requirements.
  • Design and deliver technical solutions across the Yardi application ecosystem, identifying opportunities to improve processes through automation, intelligent workflows, data, and AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Lead technical activities throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, prototyping, development, testing, deployment, documentation, and production support.
  • Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications, solution designs, estimates, and executable development plans in partnership with business stakeholders and internal IT teams.
  • Design, develop, and support integrations between real estate applications and enterprise systems, including Salesforce, PeopleSoft, and custom applications.
  • Collaborate with project managers, stakeholders, developers, vendors, and globally distributed teams to coordinate development, testing, deployment, issue resolution, and delivery dependencies.
  • Lead global change and release management activities for supported applications while identifying opportunities to improve system reliability, support effectiveness, and delivery processes.

Building blocks for success


Required:

  • 5+ years of functional and technical experience with Yardi Commercial, International, and Elevate products.
  • Intermediate or greater SQL experience, including the ability to work effectively with application data and underlying data structures.
  • Experience designing, developing, and supporting integrations between enterprise applications and external systems, including Salesforce, PeopleSoft, or custom applications.
  • Experience across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, fit/gap analysis, technical design, development, testing, deployment, and support.
  • Experience delivering technology solutions with globally distributed teams, including internal teams, vendors, onshore/offshore developers, or quality assurance teams.
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple technical initiatives and deliverables with competing timelines and dependencies.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts, recommendations, risks, and solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms, model gateways, orchestration frameworks, vector search, evaluation frameworks, or AI observability.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure services, and secure software delivery practices.
  • Data engineering experience.
  • Experience with Argus Enterprise.
  • Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

Hiring Salary Range of:

$121,000 - $167,000. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

People First

Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. Individuals take the initiative here.

When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. Employees advance their careers here.

As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. And because of that, we provide a generous total rewards package and take a lot of time to focus on quality management and leadership development. People come first here.

All full-time roles in the US come with a robust benefits package which includes healthcare, dental, and vision insurance for employees and eligible dependents. Prologis also offers several other wellness, financial, and work/lifestyle-specific benefits. Our 401(k) retirement plan has a company match of 50% up to 12% of eligible compensation. We also offer generous PTO with a starting accrual of 22 days a year in addition to paid holidays and volunteer time.

All job offers are contingent upon successful completion of background verification. Prologis is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religions, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
