Job Description:

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to join our team! In this role, you will provide technical leadership for Penn Mutual’s Brokerage and RIA Technology Team, helping shape the architecture and technical direction of its platforms and systems. You will lead complex initiatives, influence technical decisions across teams, and ensure solutions align with business needs and long-term technology strategy.


While remaining hands-on in engineering and solution delivery, you will expand your impact through architecture, technical standards, reusable patterns, mentoring, and cross-team technical leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Define and drive the technical direction and architecture for Penn Mutual’s Brokerage and RIA Technology Team and its associated platforms and systems.
  • Partner with product, engineering, architecture, business, cybersecurity, and platform leaders to develop technical roadmaps aligned with business priorities and long-term technology strategy.
  • Define architecture, reference patterns, engineering standards, and reusable capabilities for AWS serverless data integration across major platforms and multiple engineering teams.
  • Architect complex solutions spanning multiple applications, services, data sources, integrations, and technology platforms.
  • Lead major cross-team technical initiatives from initial analysis and solution design through implementation and operational adoption.
  • Establish and drive adoption of technical standards, reference implementations, and reusable components that improve consistency and scalability across engineering teams.
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, ensuring significant technical decisions, trade-offs, dependencies, and risks are clearly documented.
  • Identify and address systemic technical risks, including dependencies, scalability constraints, security concerns, and operational weaknesses.
  • Resolve complex technical challenges that span systems, teams, applications, or organizational boundaries.
  • Balance near-term delivery priorities with long-term maintainability, modernization, reliability, and technical-debt reduction.
  • Influence product and technology roadmaps through technical expertise and a strong understanding of business priorities.
  • Mentor Senior Software Engineers and other engineers, helping develop technical leadership capabilities across the organization.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and lead prototypes or proofs of concept for strategically significant capabilities.
  • Communicate technical direction, architectural decisions, and recommendations to engineering teams, architects, business leaders, and other stakeholders.
  • Promote engineering excellence through automation, observability, testing, documentation, security, and operational discipline.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Nine or more years of relevant software development experience, including significant technical leadership responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering complex solutions spanning multiple systems, applications, platforms, or engineering teams.
  • Deep expertise in AWS serverless and cloud-native data architecture, including orchestration, messaging, APIs, security, networking, observability, resiliency, data governance, and infrastructure automation.
  • Deep knowledge of software architecture, design patterns, integration approaches, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and operational resilience.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages, with the ability to contribute directly to solution design, development, prototyping, and technical reviews.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and decisions across teams without relying on direct reporting authority.
  • Experience establishing and driving adoption of reusable engineering patterns, technical standards, and platform capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve cross-team technical risks, dependencies, and complex technical challenges.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to clearly explain architecture decisions, technical recommendations, and trade-offs to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor senior engineers and strengthen technical and engineering capabilities across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading architecture for cloud-native, enterprise integration, data platform, or distributed systems initiatives.
  • Experience with major cloud platforms and technologies, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, containerization, serverless computing, or managed data services.
  • Experience with architecture modeling, architecture decision records, reference architectures, and technology roadmap development.
  • Experience establishing enterprise architecture and engineering patterns using AWS services such as Glue, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, EMR, SQS/SNS, API Gateway, S3, Athena, Lake Formation, Glue Data Catalog, and DynamoDB, as well as infrastructure-as-code technologies.
  • Experience working in a regulated industry with security, audit, privacy, and data governance requirements.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud architecture, security, software engineering, data engineering, or related technical disciplines.
  • Experience with wealth management technology within a broker-dealer or Registered Investment Adviser (RIA) environment.

Substation Engineering Lead (PE)

Position Description:

Vantage Point Solutions (VPS) is seeking a Substation Engineering Lead to provide technical leadership, project oversight, and client engagement for electric utility substation projects. In this role, you will work directly with utility clients to plan, design, and oversee construction of substation solutions that align with client goals and support reliable electric service.

Projects may include new substations, substation expansions, brownfield modifications, system improvement initiatives, grant-funded projects, and multi-year capital improvement programs. You will serve as a key link between utility personnel, contractors, field crews, and engineering teams, helping move projects from concept through commissioning.

The Substation Engineering Lead is responsible for the technical direction, design oversight, and professional engineering approval of substation projects. This role provides mentorship and leadership to engineers, manages project execution, and ensures projects are completed safely, with quality, on schedule, and within budget.

Successful candidates demonstrate strong leadership, sound engineering judgment, adaptability, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering exceptional service.

Why Vantage Point Solutions?

Vantage Point Solutions was founded in 2002 on the belief that people come first. Today, VPS is a customer focused, technology-driven engineering and consulting firm serving clients in the power, broadband, and financial industries. We are committed to delivering exceptional service while fostering a culture built on teamwork, accountability, respect, innovation, and professional growth. Our employees are empowered to make meaningful contributions to our clients, communities, and industries while building rewarding careers.

Technical Leadership & Project Management:

  • Lead and manage multiple substation projects simultaneously from planning through construction and commissioning.
  • Conduct quality assurance and quality control reviews throughout all phases of project delivery.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with local, state, and federal technical, regulatory, and safety standards.
  • Conduct quality assurance and quality control reviews throughout all phases of project delivery.
  • Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, and engineering cost estimates.
  • Stay current with applicable codes, standards, industry practices, and emerging technologies.

Engineering & Design:

  • Perform system-wide planning studies and system assessments related to substation capacity, reliability, and system performance, applying best practices and the latest technologies.
  • Develop, review, and approve (PE-seal) complete substation designs, including physical layouts, electrical design, grounding systems, equipment selection, bus configurations, structural steel, protection and control systems, relay schematics, wiring diagrams, SCADA integration, and bills of material to deliver full construction drawings (IFC) and bid packages (IFB).
  • Prepare equipment specifications, material specifications, and construction requirements in accordance with client and regulatory requirements.
  • Professionally seal for-construction substation designs, protection and controls, and grounding system designs.
  • Demonstrate proficiency with industry-standard software used for the design, planning, modeling, and analysis of substations, protection systems, and control systems.
  • Support permitting, regulatory compliance, and engineering documentation efforts.
  • Develop substation protection and control settings.

Client & Field Support:

  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with clients, contractors, utility personnel, and internal team members.
  • Strengthens VPS’s reputation as a trusted partner for utilities and enterprise clients.
  • Serve as a trusted technical advisor to utility clients and assist in developing best practices, infrastructure modernization, and operational direction.
  • Provide field engineering support during construction, commissioning, outage restoration, and emergency response activities.
  • Assist clients with day-to-day engineering questions, operational challenges, and strategic planning initiatives.
  • Assist clients in meeting regulatory reporting and compliance requirements for substation systems.

Team Leadership:

  • Mentor, train, and develop engineers and technical staff.
  • Develop a high-performing engineering team capable of executing complex, multi-faceted projects.
  • Foster collaboration, accountability, and technical excellence within the Power Engineering team.
  • Support management and customer relations staff with business development initiatives.
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, and professional development efforts.
  • Implement process improvements to enhance engineering efficiency, accuracy, and client satisfaction.

Required Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or Electrical Engineering Technology (BSEET) from an ABET-accredited institution, preferably with an emphasis in Power Systems.
  • Active Professional Engineer (PE) license and ability to obtain licensure in other states through reciprocity within a reasonable timeframe.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in electric utility substation design and engineering.
  • Minimum of 2 years of engineering leadership experience with direct supervisory responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated success working with utility personnel, construction contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Strong knowledge of substation design, protection and controls, grounding systems, SCADA integration, and utility construction practices.
  • Thorough understanding of applicable engineering standards and codes, including NESC, IEEE, ANSI, and RUS requirements.
  • Working knowledge of OSHA requirements applicable to substations and the electric utility industry.
  • Broad understanding of electric utility operations, including transmission, substations, distribution systems, protection and control systems, SCADA, AMI, and OMS platforms.
  • Ability and willingness to perform field work, including walking on uneven or rough terrain, visiting active construction sites, and working in varying weather conditions.

Additional Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with clients, contractors, utility personnel, regulatory agencies, and internal team members.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound engineering judgment, and attention to detail.
  • Valid driver's license with an acceptable driving record.
  • Authorized to work in the United States.
  • Ability to successfully pass background checks, driving record reviews, drug screening requirements, and client-specific screening processes as required.

Compensation and Benefits:

VPS offers a competitive compensation package along with comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, a 401(k)-retirement plan, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and other benefits designed to support the well-being and success of our employees.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Vantage Point Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.”

Job Summary

The Director of Mobile Maintenance will lead the development, operation, and growth of a national mobile maintenance business. This leader will build a scalable service model that delivers reliable, high-quality maintenance across geographically dispersed client locations.

The role requires a strong operational background and demonstrated experience managing mobile technicians, leading distributed teams, and expanding a service business. The Director will own operational performance, financial results, workforce development, and service delivery while partnering with sales and sector leadership to identify opportunities and enter new markets.

Ability to travel regularly to support field teams, clients, and new market launches.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

  • Lead daily mobile maintenance operations across multiple markets, ensuring safe, responsive, and consistent service delivery.
  • Establish standard operating procedures for preventive maintenance, reactive repairs, emergency response, and work order completion.
  • Develop staffing models, service territories, technician schedules, and routing strategies that improve coverage, productivity, and utilization.
  • Partner with the Command Center to coordinate dispatch, work prioritization, escalation, and client communication.
  • Establish clear accountability for service quality, response times, work order documentation, and client satisfaction.
  • Oversee fleet, tools, equipment, parts inventory, and technician readiness.

Business Development and National Expansion

  • Develop and execute a national growth plan, identifying priority markets, client opportunities, and the resources needed to expand.
  • Build a repeatable model for launching new markets, including staffing, service coverage, pricing, and operational readiness.
  • Partner with sales and Compass sector teams to develop opportunities with existing clients and new customers.
  • Support site assessments, scope development, estimating, proposals, and client presentations.
  • Evaluate opportunities to transition outsourced maintenance to self-performed mobile services.
  • Ensure new business is priced appropriately and supported by a practical, profitable delivery model.

Financial Management

  • Own the mobile maintenance operating budget, forecasts, and profit and loss performance.
  • Manage labor, overtime, travel, fleet, materials, and subcontractor costs.
  • Develop pricing and cost models that support competitive services and sustainable margins.
  • Monitor account and market profitability, identify performance gaps, and implement corrective actions.
  • Balance investment in growth with financial discipline and operational capacity.

Team Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain regional leaders, operations managers, and skilled mobile technicians.
  • Establish clear roles, performance expectations, training requirements, and career paths.
  • Build a culture of safety, accountability, technical excellence, and client service.
  • Develop leadership capacity to support expansion into additional markets.

Short Description

Technology and Continuous Improvement

  • Use technology and work management systems to improve field execution, reporting, and visibility.
  • Establish performance measures for technician utilization, response times, preventive maintenance completion, first-time fix rates, repeat calls, safety, and profitability.
  • Use operational data and client feedback to improve service delivery and identify additional maintenance needs.
  • Ensure accurate asset records, service histories, and field documentation.

Qualifications

  • Significant progressive experience in facilities maintenance, field service, or a related service business, including leadership of mobile maintenance operations across multiple markets.
  • Demonstrated success developing or expanding a mobile service business, including launching markets and scaling distributed teams.
  • Strong operational knowledge of technician deployment, dispatch coordination, preventive maintenance, reactive service, and fleet management.
  • Experience owning financial performance, including budgeting, forecasting, pricing, and margin improvement.
  • Working knowledge of building systems and maintenance trades, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and general building repairs.
  • Experience using CMMS, field service management systems, and operational reporting tools.
  • Strong client relationship, communication, and team leadership skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, facilities management, engineering, or a related field preferred; equivalent operational experience will be considered.
  • Ability to travel regularly to support field teams, clients, and new market launches.

Measures of Success

  • Profitable revenue growth and successful expansion into priority markets.
  • Consistent service delivery and strong client retention.
  • Improved technician productivity, utilization, and service quality.
  • Effective hiring, development, and retention of field teams.
  • A scalable operating model that supports a national mobile maintenance business.

Senior Employment Solicitor (Consultant)

We are looking for an experienced Employment Solicitor with a minimum of 10 years’ PQE and strong contentious and non-contentious experience to join Harper James on a consultancy basis.

This is an exciting opportunity to work with a growing and diverse client base ranging from innovative start-ups to established national and international businesses.

You will advise on a wide range of employment law matters within a modern, tech-enabled law firm. As a consultant within our flexible model, you will manage your own caseload while benefiting from the support, infrastructure and collaborative culture of a forward-thinking national firm.

What you’ll be doing

You will take the lead on a broad range of contentious and non-contentious employment matters, supporting businesses with day-to-day workforce issues, strategic projects and employment disputes.

You will work closely with founders, senior leadership teams, HR teams and in-house counsel, providing clear, pragmatic advice that helps clients manage risk and achieve their commercial objectives.

Your work is likely to include advising on matters such as general day-to-day employment law support to SMEs and larger companies;

  • business restructures & redundancies (including collective);

  • overseeing discrimination and whistle-blowing cases;

  • advising on TUPE transfers, including corporate support;

  • drafting consultancy agreements and advising on status (with a good knowledge of IR35);

  • drafting and advising on director service agreements and contracts of employment;

  • managing disciplinary and grievance processes; and

  • handling senior exec severances.

As part of the wider Harper James legal team, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across Corporate, Commercial and other practice areas, particularly where employment issues intersect with transactions, business growth and organisational change.

What we’re looking for

  • A minimum of 10 years’ PQE with strong experience across both contentious and non-contentious employment law

  • Demonstrable experience advising employers on complex workforce issues and managing Employment Tribunal litigation

  • Experience advising founder-led businesses, start-ups and scale-ups would be advantageous

  • Ability to manage matters independently and deliver pragmatic, commercially focused advicel

  • Excellent client relationship and stakeholder management skills

The Harper James difference

We are a tech-driven, agile law firm where lawyers are empowered with modern legal technology to maximise efficiency, productivity and work-life balance.

Our consultant model offers experienced solicitors flexibility, autonomy and the ability to work remotely, while remaining part of a supportive national team.

At Harper James, we keep things straightforward. We are relaxed and informal but well organised. There is no politics and no big egos — if people around us succeed, so do we. We welcome proactive, self-motivated solicitors who thrive in a modern legal environment and are passionate about delivering exceptional client service.

You’ll excel as part of the HJ team if you

  • Are a quick learner, ready to adapt to new systems and technologies

  • Are interested in using AI tools to improve efficiency and productivity

  • Have a solid working knowledge of Microsoft 365 products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)

  • Can confidently navigate SharePoint to manage and collaborate on work

  • Have a keen eye for detail when drafting documents, ensuring consistency and professionalism

The bottom line

This is an opportunity to play an important part in the continued growth of the business, working alongside a great team of people who all contribute to our shared success.

We are offering a competitive consultancy rate with flexibility and autonomy as part of the Harper James consultant model.

NO AGENCIES PLEASE

This is a remote-based position. The ideal candidate will be located in either VA, SC, NC, or GA.

Success in this role requires a highly proactive, relationship-driven approach to business development with the ability to identify and develop opportunities while building trusted relationships. The Business Development Director will develop and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective members in Salesforce through direct prospecting, email campaigns, referrals, carrier and strategic partner relationships, industry events, conferences, and other market-development activities. The Business Development Director is expected to create opportunities and be the first point of contact for all FirstChoice Web lead inquiries in the Region. They will continually expand FirstChoice’s network by initiating conversations with agency owners and other key industry stakeholders.

This individual will work in close partnership with the Regional Vice President and Regional Relationship Directors to ensure the region has a coordinated team selling strategy for approval and onboarding of all new members. The Business Development Director will introduce and actively transition the relationship to the appropriate Regional Relationship Director throughout the relationship building process.

Responsibilities:

  • Attends monthly meetings to collaborate with the other Region’s Business Development Director.
  • Stays abreast of industry trends and changes incorporating “proven practices” in the development of processes, services, and quality standards.
  • Supports MarshBerry and individual branding with an active LinkedIn presence & contributing to MarshBerry and industry presentations.
  • Other special projects, tasks or duties as assigned by Management.

Selection Criteria

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Risk Management, Finance, Marketing, Sales or another related field. MBA or master’s preferred.
  • Insurance designations or licenses are a plus such as P&C license, CIC, CPCU.
  • 7-10+ years of sales experience. A minimum of 5 years within the insurance industry.
  • Proficient with technology including CRM, PowerBI, Word, Excel, Power Point. Salesforce experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated success growing a geographic territory through consultative sales, territory management, strategic planning, relationship management, recruiting, and business development.
  • Existing relationships within the independent agency and carrier community are strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with associations and carrier partners with an in-depth knowledge of insurance carrier reporting.
  • Self-motivated with excellent organization and time management skills.
  • Strong networking, negotiation, presentation, & communication skills with demonstrated ability to develop executive-level relationships & influence decision makers.
  • Self-directed, disciplined, and comfortable operating with significant autonomy and accountability for results.
  • Experience presenting and writing content to be published is a plus.
  • Ability to travel 30-40% of the time; includes overnight and weekend travel.
  • Ability to work flexible and/or extended hours as needed.

Other:

  • Confidentiality: Always maintains confidentiality with proprietary information as well as all internal and external communications.
  • Team-oriented: Positive and professional, able to show consideration for and maintain good working relations with coworkers; remains opens to others’ ideas and exhibits a willingness to try new things.
  • Ability to multitask: Able to complete projects and responsibilities accurately according to required timelines and deadlines; possesses the capacity to work under pressure; demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness and monitors work to ensure quality.
  • Self-motivated: Innovative self-starter with the ability to prioritize and make appropriate decisions with little guidance or instruction.
  • Confident: Poised and acts in a confident manner to facilitate completion of a work assignment or to defend a position or idea.
  • Open to feedback: Follows instructions, responds to management directions, and solicits feedback to improve performance.
  • High ethics: Displays strong moral and ethical fortitude, prescribing to the values, standards, and policies of MarshBerry.

Working at MarshBerry

raw.description:
About Teton

Teton is building the foundational data layer for the point of care, using real-time, multimodal AI to generate a digital twin of the patient and care environment. Our proprietary computer-vision system enables staff to automate documentation, proactively manage resident care, and streamline workflows. Our platform delivers unprecedented access to real-time data insights, empowering healthcare providers with actionable intelligence to enhance decision-making and elevate care delivery.

The Role

We're hiring a Product Manager who will own product initiatives end-to-end — from discovery through launch — for a product used every day by caregivers, nurses, and operators in senior living communities across the country. You will report to the Director of Product Management, within the Product and Engineering organization.

This role is built around proximity to the US senior living market. You'll spend meaningful time on-site with customers — observing workflows, sitting with staff, and pressure-testing our product against the realities of care delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead product initiatives from idea to launch — discovery, scoping, prioritization, and shipping with design and engineering

  • Define success metrics for your area and own the outcomes

  • Bring clarity and structure to ambiguous problem spaces; make tradeoffs grounded in customer reality, not internal opinion

  • Spend meaningful time on-site with US customers — senior living operators, care staff, and clinical leadership — and translate field observations into concrete product decisions

  • Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to land features in market — shape positioning, enablement materials, and launch narratives so what we ship actually gets adopted

  • Run beta and adoption programs — recruit pilot customers, structure feedback loops, and drive feature uptake in the field

  • Build deep technical fluency in our computer-vision and AI stack — enough to scope feasibly, push back on engineering, and make the right build calls

  • Communicate clearly across teams, time zones, and the Copenhagen and US teams

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally on B2B software

  • Track record of owning a product area end-to-end and shipping outcomes (not just features) — comfortable being the most senior PM in the room with customers and partners

  • Experience at a fast-moving growth-stage startup. You're comfortable with ambiguity, fast cycles, and owning outcomes without a playbook

  • Strong product thinking — discovery, prioritization, scoping, shipping

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Comfort spending significant time in the field — this is not a desk job

  • Ability to develop deep technical understanding of complex products (AI systems, data pipelines, or hardware-software systems)

  • Structured thinking and strong problem-solving ability

  • Based in the US, with the availability to travel domestically for customer visits

Nice to Have

  • Experience in healthcare, senior living, or another regulated, high-stakes industry

  • Experience with AI, computer vision, or data-heavy products

  • Experience working closely with sales and customer-facing teams

  • Experience operating in a distributed product org (especially across US and Europe)

Location & Travel

  • Our US office is in Boulder, Colorado. If you're based there or open to relocating, we'd love that.

  • We're equally open to remote candidates across the US. Strong people come from everywhere, and we'd rather meet you than filter you out on location.

  • Required travel across the US to customer sites.

  • Occasional travel to our headquarters in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Why Join Teton

  • Competitive Salary and participation in our warrant program.

  • Work with state-of-the-art technology in a pioneering field.

  • A vibrant, learning-focused work environment.

  • A role where you can make a significant impact on care delivery.

What It's Like Working at Teton

We're a growing team of extremely hard-working and talented people. The learning curves are steep, and expanding your skill set is not just encouraged — it's expected. It's a hands-on environment where you'll be challenged, supported, and constantly learning.

We are looking for people who believe in our long-term vision and value ownership and entrepreneurship rather than just another 9-5 job. With us you will have an opportunity to truly make an impact on the world with the outcomes of your work. So, if you are looking for a ride and not just a job – jump on board 😊

raw.description:
Content Writer – SEO, Blog Writing & Marketing Content | Remote

Position Type: Remote
Department: Marketing / Content Creation
Function: Content Writing / SEO / Digital Marketing

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a talented and detail-oriented Content Writer to create engaging, well-researched, and SEO-optimized content that supports its marketing initiatives.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys researching new topics, translating complex information into clear and compelling writing, and producing high-quality content across multiple formats.

You’ll be responsible for developing blog posts, website copy, case studies, and marketing collateral while ensuring every piece aligns with the client’s brand voice, positioning, and marketing objectives.

The ideal candidate combines strong writing skills, SEO knowledge, research capabilities, and editorial judgment with the ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with a remote marketing team.

What You’ll Own

Content Writing & Creation

  • Write clear, engaging, and well-researched content for the client’s marketing initiatives.
  • Develop content across multiple formats, including:
    • SEO blog posts and articles
    • Website and landing page copy
    • Case studies
    • Marketing collateral
    • Campaign-related content
  • Translate complex industry topics into accessible, compelling content.
  • Adapt writing style and tone to different audiences and marketing objectives.
  • Ensure content accurately reflects the client’s positioning and messaging.
  • Deliver polished drafts that meet established quality standards.

Research & Content Ideation

  • Research industry trends, relevant topics, and audience interests.
  • Analyze competitor content to identify opportunities and content gaps.
  • Generate relevant content ideas aligned with marketing goals.
  • Gather accurate information from credible sources.
  • Develop content angles that resonate with target audiences.
  • Quickly understand unfamiliar subjects and turn research into useful content.
  • Support the marketing team with content ideas for campaigns and initiatives.

SEO Content Writing & Optimization

  • Apply on-page SEO best practices to written content.
  • Integrate relevant keywords naturally without compromising readability.
  • Develop SEO-friendly titles, headings, and subheadings.
  • Write compelling meta descriptions.
  • Structure articles for readability and organic search visibility.
  • Ensure content aligns with relevant search intent.
  • Balance SEO requirements with strong editorial quality and audience value.

Editing & Editorial Consistency

  • Review and refine drafts for clarity, accuracy, grammar, and readability.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing content.
  • Follow established editorial guidelines and content standards.
  • Ensure content is logically structured and easy to understand.
  • Incorporate feedback from the marketing team.
  • Identify and correct issues before content is submitted for publication.
  • Maintain high editorial standards across all deliverables.

Marketing Team Collaboration

  • Collaborate with the marketing team on content priorities and deadlines.
  • Support marketing campaigns and product launches with written content.
  • Review content briefs and clarify requirements before starting assignments.
  • Deliver drafts and revisions according to agreed timelines.
  • Communicate progress and potential blockers proactively.
  • Participate in occasional team check-ins to align on priorities.
  • Work efficiently through shared documents and remote collaboration tools.

Requirements

  • Proven professional experience as a Content Writer, SEO Content Writer, Marketing Content Writer, Copywriter, or similar role.
  • Previous writing experience in a marketing, agency, or professional business environment.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating writing quality, versatility, and consistency.
  • Excellent written English, including grammar, punctuation, sentence structure, and clarity.
  • Ability to adapt tone and writing style for different audiences and content formats.
  • Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and on-page optimization.
  • Experience writing blog posts, website copy, or other marketing content.
  • Strong research skills and ability to understand unfamiliar topics quickly.
  • Ability to produce accurate, readable content with minimal supervision.
  • Strong editing and proofreading capabilities.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to manage deadlines and incorporate feedback efficiently.
  • Strong written communication and remote collaboration skills.
  • Comfortable using digital tools for communication, document sharing, and feedback.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience writing SEO-focused blog posts and website content.
  • Experience developing B2B marketing content.
  • Familiarity with content marketing and digital marketing campaigns.
  • Experience researching technical or complex industry topics.
  • Experience writing case studies and marketing collateral.
  • Understanding of keyword research and search intent.
  • Familiarity with editorial guidelines and brand voice development.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed marketing teams.

Tools & Skills

SEO Writing | Content Research | Blog Writing | Website Copywriting | Case Study Writing | Keyword Integration | Meta Descriptions | Content Editing | Proofreading | Digital Collaboration Tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Enjoy researching unfamiliar topics and turning them into compelling content.
  • Can explain complex ideas in clear, accessible language.
  • Understand how to balance SEO requirements with engaging writing.
  • Take ownership of assignments and deadlines.
  • Communicate proactively rather than waiting for follow-ups.
  • Ask thoughtful questions before beginning a project.
  • Can independently identify weaknesses in a draft and improve them.
  • Pay close attention to grammar, structure, accuracy, and tone.
  • Incorporate editorial feedback professionally and efficiently.
  • Maintain consistent writing quality across different content formats.
  • Are comfortable working asynchronously with a remote marketing team.
  • Take pride in producing content that is genuinely useful to readers.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may begin by reviewing a content brief for an upcoming blog post, researching the topic, and outlining the article.

You’ll then develop a clear, engaging draft that incorporates relevant SEO keywords, appropriate headings, and accurate supporting information.

Later, you might revise an existing article based on feedback, update website copy, or develop ideas for an upcoming marketing campaign.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate with the marketing team through shared documents and written communication, ensuring deliverables remain on schedule.

Most work will be asynchronous, with occasional check-ins to align on priorities and deadlines.

In short: You’ll research, write, edit, and optimize content that strengthens the client’s marketing efforts and communicates its value to the right audiences.

Key Metrics for Success

Content Quality

  • Clarity, accuracy, and readability of written content
  • Consistency with brand voice and editorial guidelines
  • Quality of research and supporting information
  • Number of revisions required before approval

SEO & Content Optimization

  • Effective keyword integration
  • SEO-friendly content structure
  • Quality of titles, headings, and meta descriptions
  • Alignment with relevant search intent
  • Organic search visibility of published content

Productivity & Collaboration

  • Timely delivery of assigned content
  • Ability to manage multiple writing assignments
  • Responsiveness to feedback
  • Proactive communication with the marketing team
  • Consistency of content output
  • Ability to work independently

Why This Role Stands Out

This opportunity allows you to contribute directly to a client’s marketing and content initiatives while developing content across multiple formats.

You’ll have the opportunity to:

  • Create engaging blog posts, website copy, and case studies.
  • Research new topics and develop relevant content ideas.
  • Apply SEO best practices to improve content visibility.
  • Collaborate with a marketing team on campaigns and launches.
  • Strengthen your experience in professional and B2B content writing.
  • Take ownership of content quality and execution.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys combining research, storytelling, SEO, and editorial precision.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application & Portfolio Review
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Screening
  4. Client Interview
  5. Final Selection & Onboarding

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re an experienced Content Writer, SEO Writer, Copywriter, or Marketing Content Specialist with strong research skills, excellent written English, and a portfolio demonstrating high-quality content, we’d love to hear from you.

Join a growing marketing team and help create engaging, informative, and search-optimized content that supports brand visibility and business growth.

Candidates with strong writing portfolios and experience producing SEO-focused marketing content are encouraged to apply.

Mit unserem Wachstum bauen wir unsere Teams gezielt und nachhaltig aus und suchen Persönlichkeiten, die Verantwortung übernehmen, mitdenken und mit uns die Zukunft gestalten.

Dein neuer Traumjob

  • Du machst den Unterschied: Mit deiner Leistung trägst du direkt zur Umsatzsteigerung von Digistore24 und unseren VIP Kunden bei. Du befähigst Online-Unternehmer, ihre Infoprodukte mit unserer Software Millionen von Menschen zugänglich zu machen, und förderst so aktiv die Digitalisierung kleiner und mittlerer Unternehmen.
  • Langfristige Direkt-Kundenbetreuung: Du betreust einen festen Kundenstamm, baust langfristige Beziehungen auf und führst mit jedem deiner Kunden regelmäßig Business-Reviews sowie Calls zur Leistungssteigerung.
  • Expertenstatus: Nach einer gründlichen Einarbeitungsphase bist du Spezialist für Online-Marketing und Software-Anwendungen. Du beantwortest eigenverantwortlich Fragen rund um unsere Features und deren Anwendungsgebiete ‒ schriftlich und telefonisch.
  • Wachstumschancen erkennst du sofort und berätst deine Kunden proaktiv zu unseren Features, um ihre Verkäufe zu steigern. Auf Basis von Sales-Trend-, Funnel- und Performance-Analysen gibst du Empfehlungen zur Optimierung ihres Business.
  • Alles im Blick: Dank regelmäßigem Monitoring registrierst du mögliche Umsatzrückgänge sofort, analysierst Hintergründe und findest Maßnahmen zur Lösung. Die Betreuung von Bug-Reports und Feature-Requests gehören ebenfalls in deinen Verantwortungsbereich.
  • Repräsentiere Digistore24: Ob bei internationalen VIP-Kunden-Events, einem Business-Lunch oder auf Messen ‒ du verstehst es, Kundenbeziehungen auch face to face zu pflegen.

PS: Es handelt sich hierbei nicht um eine Vertriebsstelle

Unsere Werte

Bitte schau dir die WIRKLICH genau an. Bist du bereit diese zu leben?

Stellenanforderungen

Das sind deine Superkräfte

  • Starkes Auftreten: Du hast einen gefestigten Charakter, Spaß an Verantwortung und bist selbstsicher im Umgang mit Menschen aller Hierarchieebenen ‒ auch in Verhandlungssituationen.
  • Kommunikationsgeschick: Du kommunizierst präzise und empfängerfreundlich. Potenzielle Konflikte entschärfst du durch Feingefühl und Lösungsorientierung. Gegenüber Kunden und deinem Team triffst du ‒ auch unter Zeitdruck ‒ stets den richtigen Ton and you can seamlessly switch to English if necessary.
  • Account Management: Du besitzt mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im Account Management und hast mindestens ein Jahr in einem technischen Umfeld gearbeitet. Komplexe Sachverhalte vermittelst du schriftlich wie mündlich versiert. Nice to have sind Grundkenntnisse in HTML, CSS sowie Erfahrung im Online-Marketing.
  • Organisationstalent: Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und kannst eigenverantwortlich Prioritäten setzen. Dank deiner ausgezeichneten Planung behältst du auch in Stresssituationen stets den Überblick und arbeitest im Homeoffice oder in Coworking-Spaces effektiv.
  • Hohe Motivation: Unsere Branche entwickelt sich ständig weiter. Um deine Kunden als Experte optimal zu beraten, verfolgst du daher laufend aktuelle Trends und hast Spaß daran, dich immer wieder eigenverantwortlich in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.

Dieser Job ist NICHT für dich geeignet, wenn du

  • … weniger als 2 Jahre Berufserfahrungim Account Management hast.
  • … dich schwertust mit der Planung und Priorisierung deiner Aufgaben.
  • … keinen Spaß daran hast, (technische) Probleme im Detail zu analysieren und zu lösen.
  • … lieber ausschließlich schriftlich mit Kunden kommunizierst statt (auch) telefonisch.
  • … lieber an kurzweiligen Kundenanfragen arbeitest, als Kundenlangfristig und mit Fokus auf Portfolio-Wachstum zu betreuen.
  • … nicht den Anspruch hast, dein Expertenwissen laufend auszubauen oder.
  • ... dich nicht mit unseren identifizierst
  • ...nicht fließend Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. B2) in Wort und Schrift beherrschst (beide Sprachen sind Voraussetzung für diese Rolle).

Deine Benefits bei Digistore24

Bei Digistore24 sind wir überzeugt: Großartige Menschen leisten ihre beste Arbeit, wenn sie echte Autonomie, klare Ziele und ein unterstützendes Umfeld haben. Das erwartet dich bei uns:

  • 100 % Remote: Arbeite dauerhaft von zu Hause aus. Alles, was du brauchst, ist eine stabile Internetverbindung.
  • Du bist permanent außerhalb Deutschlands ansässig? Auch das ist in Festanstellung in vielen europäischen Ländern möglich.
  • Arbeite bis zu 170 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland (weitere Länder nach Absprache ggf. möglich).
  • Nutze bis zu 3 Tage pro Woche die Coworking-Spaces unseres Partners.
  • 30 Urlaubstage auf Vollzeitbasis.
  • Klare Strukturen: Arbeiteim Gleitzeitmodell und in Absprache mit deinem Team.
  • Keine starren Entwicklungspläne: Deine Weiterentwicklung richtet sich individuell nach deinen Stärken. On the job setzt du dich mit modernen und relevanten Themen auseinander.
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege: Die Stabilität eines extrem erfolgreichen deutschen Hightech-Unternehmens, das sich seinen Start-Up-Spirit über die Jahre bewahrt hat.
  • Unsere Founder sind Teil unseres Teams: wir agieren ohne externe Investoren aus eigener Kraft und reinvestieren alles, was wir erwirtschaften.
  • Selbstbestimmte, ergebnisorientierte Teams: Arbeite in einer Unternehmenskultur, die auf Eigenverantwortung, Autonomie und direktes Feedback setzt, statt auf Micromanagement.
  • Du erhältst von uns modernes Equipment für deine Arbeit.
  • Internationale, kollaborative Kultur: Arbeite mit einem internationalen Team aus engagierten, klugen Köpfen zusammen.
  • Team Lunches mit Lieferando-Guthaben.
  • Echte menschliche Verbindung: Erlebe spektakuläre Team-Events in ganz Europa und baue Beziehungen auf, die über Bildschirme hinausgehen.
  • Ownership vom ersten Tag an: Bei uns bist du kein Rädchen im System, sondern ein wichtiger Teil eines A-Player-Teams und wirst von der Teamleitung persönlich gefördert (und gechallenged!), unter anderem in monatlichen One-on-One-Gesprächen. .
  • Arbeite in deinem Team per du, ohne Dresscode und auf Augenhöhe.

So sieht dein typischer Tag aus

  • Struktur ist alles: Zum Start screenst du alle Nachrichten. Auf dieser Grundlage priorisierst und planst du deine heutigen Aufgaben.
  • High-Prio-Tasks zuerst: Einer deiner Kunden hat dich gebeten, seinen Funnel zu optimieren. Du analysierst alle Parts, von der Verkaufsseite bis zur Bestellbestätigungsseite. Dank deiner Kenntnisse aus Schulungen sowie der detaillierten Checkliste siehst du das Verbesserungspotenzial. Zur Sicherheit besprichst du dich kurz mit deinem Team, damit sie ihre Erfahrungen beitragen können. Anschließend stimmst du dich mit dem Kunden zu deinen Empfehlungen ab.
  • Nun sind deine Messenger dran. Technische Fragen zu APIs, Upsell-Flows und Split-Tests beantwortest du im Handumdrehen – solche Grundlagen hast du bereits im Onboarding gelernt.
  • Jetzt steht ein virtueller Kaffee-Call an: Die nächsten 15 Minuten sind für einen entspannten Austausch beim Kaffee mit einer Teamkollegin reserviert.
  • Dich schreibt spontan ein VIP-Kunde an und bittet dich um Unterstützung bei einem technischen Problem, das dir neu ist. Du überlegst dir Lösungsvorschläge und postest diese im Team-Chat. Deine Kollegin meldet sich prompt mit Feedback. Gut zu wissen, dass dein Team dir Rückendeckung gibt 🙂
  • In deiner Mittagspause triffst du Freunde bei deinem Lieblings-Italiener um die Ecke. Diese Freiheit kannst du dir nehmen, weil du remote arbeitest, und die Pause natürlich frei gestalten kannst.
  • Mit frischem Kopf zurück steht ein Business-Review-Call an. Du bist super vorbereitet, denn du hast am Vortag den Funnel des Kunden analysiert und dir dazu Notizen gemacht. Nun hörst du dem Kunden zu, um mehr über seine Business-Ziele zu erfahren und ihn entsprechend zu unterstützen.
  • Zeit für den Check-In Call mit einer Kundin: Dir ist aufgefallen, dass sie ein verkaufsförderndes Digistore24-Feature noch nicht nutzt. Du berätst sie zu ihrem Umsatzwachstum-Potenzial und hilfst ihr beim Set-up. Dafür folgt ihr dem Prozess in unserer Wissensdatenbank – easy!
  • Als nächstes rufst du einer VIP-Kundin an, eine Ärztin, die Health-Coachings anbietet, sie hat morgen einen großen Launch, doch für ihren Kurs von der Produktgenehmigung ein Änderungswunsch gemeldet. Obwohl die Coaching-Szene umstritten ist, kennst du deine Kunden persönlich und weißt, dass wir dank deiner Kolleginnen in der Produktprüfung ausschließlich seriöse Angebote auf unserer Plattform haben. Du prüfst den Freigabeprozess. Der Grund ist schnell klar: Die Preise auf der Produktseite und im Bestellformular stimmen nicht überein. Nach der Anpassung informierst du das Produktgenehmigungsteam. Das Produkt geht online, deine Kundin ist dankbar, und Tausende von Menschen kommen ihren Gesundheitszielen näher.
  • It's time to grow: Demnächst steht ein internationales Kunden-Event an, bei dem du aus deiner Komfortzone gelockt wirst. Du wirst unsere VIP-Kunden live begleiten. Herzklopfen? Keine Sorge! Du wirst glänzen, denn du nimmst du dir eh täglich 10 Minuten Zeit, um die Historie deiner Kunden zu kennen und ihre aktuellen Projekte auf Social Media zu verfolgen. Eine “echte Verbindung” zu deinen Kunden ist dir schließlich sehr wichtig.
  • Heute steht außerdem noch ein AI-Workshop an. Ein AI-Consultant erklärt die Nutzung eines Tools, das Kundengespräche aufzeichnet und Action-Items zusammengefasst. So bleibst du bei unson top der modernsten Technologie.
  • Mit einem guten Gefühl gehst du in den Feierabend: Heute hast du wieder Neues gelernt und konstruktives Feedback von Kunden und Kollegen bekommen. Es ist einfach super zu sehen, was du bewegen kannst.

raw.title: Director of Customer Programs
raw.excerpt: SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe.
raw.description:
SoSafe has the ambition to become the leading human risk management provider in Europe. Our award-winning awareness platform triggers behavioural change by providing effective and engaging training and simulations on cybersecurity and data protection. Cybercrime is costing the world >$10 trillion annually and growing by 15% p.a. - we invite you to be part of the solution!

As Director of Customer Programs, you will serve as a high-impact, hands-on strategic leader responsible for designing, scaling, and executing global customer engagement and educational initiatives. We are looking for an impact-seeker—someone driven by the scope of customer outcomes and revenue expansion.

Leading a global team of individual contributors across international markets, you will bridge the gap between high-level strategy and direct execution. You build the engine, not just run it: scaled, AI-native programs that lift GRR/NRR across the long tail without scaling headcount linearly. You will take personal ownership of defining, launching, and scaling our strategic flagship initiative: the SoSafe Education Program. You will treat this initiative as a business you’re launching: define the case, the targets, the pilots, and fine tune to what moves the needle.

Here's how you'll make a difference:

Strategic Leadership and execution

  • Develop and directly execute a strategy to drive product adoption, user engagement, and lifetime customer value across a long-tail, multi-region customer segment.

  • Take full strategic and operational ownership of the new SoSafe Education Program, defining its roadmap, curriculum strategy, and rollout execution, supported by 1 fully dedicated individual

  • Personally design and deploy program-driven retention strategies that directly impact GRR and NRR performance targets across global accounts.

Team Leadership, Coaching & Operations

  • Lead, mentor, and actively coach a multilingual, global team of individual contributors, maintaining proximity to the work and leading by example.

  • Foster a high-bar culture focused on individual accountability, coachability, data-driven decisions, and operational excellence.

  • Build scalable frameworks, workflows, and automated processes to ensure consistent program quality across global regions.

AI, Technology & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Leverage AI tools, automation technologies, and customer analytics to streamline workflows, optimize program efficiency, and scale output.

  • Partner closely with the broader Customer Success team, Marketing, Product, and Sales to eliminate friction in customer journeys and align strategic priorities.

  • Collaborate with Marketing to manage clear handoffs between community/advocacy initiatives and education programs.

  • Own program-level KPIs such as adoption, engagement and retention impact. Add experiments and a clear link from program activity to GRR/NRR movement.

What makes you a great fit:

  • Proven Leadership: 5+ years of direct leadership experience managing customer success, customer education, or customer programs teams in a SaaS environment with a demonstrated track record of success

  • Revenue Ownership: Proven experience holding accountability for or directly driving GRR and NRR metrics through scalable program execution.

  • "Doing" Manager Mindset: Strong balance of strategic vision and active execution—you enjoy getting into the details, building from scratch, and solving complex problems yourself.

  • Technological Edge: Redesign programs from first principles with AI and automation, and question what should still be manual.

  • Coachability & Resilience: High degree of self-awareness, openness to real-time feedback, and a history of working through complex challenges in fast-paced environments.

  • Written Precision & Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex strategies into clear plans of action.

Nice to Have

  • Experience scaling customer programs in a fast-growing, mid-stage SaaS environment ($75M+ ARR).

  • Experience in the Cybersecurity industry

  • Fluency in German or additional European languages

What we offer*

  • Work/Life balance: Flexible hours, 33 vacation days, and parental leave support

  • Wellbeing and financial support: Access to Open Up, Corporate Discounts, Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits

  • Connection & community: Virtual events, collaborative team activities, and opportunities for local meet-ups

  • And the list goes on: Tech equipment, referral bonuses, an individual development budget, dog-friendly HQ

*Perks and benefits listed above are for full-time employees and may vary slightly by office location. These are just a sample — you'll learn more during the interview process.

About Us

At SoSafe, we’re on a mission to make the digital world safer by addressing the human factor in cybersecurity. As one of the fastest-growing security awareness scale-ups worldwide, we leverage behavioural science and data-driven learning to empower people against cyber threats. Our Human Risk Management approach helps organisations turn their employees into their strongest line of defence.

Backed by leading VCs like Highland Europe and Global Founders Capital, we’re rapidly expanding across the globe. We’re looking for team players who want to drive meaningful change in cybersecurity, take ownership of their work, and grow with us.

If you thrive in a vibrant, purpose-driven environment that values innovation, diversity, and collaboration, then this is the place for you!

raw.description:
Remote | New Zealand | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $15–$35 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Healthcare

What if the medical knowledge and clinical skills you're developing could help improve how artificial intelligence understands complex healthcare information, evaluates medical scenarios, and delivers more accurate, reliable responses?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting medical students, residents, and advanced healthcare trainees with opportunities to contribute to the evaluation and improvement of advanced Artificial Intelligence (AI) models.

We're seeking individuals currently pursuing medical education or completing supervised clinical training in General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant pathways.

This opportunity is designed for candidates who can apply their academic knowledge, clinical training, and evidence-based reasoning to evaluate AI-generated medical information.

This is not a traditional clinical position. You will not provide direct patient care, diagnose actual patients, or make treatment decisions for real patients. Instead, you'll assess medical scenarios, evaluate clinical reasoning, identify inaccuracies, and provide structured feedback to help improve AI model performance.

Previous AI experience is not required. We're looking for candidates with a strong foundation in medical knowledge, analytical thinking, and an interest in applying their education to emerging healthcare technology.

Areas of Medical Education & Clinical Training

We're seeking qualified students and trainees in the following five areas:

1. General Practice:

Medical students in their third or fourth year, medical interns, or residents pursuing a broad foundation in general medical practice.

Ideal candidates have education or clinical exposure in:

  • General patient assessment and clinical evaluation.
  • Recognition and management principles for common medical conditions.
  • Preventive medicine and general healthcare practices.
  • Medical history review and interpretation of clinical findings.
  • Fundamental diagnostic reasoning and evidence-based medical decision-making.

2. Family Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or demonstrated interest in family medicine.

Relevant experience may include:

  • Primary care across different age groups and patient populations.
  • Evaluation of acute and chronic medical conditions.
  • Preventive care, wellness, and health screenings.
  • Differential diagnosis and general treatment planning principles.
  • Interpretation of medical histories, clinical findings, and evidence-based guidelines.

3. Internal Medicine

Third- or fourth-year medical students, medical interns, or residents with clinical training, rotations, or an interest in internal medicine.

Relevant knowledge and experience may include:

  • Adult medicine and management principles for common or complex conditions.
  • Interpretation of laboratory results and diagnostic findings.
  • Recognition of multisystem diseases and related complications.
  • Development and evaluation of differential diagnoses.
  • Evidence-based approaches to clinical assessment and medical management.

4. Nurse Practitioner (NP)

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Nurse Practitioner educational program, particularly those completing advanced coursework or supervised clinical training.

Ideal candidates have education or experience in:

  • Advanced health assessment and patient evaluation.
  • Pathophysiology, pharmacology, and clinical management principles.
  • Diagnostic reasoning and interpretation of medical findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment planning and healthcare practices.
  • Patient education, preventive care, and healthcare quality standards.

Candidates pursuing Family Nurse Practitioner (FNP) or Adult-Gerontology Primary Care Nurse Practitioner (AGPCNP) pathways are especially encouraged to apply.

5. Physician Assistant (PA) / Physician Associate

Students currently enrolled in a recognized Physician Assistant or Physician Associate program, preferably in the clinical phase of training.

Relevant educational and clinical experience may include:

  • Patient assessment, medical history review, and physical examination.
  • Clinical rotations in primary care, internal medicine, or family medicine.
  • Differential diagnosis and interpretation of diagnostic findings.
  • Evidence-based treatment and patient management principles.
  • Medical documentation and evaluation of clinical scenarios.

What You'll Do

As a Medical AI Evaluator, you'll apply your medical education and clinical training to assess how accurately AI systems interpret healthcare information and reason through medical scenarios.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate AI-Generated Medical Content: Review AI-generated healthcare information for factual accuracy, completeness, clinical relevance, and consistency with established medical knowledge and guidelines.
  • Assess Clinical Reasoning: Evaluate AI-generated assessments, differential diagnoses, and treatment-related explanations to determine whether conclusions are medically sound and supported by appropriate evidence.
  • Identify Medical Inaccuracies: Recognize factual errors, unsupported assumptions, missing clinical considerations, and potential patient safety concerns in AI-generated responses.
  • Conduct Medical Research and Verification: Validate information using credible sources, including peer-reviewed medical literature, clinical practice guidelines, and established healthcare resources.
  • Review Clinical Scenarios: Analyze hypothetical patient cases, symptoms, medical histories, laboratory findings, and diagnostic information to evaluate AI-generated interpretations.
  • Provide Evidence-Based Feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify inaccuracies, and recommend appropriate corrections supported by medical evidence and clinical standards.
  • Apply Evaluation Standards: Consistently follow project-specific scoring rubrics, annotation instructions, and quality assurance guidelines.
  • Complete Assigned Evaluations: Perform independent evaluation tasks using designated online platforms, including DataCompute, while meeting established deadlines and quality expectations.
  • Maintain Confidentiality and Professional Standards: Protect sensitive project information and comply with applicable privacy, ethical, and data security requirements.

Compensation & Project Structure

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on educational background, clinical training, relevant experience, geographic location, and assignment complexity.

This opportunity is ideal for individuals seeking to earn supplemental income while applying your professional skills and expertise to meaningful projects.

Specialty & Experience Level

General Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Family Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Internal Medicine

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$25/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$35/hr

Nurse Practitioner

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$20/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$28/hr

Physician Assistant

  • Second-year students (top medical schools only): $15–$23/hr
  • Third-year students and above: $20–$30/hr

Eligibility Requirements

  • Second-year medical students must be enrolled at a top medical school
  • Third-year students and above: open to all qualifying programs
  • Relevant specialty or study track required (see list above)

Final compensation is subject to client approval, project requirements, and geographic eligibility.

This is a freelance, task-based opportunity intended for individuals interested in applying their medical knowledge to AI evaluation projects while continuing their education or clinical training.

Assignments are distributed based on project needs and availability. Workloads may be irregular or intermittent, and specific hours or future assignments are not guaranteed.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Medical Education in a New Way

Use the medical knowledge and clinical reasoning skills gained through your coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training to contribute to advanced AI evaluation projects.

Help Improve Healthcare AI Accuracy

Your evaluations will help identify weaknesses in AI-generated medical information and support the development of more reliable and medically informed AI systems.

Explore Emerging Healthcare Technology

Gain exposure to AI evaluation, medical content assessment, and evidence-based research while expanding your experience beyond traditional clinical settings.

Work Remotely

Participate in specialized project assignments from an eligible location, with schedules and workloads based on project availability.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for candidates who can think critically, recognize accurate medical reasoning, identify errors, and explain their conclusions using credible medical evidence.

Project Details

  • Engagement Type: Project-Based Independent Contractor
  • Work Arrangement: Remote
  • Primary Location: United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand, Canada, India, and the Philippines, subject to client approval

Bring Your Medical Knowledge to the Future of AI

Whether you're completing medical school, advancing through residency, or pursuing Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant training, this is an opportunity to apply your developing clinical expertise to emerging healthcare technology.

At Volga Partners, we value candidates who demonstrate strong medical knowledge, thoughtful clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and the ability to evaluate complex information using evidence-based principles.

Join us in helping shape the next generation of healthcare AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

Candidates should possess the following qualifications:

  • Medical or Advanced Healthcare Education: Current enrollment in the third or fourth year of a recognized medical degree program, an eligible medical internship or residency, or an advanced NP or PA educational program with relevant clinical training.
  • Relevant Clinical Focus: Academic coursework, clinical rotations, or supervised training related to General Practice, Family Medicine, Internal Medicine, Nurse Practitioner practice, or Physician Assistant practice.
  • Foundational Medical Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical terminology, anatomy, physiology, pathology, pharmacology, and clinical concepts relevant to their area of training.

  • Analytical and Critical Thinking: Strong analytical reasoning, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
  • Written Communication: Excellent written English skills, with the ability to clearly explain clinical findings, document evaluations, and support conclusions with credible evidence.
  • Technical Proficiency: Comfort working with computers, web-based platforms, digital documentation, and online research tools.
  • Independent Work and Accountability: Ability to follow detailed instructions, complete assignments independently, and consistently meet established quality requirements.
  • Project-Based Availability: Willingness to participate in a remote, freelance engagement where assignments and schedules are determined by project needs.

Independent medical licensure and previous employment as a licensed physician, Nurse Practitioner, or Physician Assistant are not required for eligible student-level evaluation assignments.

Preferred Qualifications

The following experience or qualifications may strengthen a candidate's application:

  • Clinical rotations, clerkships, internships, or supervised training in general practice, family medicine, internal medicine, or primary care.
  • Enrollment in the clinical phase of an accredited or recognized medical, NP, or PA educational program.

  • Participation in medical research, literature reviews, clinical case presentations, or healthcare-related academic projects.
  • Exposure to healthcare quality assurance, medical documentation review, or clinical evaluation.
  • Interest in artificial intelligence, healthcare technology, or medical informatics.

Previous AI evaluation experience is beneficial but not required.

About the team

Zillow’s Agent Software and Advertising org is a collection of software and advertising solutions that focus on providing services to all real estate agents, teams, and brokers to facilitate a seamless shopping and transaction experience for their clients.
The team values delivering exceptional customer experiences and plays a critical role in onboarding new customers, retaining customers, establishing regular cadence and rapport, understanding customer needs, addressing customer challenges, providing best practice guidance, and driving upsell/cross-sell opportunities.

The Senior Customer Success Manager for Zillow Showcase plays a critical role in handling large, complex, and high spend accounts. This senior position takes on the responsibility of efficiently onboarding Brokerages using industry-leading implementation practices. The key focus of this role is to establish strong relationships with customers, ensure successful implementations that align with their specific expectations, and drive product adoption.

About the role

The Senior Customer Success Manager on our Enterprise team is responsible for a book of business comprising our larger, more complex customer relationships. They are expected to quickly build rapport; understand the agent’s business, goals and potential challenge; and advise our customers on best practices. This is accomplished by:


Being a Trusted Advisor

  • Serve as the day-to-day relationship lead for Showcase customers in our Enterprise segment
  • Hosting monthly Business Reviews to discuss engagement, updated customer goals and share business or product updates
  • Deliver subject matter expertise on Showcase (including media and marketing)
  • Tactfully address challenges and concerns while driving towards initial implementation
  • Proactively advise customers on best practices and recommend system and process changes that are essential for achieving customer outcomes

Driving Product Adoption

  • Champion Zillow Showcase and related products and features to agents within your client’s brokerage
  • Delivering training sessions to new users through phone/web-based or in-person interactions
  • Ensure implementation and adoption aligns with internal goals and customer goals
  • Collaborating with Sales to determine renewal strategy and identify expansion opportunities

Influencing Strategies and Tactics

  • Leverage tableau reporting, listing performance dashboard and agent rosters to demonstrate areas of opportunities for your customer
  • Supporting your clients’ goals through accountability targets
  • Influencing future lifetime value through higher product adoption, retention and overall customer health scores
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $98,000.00 - $156,600.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

This role requires focus on the success of our Showcase agent customers in a dynamic and changing real estate market. Requirements:


  • Four-year degree or equivalent experience
  • At least 5 years’ experience in a client-facing position (e.g.customer success, sales, business solutions, support)
  • Knowledge of the real estate industry preferred
  • Strong communications and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated organizational and time management skills
  • Flexibility in scheduling to meet customer needs with short turnaround
  • Ability to manage project completion with tight deadlines
  • Ability to work efficiently and effectively on project teams

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.
