Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.

About the Company

Our client is a frontier data research lab. Their thesis: models are what they eat. A large share of training compute is burned on data that's redundant, irrelevant, or harmful - so they built a platform that automatically curates petabytes of raw data into high-quality training data. It's modality-agnostic, needs no labels, and runs inside the customer's own cloud or on-prem.

The results are concrete: 7-40x faster training, performance as if trained on 10x+ more raw data, and models with less than half the parameters beating larger ones. AI labs and enterprises use it to train and adapt their own models.

Our client has raised ~$60M across Seed and Series A, led by Felicis and Amplify Partners, with Radical Ventures, Microsoft, and Amazon. Angels include Geoff Hinton, Yann LeCun, and Jeff Dean. The team is growing fast on the back of a strong enterprise pipeline.

The Mission

Every company should own its intelligence. Our client wants every AI team - not just the frontier labs - to have frontier-quality training data and full control over the cost and roadmap of their own models.

The Opportunity

Our client is hiring an AI Developer Experience & Media Lead to build its media and developer experience function from zero. You'll be the voice of the company on X and beyond, turning real research into threads, demos, videos, and launches that technical people actually want to read and share.

You'll sit on the marketing team and work directly with the co-founder on content strategy and execution, with direct access to the researchers and engineers doing the work. No legacy playbook, no layers of approval - and an AI community that's already paying attention.

What You'll Do

  • Turn research and product work into technical storytelling - threads, demos, videos, and launches

  • Run the company's voice on X day-to-day: posting, replying, quote-posting, and joining live conversations in real time

  • Help founders and researchers show up in their own voices - draft for them and enable their social presence

  • Own research launches end to end across X, the technical blog, and video - angle, assets, sequencing, follow-through

  • Build real relationships with researchers, open-source developers, AI creators, and technical founders

  • Bring community feedback back to product and research to shape what gets built and communicated next

  • Experiment across formats and channels, track what earns attention and trust, and let the data steer strategy

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • An active personal X account with 1,000+ followers and a technical audience

  • Experience creating social content that explains technical concepts

  • You build your own technical demos - code, notebooks, and video

  • Strong short-form technical writing - threads, posts, blogs

  • 2-7 years in technical content, developer marketing, or DevRel in AI/ML

Nice-to-haves

  • CS, ML, or other technical degree (or equivalent self-taught depth)

  • Experience at an AI model or infrastructure company

Key Success Drivers

  • X-native: you're already in the AI conversation and know what earns respect from researchers and engineers

  • Technically credible: you can read a paper, build a demo, and explain it without losing the substance

  • Ownership: you ship without waiting for a brief and take on the unglamorous work

  • Experimental: you test formats, read the data, and double down on what works

  • Focused: you prioritize ruthlessly when everything looks important

  • Collaborative and candid: you work closely with founders and researchers and give honest feedback with respect

  • At home in a fast, flat, in-person startup

Why Join?

  • Real material: research with measurable, dramatic results - you'll never have to fake the story

  • Greenfield ownership of the whole function, working directly with the co-founder

  • Built-in credibility: backed by Felicis, Amplify, Radical, Microsoft, Amazon, Hinton, LeCun, and Dean

  • Early equity at an inflection point, when brand and community compound most

  • $160K-$230K base + significant equity

  • 100% covered medical, dental, and vision; 401(k) with 4% match; unlimited PTO

  • $2K wellness and $1K learning stipends; daily lunches; relocation assistance; open to visa transfers

Interviewing Process

1. First chat with the Hiring Manager (30 min)

2. Head of Marketing interview (45 min)

3. Take-home content exercise (1 hr)

4. Founder conversation (30 min)

5. On-site team meet (1 hr)

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $160K - $230K

The Regional Sales Manager / Minka, is responsible for driving revenue growth across a defined territory by developing key accounts and leading independent sales agencies. This role focuses on expanding market share within Ferguson Enterprise, lighting showrooms, builders, electrical distributors and projects, while ensuring strong brand presence and execution in the region!


This is a Remote role covering the Northeast quadrant of the US, from the Great Lakes to the Northeast Regions of the US. It is expected that you live in that Region, preferably near a decent sized airport to allow travel within that Region.

Revenue Growth & Sales Execution

Project & Specification Management

  • Collaborate with agencies and internal teams to ensure timely follow-up on project opportunities
  • Support value engineering and product selection to meet project requirements and budgets

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Provide various sales and management reports as required
  • Assist customer service in providing information, post-sales support, and technical expertise to customers and representatives

Senior Data Engineer – Snowflake & dbt | Remoto México y LATAM

En DaCodes buscamos un/a Ingeniero/a de Datos Senior para construir una plataforma en Snowflake que transforme información de distintos sistemas en datos confiables para negocio y soluciones de inteligencia artificial.

Si disfrutas construir pipelines, resolver diferencias entre fuentes y asegurar que los indicadores sean correctos, esta oportunidad puede interesarte.

Modalidad: Remoto · Tiempo completo
Ubicación: México y Latinoamérica
Idioma de trabajo: Español
Inglés: Intermedio, con comprensión de documentación técnica

Requirements

El proyecto

Construirás un almacén de datos en Snowflake integrando bases de datos, APIs y archivos. Tendrás responsabilidad sobre la extracción, transformación, modelado, calidad, seguridad y operación de la capa de datos.

Trabajarás con usuarios de negocio y un ingeniero de IA para que los agentes consulten información con métricas claras, cifras verificables y permisos de acceso adecuados.

Qué harás

  • Desarrollar pipelines desde SQL Server, SAP ASE/Sybase, APIs REST y archivos, utilizando conexiones ODBC y un patrón de conectores basado en Openflow.
  • Conservar los datos originales y sus marcas de extracción para permitir reprocesos sin consultar nuevamente las fuentes.
  • Construir capas Bronze, Silver y Gold, modelos dimensionales y mecanismos de historización.
  • Desarrollar transformaciones con dbt, incluyendo modelos incrementales, pruebas y documentación.
  • Homologar catálogos e identificadores entre sistemas mediante equivalencias versionadas y controles de cobertura.
  • Implementar reglas de calidad, cuarentena y conciliación contra fuentes y reportes de negocio.
  • Orquestar cargas nocturnas, monitorear ejecuciones y resolver fallas.
  • Administrar permisos y políticas de acceso en Snowflake, además de controlar rendimiento y consumo de créditos.
  • Colaborar en modelos semánticos, consultas verificadas y pruebas de exactitud para el consumo por agentes de IA.
  • Documentar linaje, operación y procedimientos de recuperación para transferir la solución al equipo del cliente.

Qué necesitamos

Experiencia en ingeniería de datos

  • Al menos cinco años construyendo almacenes de datos en producción y dos años trabajando con Snowflake.
  • SQL avanzado y experiencia investigando esquemas y reglas de sistemas con poca documentación.
  • Modelado dimensional: esquemas estrella, dimensiones conformadas e historización.
  • Trabajo directo con negocio para definir métricas, homologar información y resolver diferencias entre reportes y fuentes.

Snowflake y dbt

  • Dominio de warehouses, RBAC, row access policies, masking y resource monitors.
  • Experiencia avanzada con dbt: transformaciones, pruebas declarativas, materializaciones incrementales y documentación generada.
  • Capacidad para diagnosticar problemas de rendimiento y controlar consumo de recursos.

Integración y operación

  • Experiencia extrayendo datos de SQL Server y SAP ASE/Sybase.
  • Integración de APIs REST con autenticación, renovación de tokens, paginación, límites de peticiones y reintentos.

raw.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:


Responsible for the operational functions of the Professional Coding Operations team for BUMG. Plays a strategic role in validating the accuracy of CPT, HCPCS and diagnosis code assignment by coders, physicians and non –physician practitioners. Works closely with key revenue cycle stakeholders to understand reasons for denials, root cause analysis, and feedback to providers. Supervises professional billing coding staff. Partners with Coding Education Team to identify trends in coding practices and assists with developing feedback and education to providers. Reviews coding denials to resolve and identify trends and provides feedback to providers and departments. Performs quality assurance reviews of inpatient and outpatient records to assess and report on the effectiveness of training programs and quality of coders. Provides in-service training and feedback to coding staff regularly, including coding changes and updates. Oversees coding operations to ensure organizational goals are being met. Partners with the Coding Education Team to design and implement programs on coding and clinical documentation audit and education to improve performance and efficiency. Enforces correct application of Official Coding Rules and Regulations and follows appropriate guidelines. Oversees the coding edits and denials and ensures compliance with payer guidelines. The Manager, PB Coding Operations is responsible for supporting coding related, RAC, other external coding reviews, and denials related to coding.

Boston Medical Center (BMC) is more than a hospital. It´s a network of support and care that touches the lives of hundreds of thousands of people in need each year. It is the largest and busiest provider of trauma and emergency services in New England. Emphasizing community-based care, BMC is committed to providing consistently excellent and accessible health services to all—and is the largest safety-net hospital in New England. The hospital is also the primary teaching affiliate of the nationally ranked Boston University School of Medicine (BUSM) and a founding partner of Boston HealthNet – an integrated health care delivery systems that includes many community health centers. Join BMC today and help us achieve our Vision 2030 which is a long-term goal to make Boston the healthiest urban population in the world.

Position: Manager Professional Billing Coding Operations – Remote

Department: BUMG Corporate PBO General

Schedule: Full Time

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

Primary responsibilities under the direction of the Director, PB Coding Operations:

Coding support

  • Reviews patient medical records and abstracts medical data that identifies all diagnoses and procedures. Codes diagnoses, procedures, and appropriate modifiers from the medical record documentation using ICD-10-CM, CPT4/HCPCS classification systems. Refers to a computerized encoding system, written coding aids and other reference materials to ensure accurate coding for billing.
  • Sequences diagnoses, procedures and complications by following ICD-10-CM, CPT-4, and the Uniform Hospital Discharge Data Set (UHDDS); adheres to the Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, Coding Clinic guidelines and other regulatory guidelines as appropriate. Consults with appropriate medical staff to clarify medical record information.
  • Maintains productivity standards set forth in Departmental Policies and procedures.
  • Serves as contact for professional billing coders regarding missing/incomplete information to allow for accurate billing in a timely manner.
  • Maintains knowledge of coding and professional skills, including maintaining yearly coding credentials through attendance at in-service programs, conferences, workshops, review of current literature and other educational programs.
  • Assists in orienting new personnel in department coding procedures.
  • Monitors all coding ques to ensure productivity is being kept on target.
  • Performs other duties as needed.
  • Review and respond to coding questions.
  • Ensure billed service is being accurately coded.
  • Perform random chart audits.
  • Perform analysis of benchmarking profiles.
  • Provide continual coding updates.
  • Research coding issues that arise.
  • Codes diagnoses and procedures from the medical record using ICD-10-CM and CPT-4/HCPCS classification systems.
  • Sequences diagnoses, procedures and complications by following ICD-10-CM, Medicare, Medicaid, and other fiscal intermediary guidelines.
  • Reviews charts for documentation and signature.

General

  • Responsible for the day-to-day management of the PB Coding Operations Team.
  • Duties include managing, developing and mentoring a group of certified professional coders.
  • Other responsibilities include interviewing, orientation, training and preparing evaluations; responsible for hiring, terminating and disciplining personnel as necessary.
  • Establishes staffing scheduling and assigns workloads and projects in accordance with appropriate volume increases and decreases.
  • Assists with coding all professional claims under the direction of the PB Coding Operations Team.
  • Conducts quality reviews to validate code selection is compliant with established coding guidelines.
  • Evaluates documentation for incomplete or inconsistent documentation in the record which impacts code assignment.
  • Initiates queries when necessary and monitors responses.
  • Provides training to healthcare professionals, coders, and Revenue Cycle staff in ICD, CPT, HCPCS Level II coding guidelines, proper documentation guidelines and other information related to coding.
  • Develops long term strategies for improving efficiencies and increasing coding team’s productivity through use of central coding conventions and classification systems, influencing and educating the coding team as well as all revenue cycle stake holders.
  • Reports on accuracy of coding and abstracting.
  • Responsible for the tracking and response for coding accountabilities from internal and external sources. This would include RAC coding reviews as well as other payer reviews.
  • Tracks overtime, absenteeism, hours worked, leaves and vacation/sick time for assigned staff. Reviews and approves timesheets to Payroll.
  • Maintains knowledge of ICD-10 and CPT classifications and coding of diagnoses and procedures.
  • Participates in coding and reimbursement meetings.
  • Follows established hospital infection control and safety procedures.
  • Maintains professional skills and knowledge of coding through attendance at in-service programs, conferences, workshops and other educational programs and by review of current literature. Shares knowledge and learning experiences to staff.
  • Performs other related duties as required.

JOB REQUIREMENTS


EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of formal education and experience.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

  • CPC – Certified Professional Coder

EXPERIENCE:

  • Must have at least five years of experience in coding; experience must include education/mentoring/training.
  • Minimum of five years acute care hospital experience coding with ICD-10-CM and CPT-4, academic medical setting or trauma center preferred.
  • Minimum of three years management experience required; five years preferred.
  • Prior experience working claim edits and denials.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Excellent command of the ICD-10-CM and CPT4/HCPCS coding conventions, E&M coding. Work also requires concepts of human anatomy, physiology and pathology.
  • Excellent skill in providing hands-on education to PB Coding Operations staff based on audit finding and need.
  • Strong knowledge of health records, computerized billing and charging systems, Microsoft applications, data integrity, and processing techniques required.
  • Excellent organizational skills, including ability to multi-task, prioritize essential tasks, follow-through and meet timelines.
  • Ability to work with accuracy and attention to detail
  • Ability to solve problems appropriately using job knowledge and current policies/procedures.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with members of the healthcare delivery team and staff, ability to handle frequent interruptions and adapt to changes in workload and work schedule and to respond quickly to urgent requests.
  • Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information and ensure compliance of HIPAA rules and regulations.
  • Must possess extensive knowledge of hospital inpatient and outpatient reimbursement methodologies.
  • Strong knowledge of health records, computer systems, Microsoft applications, data integrity, and processing techniques required.
  • Ability to mentor, guide and motivate direct reports through demonstration of best practices and leading by example.
  • Excellent organizational skills, including ability to multi-task, prioritize essential tasks, follow-through and meet timelines.
  • Ability to solve problems appropriately using job knowledge and current policies/procedures.
  • Ability to maintain and enforce strict confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information and ensure compliance of HIPAA rules and regulations.
  • Must possess extensive knowledge of payer claim edits and payer denials. Work requires in-depth knowledge of medical terminology, ICD-10-CM and CPT-4 Coding conventions (including E&M coding), CMS National Coverage Determinations and various other applicable coding regulations and law.

Compensation Range:

$78,000.00- $113,000.00

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensures as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), discretionary annual bonuses and merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family well-being.

NOTE: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disabled/Veterans

We do not ask or require downloads of any applications, or “apps” job offers are not extended over text messages or social media platforms. Vice President, Business Development
Position Title: Vice President, Business Development
Reports To: Chief Commercial Officer

HRforGrowth® is engaged as the talent acquisition partner to conduct this search on behalf of a client organization that is hiring for this role. HRforGrowth is not the employer for this position. HRforGrowth identifies, evaluates, and presents top-tier candidates through its global talent acquisition practice; all employment decisions — including final selection, offer terms, compensation, and conditions of employment — are made solely by the hiring organization.


Role Overview

The Vice President of Business Development (VPBD) is responsible for delivering revenue growth across our Supply Chain Strategy & Operations Consulting practice. Reporting to the Chief Commercial Officer, the VPBD is a quota-carrying, pipeline-owning role, directly accountable for hitting annual revenue targets, building and closing a qualified pipeline of mid-market, Enterprise, and high-growth venture-backed or private equity-backed companies, and converting that pipeline into signed engagements.

As the engine behind Revenue Growth, the VPBD will generate pipeline from day one, managing full sales cycles, closing deals, building long-term client relationships as a deliberate commercial strategy, creating repeat business, expanded scopes, and referrals that compound our revenue base.

Key Result Areas
1. Revenue Generation & Quota Attainment (Primary Accountability)
  • Own an annual revenue target and be directly accountable for attaining or exceeding it through new client acquisition and expanded engagements
  • Build and manage a qualified pipeline across mid-market, Enterprise, and high-growth venture-backed and private equity-backed accounts — at sufficient volume and velocity to consistently cover quota
  • Drive full-cycle deal management: prospecting, qualification, discovery, proposal, negotiation, and close
  • Sell consultative supply chain engagements spanning Strategy & Operations and the broader service portfolio
  • Convert existing relationships and net-new outreach into revenue — not just meetings, not just proposals, but closed business
  • Maintain an active, rolling pipeline with clear stage progression, documented next steps, and accurately close forecasts at all times
2. Market Penetration & Strategic Targeting
  • Identify and prioritize target accounts using a first principles understanding of supply chain problems — know what operational pain looks like for a mid-market manufacturer or a PE-backed distribution company, and use that knowledge to open doors
  • Build access to and develop relationships with economic buyers and decision-makers: CEOs, CFOs, COOs, private equity partners, and supply chain leaders
  • Develop tailored pitches, proposals, and business cases that articulate quantified value — tie the company's capabilities directly to the client's revenue, cost, and operational outcomes
  • Identify emerging market gaps, sector-specific trends, and client needs that create new commercial opportunities and act on them faster than competitors
3. Pipeline Development Through Network & Relationship Management
  • Leverage your existing network to accelerate pipeline coverage in target segments from day one
  • Establish the company as the go-to supply chain consulting partner within private equity firm networks — drive PE relationships as a pipeline multiplier, generating introductions to portfolio companies with active operational needs
  • Represent the company at industry conferences, events, and client meetings with a clear commercial objective: advance pipeline, source opportunities, and close business
  • Build long-term client relationships that produce repeat engagements, expanded scopes, and referral revenue — treating client retention and growth as a compounding commercial asset

4. Leadership & Internal Collaboration
  • Partner with delivery, operations, marketing, and service development teams to ensure proposals are accurate, delivery is set up for success, and client expectations are met from day one
  • Act as the voice of the market to GCG leadership — surface client feedback, competitive intelligence, and market signals that sharpen positioning and improve win rates
  • As the business development function scales, recruit, mentor, and develop junior BD and sales team members to expand pipeline coverage and accelerate revenue growth
5. Reporting, Forecasting & Commercial Analytics
  • Deliver accurate weekly and monthly pipeline forecasts to executive leadership, with clear visibility into deal stage, expected close, and revenue timing
  • Track and analyze key commercial metrics: lead conversion rate, pipeline coverage ratio, average deal size, sales cycle length, win/loss rate, and revenue attainment versus target
  • Use performance data to identify where deals stall or are lost, and adjust targeting, messaging, or approach to improve conversion

Required Qualifications
Experience
  • A minimum of 7 years in business development, sales, or client acquisition — a focus on supply chain consulting, logistics, or complex enterprise professional services is a plus
  • A verifiable track record of meeting or exceeding revenue quotas; be prepared to discuss specific targets, attainment figures, and deal sizes from prior roles
  • Demonstrated success closing new business with mid-market companies and/or high-growth startups — not just managing existing accounts
  • Prior experience working with or selling into private equity firms or their portfolio companies is highly desirable
Key Competencies
  • Revenue Ownership: You treat quota as a floor, not a ceiling. You have closed complex, multi-stakeholder B2B deals and can walk through exactly how you did it
  • Commercial Instinct: You know how to qualify hard, move deals forward, and walk away from deals that won't close — without losing the relationship
  • Supply Chain Fluency: You understand supply chain operations at a level that earns credibility with COOs and operations leaders — you engage on the problem, not just the pitch
  • Pipeline Discipline: You maintain a rigorous, data-backed pipeline and forecast accurately
  • Entrepreneurial Drive: You operate with urgency in ambiguous environments, build a pipeline from scratch when necessary, and treat the company's growth as your own

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience selling supply chain technology solutions (SaaS, analytics) or consulting services in a quota-carrying capacity
  • An established, activatable network within private equity or mid-market industries
  • Familiarity with startup ecosystems and their distinct supply chain challenges and buying dynamics

Education
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field required
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus

HRforGrowth is a full-service HR and talent partner built to support companies that are scaling, transforming, or navigating change. HRFG is globally recognized for delivering quality, speed, and cost-effective talent solutions across every level of the workforce. Through its global talent acquisition practice, HRforGrowth applies world class rigor and precision to identifying exceptional professional and executive talent on behalf of its clients — from temporary staffing to permanent hourly workers through to placing C-suite executives. HRforGrowth is presenting this opportunity in its capacity as the retained search partner and does not serve as the employer of record for this position.

Equal Employment Opportunity:
In its recruiting and search practices, HRforGrowth does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender, or gender identity, and welcomes applications from all qualified individuals. WHAT DOES A MEETING SUPERVISOR DO?

The Meeting Supervisor is responsible for the independent management and successful execution of live meetings and virtual events, including Advisory Meetings, Congresses, Product Launches, Speaker Trainings, Peer-to-Peer Events, Product theaters, and Webinars.

  • Being responsible for managing all program logistics, including but not limited to venue/site selection, contract negotiations, travel, food and beverage, meeting room sets, audio-visual and production, hotel rooming lists, ground transportation, and ancillary vendors (i.e., entertainment, activities, décor, photographer)

  • Being responsible for independent planning, organizing, and seamless execution of high-quality virtual event meetings with multimedia components. Including but not limited to:

  • Virtual platform configuration

  • Manage technology vendor

  • Schedule and execute rehearsals to ensure all parties are prepared for success

  • Attendee management and communication

  • Offer assistance and guidance with any attendee connection issues, as well as basic technical support during an event and to the client

  • Building and customizing registration websites and recruitment material templates with program-specific information and coordinating distribution to all attendees according to necessary timelines

  • Ensuring the highest standards of quality control of client materials and, as appropriate, developing best practices protocols for project teams to facilitate such quality control

  • Being responsible for the oversight and management of program recruitment and attendee management

  • Reviewing and approving meeting specifications from all perspectives such as attendees, vendors, etc., and offering recommendations to reduce costs

  • Providing standard and customized reports to clients at specified intervals

  • Being responsible for attending and participating in new project briefings and kick-off meetings

  • Attending multiple internal meetings with Client Services, Meeting Services, and other key personnel to discuss project status, etc

  • Working on-site at small meetings independently or leading the logistics team at large meetings to coordinate meeting logistics/activities with Client Services, venue, and vendors, and offering assistance to team members

  • Reviewing and reconciling final invoices and pass-through costs within mandated timelines

  • Tracking and preparing accurate attendee spend reports to comply with the Open Payment Guidelines

  • Maintaining ongoing dialog with the line manager and project team throughout the life of the program to evaluate progress and initiate the scope change process, if necessary

  • Negotiating the best available rates and contract terms with vendors for owned meetings such as hotel F&B, A/V, ground, etc.

  • Owning the budget (hours & OOP) on assigned meetings and advising the project team of the possible risks. Discussing with the client the challenges and recommendations for correction

  • Identifying operational change opportunities to improve program execution or increase efficiency and/or decrease costs and elevating and owning the potential plan to the management.

  • Providing input through knowledge and experience to begin to build a budget for a requested meeting

  • Maintaining and/or exceeding the minimum billable utilization percentages for the position level

  • Demonstrating a commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through continuous development, modeling inclusive behaviors, and proactively managing bias

  • All other duties as assigned

WHAT ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or 8 years in a pharmaceutical hospitality role.

  • Experience and/or Training: Planning for live, virtual, or hybrid meetings; knowledge of hotel bookings and air travel

  • Licenses/Certificates: CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) is preferred but not required

  • Technology/Equipment: Cvent or another similar registration platform required, Excel

Patient Minded I act with the patient’s best interest in mind.

Client Delight I own every client experience and its impact on results.

Take Action I am empowered and empower others to act now.

Grow Talent I own my development and invest in the development of others.

Win Together I passionately connect with anyone, anywhere, anytime to achieve results.

Communication Matters I speak up to create transparent, thoughtful and timely dialogue.

Always Innovate I am bold and creative in everything I do.

profissional proativo, orientado a resultados e com forte senso de ownership, capaz de atuar de forma estratégica e executiva na evolução do CRM orientado a dados.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Projetar e construir soluções de dados para CRM, estruturando datasets, tabelas, regras e pipelines que suportem campanhas, jornadas e estratégias de relacionamento com clientes;
  • Desenvolver segmentações e inteligência de clientes em escala, transformando regras e necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados automatizadas, reutilizáveis e produtivas;
  • Evoluir a arquitetura de dados de CRM, contribuindo com modelagem, integração, performance, qualidade, observabilidade e governança dos dados;
  • Desenvolver e colocar em produção produtos e serviços de dados que possam ser consumidos de maneira confiável por CRM e outros times da companhia;
  • Construir soluções utilizando SQL, Python e Databricks, buscando automação, eficiência, escalabilidade e redução de processos manuais;
  • Aplicar conceitos de Engenharia de IA e GenAI para desenvolver automações, agentes, ferramentas e soluções que facilitem o acesso a dados, insights e conhecimento;
  • Criar mecanismos para democratização de dados e conhecimento, reduzindo a dependência de análises manuais e permitindo que áreas de negócio tenham maior autonomia;
  • Trabalhar junto aos stakeholders para transformar problemas de negócio em requisitos técnicos, soluções de dados e hipóteses mensuráveis;
  • Desenvolver provas de valor, experimentos e mecanismos de mensuração que permitam avaliar o impacto das soluções e suportar decisões baseadas em dados;
  • Garantir boas práticas de documentação, versionamento, testes, monitoramento e manutenção das soluções desenvolvidas;
  • Ter ownership sobre suas entregas, realizando estimativas, planejamento, negociação de escopo e prazos, identificação de riscos e reports de evolução para os stakeholders.

Conhecimentos e competências esperados:

  • SQL avançado, incluindo manipulação e transformação de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Databricks, com experiência no desenvolvimento e operacionalização de soluções de dados;
  • Python aplicado a engenharia, automação, processamento e análise de dados;
  • Conhecimentos de engenharia de dados, incluindo pipelines, ETL/ELT, modelagem, integração e qualidade de dados;
  • Conhecimentos de Engenharia de IA/GenAI, incluindo construção e integração de soluções baseadas em LLMs, automações e agentes;
  • Capacidade de desenvolver soluções pensando em produção, escalabilidade, confiabilidade e reutilização, e não somente análises pontuais;
  • Boa capacidade de conectar decisões técnicas aos objetivos e resultados de negócio;
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de transitar entre stakeholders técnicos e de negócio;
  • Autonomia, organização, capacidade de estimativa e gestão das próprias entregas.

Diferenciais

raw.description:
Join a global Contract Resource Organization (CRO) where innovation meets purpose. At Worldwide Clinical Trials, we're driven by a shared commitment to improving lives through high-quality clinical research. Our teams are empowered to think creatively, take ownership, and deliver meaningful work that helps bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world.


With more than 4,000 professionals across the globe, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued, growth is encouraged, and every contribution makes an impact. Whether you're building your career or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to learn, grow, and help shape the future of clinical research.


Make an Impact as a In-House Clinical Research Associate at Worldwide


Help keep clinical studies moving forward by supporting effective site management throughout the study lifecycle. In this role, you’ll work closely with Clinical Trial Managers, field Clinical Research Associates, study sites, and cross-functional project teams to help deliver site activities accurately and on schedule.

You’ll have broad involvement across site management, from study start-up and essential documentation through remote monitoring, data review, recruitment support, and study close-out. Your work will help sites stay prepared, informed, and aligned with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), applicable regulations, and study requirements.


Where You'll Work

This is a remote role open to candidates based in Argentina or Brazil. You will collaborate with global teams across multiple time zones.


What You'll Do

  • Support site management activities throughout the study lifecycle, including feasibility, study initiation, interim and remote monitoring, and close-out activities under appropriate guidance.
  • Maintain regular communication with assigned sites and partner with Clinical Trial Managers and field CRAs to keep study activities and deliverables on track.
  • Review site documentation for quality and completeness, support Trial Master File (TMF) filing and reconciliation, and help maintain Investigator Site Files (ISFs).
  • Review electronic data capture (EDC) records for completion, logic, and compliance, and assist sites with resolving data management and vendor queries.
  • Prepare CRAs for site visits by tracking and communicating action items, protocol deviations, outstanding queries, study supplies, training, and other open activities.
  • Coordinate study materials, support site staff changes and system access, and help ensure required training, qualifications, delegation, and regulatory documentation remain current.
  • Support site prescreening, screening, recruitment, and Subject Eligibility Review tracking, as applicable to the study.
  • Maintain study trackers, pull information from study-specific portals and systems, and provide timely updates to Clinical Trial Managers and project teams.
  • Serve as a key operational contact for clinical research activities when appropriate, helping sites and study teams address issues and maintain progress.

What You'll Bring

  • A four-year college curriculum with a major concentration in medical, biological, physical, health, pharmacy, or another related science is preferred; alternatively, a two-year college curriculum or equivalent education/training plus at least one year of relevant clinical research experience, or other relevant education/training plus at least two years of clinical research experience, may be considered.
  • A basic understanding of clinical research principles and processes, with knowledge of applicable FDA and/or EU regulations, ICH Guidelines, local regulatory requirements, and standard operating procedures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the interpersonal skills to work effectively with sites and cross-functional study teams.
  • Good planning, organization, and time-management skills, with a methodical approach to managing multiple activities.
  • Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office and familiarity with IVRS and electronic CRF systems.
  • Proficiency in spoken and written English + Spanish + Portuguese along with fluency in the local languages of the countries under your responsibility.

Discover the Difference


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.  Discover the Difference at Worldwide Clinical Trials. Explore additional opportunities on our careers page, visit , or connect with us onLinkedIn.

raw.description:
Position:

Senior Corporate Auditor

Job Description:

Arrow Corporate Audit’s mission is to deliver responsive risk-based audit and advisory services in a spirit of partnership with objectivity, fairness, transparency, and in accordance with our professional and ethical standards to our stakeholders. This role in instrumental in achieving that mission.

This role sits within the rapidly expanding EMEA Corporate Audit Team and is primarily based in London, although audit engagements and projects will be executed throughout the EMEA region.


Senior Auditors are a crucial business partner to Arrow businesses, departments and other key stakeholders. They execute high quality, value-adding projects in a managed, professional, detailed, diligent and collegiate manner. They are credible and are able to communicate complicated issues and the concept of risk and risk management to non-finance based individuals as well as senior executives and business leaders throughout the Arrow organization.

Our Senior Auditors are the team captains and are charged with leading delivery of our audit and advisory services across our global organization address all areas of enterprise risk management (strategic, financial, operational, compliance, and reputational) and establishing the team culture. They demonstrate thorough knowledge and a proven record of success in completing aspects of the Internal Audit process, control evaluation and testing methodologies, and other Financial and Operational Internal Control methodologies and terminology e.g. COSO.

Arrow Senior Auditors are agile thinkers and are able to react, adjust their project scope and procedures and problem solve where required. They are able to see the wider-risk and form an opinion on the level to which it is mitigated. They are able to execute a bespoke engagement to deliver specific assurance on a stated goal and they do not rely on thoughtlessly executing a standard, repetitive work-program. Consequently, Arrow Senior Auditors are a highly prized team-member, whose experiences, feedback and input are invaluable to the function as it seeks to constantly evolve, improve and provide gold standard audit projects to the business.


What will you be doing at Arrow?

  • Leading teams, emphasizing the supervising of staff by creating a positive working environment through the building of solid relationships with team members; the monitoring of workloads of all team members; adjustment and redistribution of assignments accordingly to promote work/life quality, the taking into account of team members capabilities and needs and meeting of business partner expectations; encouragement of team dialogue; the providing of candid, meaningful feedback in a timely manner; and the keeping of team members and leadership informed on progress and issues.
  • Using available technical resources and tools to research and expand one's sphere of knowledge to enhance work product, and to remain up to date on hot topics affecting Arrow's business and industry while sharing the knowledge with the team where applicable.
  • Collaborating directly with key stakeholders in the organization, identifying and addressing needs through building solid relationships with stakeholders; understanding the Company’s business; and actively participating in discussions and meetings.
  • Managing day-to-day engagement operations, including preparing concise, accurate documents and addressing unanticipated issues; demonstrating flexibility in prioritizing and completing tasks; and communicating potential conflicts to leadership.
  • Develop and or review audit programs, benchmark financial and operational processes as well as perform process optimization.
  • Creating high quality deliverable using appropriate business and technical language, especially developing and reviewing audit programs or testing steps, adapting an audit program to suit a specific environment, and/or designing special projects evaluation and testing work plans.
  • Involved with and contributing to specific company wide strategies and initiatives.

What are we looking for?

  • At least 4/5 years audit or consulting experience preferably in Manufacturing, Distribution/ Supply Chain Industry.
  • Education background: CPA/ ACA/ CIA/ CMA or MBA preferred.
  • Business Fluency in English language.
  • Willingness to travel internationally up to 25% of the time. The team meets in London twice per month.
  • Experience of working in Big 4 companies preferred.
  • Strong skills in Microsoft tools especially in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Data Analytics and AI (ACL, Power BI, Copilot Pro (preferred), Claude, etc.).
  • Exposure to Oracle, AX, or similar systems.

What is in it for you?

  • Competitive and attractive employee compensation package.
  • Benefits
  • Reliable & trusting work environment.
  • Cooperative team with flat structures and communication.
  • Professional and personal development.
  • Work Shift: Full Time 37.5hrs Monday- Friday 9.00am-5.30pm (30 mins lunch)
  • Remote working

Do you see yourself as our future colleague? If yes - send us your application.

AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.
At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.
We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.
We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.

The Technical Program Manager leads complex, multi-workstream technology programs that span related projects and teams across the lifecycle of an engagement. This role is accountable for working with cross-functional teams on aligning customer outcomes, solution strategy, commercial commitments, integrated delivery plans, and execution across AHEAD.

The Technical Program Manager operates at the intersection of Pre-Sales, Sales, Delivery, Practices, Resource Management, Finance, partners, and customer leadership. They help shape opportunities, establish the program operating model, coordinate project and workstream leaders, manage cross-project dependencies and financial outcomes, and provide the executive visibility required to make timely decisions and realize value.

Duties and Responsibilities:

    Program Strategy, Opportunity Shaping, and Commercial Planning

    • Lead program-level shaping of complex lifecycle management programs in partnership with Pre-Sales, Sales, Architects, Technical Leads, Practice leaders, and customer stakeholders.
    • Translate a strategic customer objective into an integrated program structure of related projects, workstreams, milestones, outcomes, dependencies, and decision points.
    • Develop and validate program assumptions, schedules, delivery approach, staffing strategy and resources forecasting, labor mix, schedule, partner or vendor inputs, and pricing recommendations with the appropriate stakeholders.
    • Assess delivery feasibility, challenge solution and schedule assumptions, identify cross-workstream risks, and surface tradeoffs before commitments are made to the customer.
    • Support proposals, solution reviews, statements of work, estimates, executive presentations, and internal approvals with practical program-level content.
    • Ensure a disciplined transition from opportunity shaping to delivery so that scope, assumptions, commercial commitments, risks, and decisions are understood across the program team.

      • Program Mobilization and Operating Model

      • Collaborate with the PMO to establish the program charter, integrated master plan, and shared governance model, in alignment with established program frameworks. This includes roles and decision rights, stakeholder alignment on priorities and outcomes, mutual accountability, communication plan, escalation paths, reporting dashboards and cadence, and RAID framework.
      • Collaborate with resource management and delivery leaders to forecast resources (internal or third party) as well as align project managers, workstream leads, technical teams, partners, and customer stakeholders around shared outcomes, sequencing, interdependencies, and measures of success.
      • Confirm readiness across staffing, customer access, environments, procurement, vendor coordination, technical prerequisites, operational requirements, and required approvals.
      • Define program-level standards for status reporting, dependency management, risk escalation, change control, quality, acceptance, and decision documentation.
      • Establish program KPIs and dashboards that provide an accurate view of progress, health, financial performance, risks, dependencies, and value realization.
      • Coach and support project managers and workstream leads in applying effective delivery practices while maintaining accountability for integrated program outcomes.

        • Multi-Workstream Technical Delivery and Lifecycle Management

        • Lead execution of large lifecycle management programs across infrastructure, cloud, network, security, platform, data center, or related technology environments.
        • Coordinate multiple projects, technical workstreams, delivery teams, partners, and vendors with complex interdependencies and shared milestones.
        • Partner with Architects and Technical Leads to sequence work, resolve cross-workstream constraints, validate technical decisions, and maintain alignment to the approved solution and customer outcomes.
        • Manage the integrated schedule and critical path, ensuring that project-level plans roll up to a coherent program plan and that impacts are understood across workstreams.
        • Track delivery against scope, schedule, budget, quality, acceptance criteria, and program outcomes; drive corrective action when performance deviates from plan.
        • Manage the relationship between program commitments and lifecycle operations, including implementation, knowledge transfer, transition to run or managed services, and post-go-live stabilization.
        • Assess the current technical environment and operational processes to define tactical and strategic initiatives that enhance service delivery and continuously improve the overall program approach.

Who We Are

PLATO is Canada’s largest Indigenous-owned software testing and technology services company. For nearly 30 years, our expert teams have helped our clients deliver reliable products that users enjoy interacting with.

Our 100% Canada‑based team brings deep experience in QA, software testing, and IT services, along with a shared commitment to collaboration, mentorship, and continuous improvement. We’re a team that shows up for each other, whether that’s tackling complex client challenges or helping colleagues grow through coaching and knowledge‑sharing.

As Canada’s largest Indigenous‑owned software testing company, we’re proud of our roots and our mission to build a stronger, more inclusive technology workforce. At the same time, we warmly welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences who are passionate about quality, teamwork, and making an impact.

Contract Duration: ASAP to Dec 31, 2026

Security Clearance: Current Government of Canada Reliability or higher is required at the time of application

Summary

As a Service Designer, you will be responsible for balancing the intersection of human-centered design, business needs and requirements and the technical solution in the Service Design and Planning phases for the EI on BDM program. You will interpret and synthesized these components to create conceptual design, functional design in collaboration with Product management Planning teams. You will be responsible for guiding experience decisions, engage with multiple teams, and contribute to key decisions to drive planning efforts to meet delivery timelines in an agile delivery model.

Responsibilities:

  • Create functional flows to visualize the user experience and partner with Product Managers to refine Features, providing a human-centered lens and design expertise for the proposed solution and its Acceptance Criteria

raw.excerpt: Ready to accelerate your career? Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact.
raw.description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

We're hiring a Senior Developer with deep mobile expertise for a small, self-contained innovation group (Initial three-month contract, with opportunity for extension or move to full-time). Working alongside a Product Manager and a web-focused developer, you will take an ambiguous business problem, turn it into a testable product bet, and build the smallest end-to-end experience that can generate meaningful evidence, often in roughly one to two weeks. You will bring early versions back to customers and the market validation group, gather feedback, and rapidly iterate through V1, V2, V3, and beyond. Once the concept is validated, the group will shift from proving the idea to determining what must change for it to become secure, reliable, scalable, and ready for handoff.

The group operates like an entrepreneurial startup within the larger organization and owns the path from problem discovery through rapid prototyping, customer and market validation, iterative development, and a validated proof of concept. From there, it determines what is required to harden and scale the product before handing it to the core product and engineering team.

The operating principle is simple: build to learn first, then build to scale. During validation, speed comes from controlling scope and making deliberate, reversible technical choices—not from designing the final production architecture before the opportunity is proven. Security, privacy, and responsible data handling remain non-negotiable throughout. Once an idea demonstrates value, you will work with our Core team at key technical integration points to harden, refactor, or redesign what is needed for scale. That judgment lets us discard weak ideas cheaply and invest deeply in the ones that earn it.

This is a fit for someone with strong product and commercial instincts, sound technical judgment, and a high degree of ownership. You identify gaps, propose a path forward, and keep momentum without waiting for perfect requirements. You own outcomes, make clear trade-offs to meet timelines, and raise consequential risks early.

What you'll do:

  • Work with the Project Lead, Product Manager and Web Developer to turn ambiguous problems into unified driver-and-admin experiences
  • Build the smallest end-to-end prototype that can test the idea, often within one to two weeks
  • Bring prototypes to customers and the market validation group, then rapidly translate feedback into V2, V3, and beyond
  • Challenge assumptions, cut scope, and keep the group moving without waiting for perfect requirements
  • Make deliberate, reversible technical choices during validation while protecting security, privacy, and data integrity
  • Build within the shared codebase, behind feature flags and in isolated modules that can be removed cleanly
  • Integrate with our platform backend and third-party APIs using existing contracts and patterns
  • Once a concept is validated, identify and complete the work required to harden, scale, test, and release it
  • Prepare validated features and technical context for a clean handoff to the core product and engineering team

What you'll bring:

Core Experience

  • 6–8 years as a software engineer at a senior level, with a track record of product work at startups and in fast-paced environments
  • You've built from nothing, cut scope under time pressure, and shipped
  • Comfortable with ambiguity: you can take an unfamiliar domain and an under-specified problem and make progress without waiting to be handed a spec
  • Strong product thinker who can connect driver and administrator needs, commercial value, and technical choices across mobile and web
  • Strong communicator who identifies gaps, proposes a path forward, and keeps the work moving
  • High ownership, sound judgment under time pressure, and a track record of delivering against commitments without hiding material trade-offs
  • Comfortable working in a small, autonomous group where priorities can change quickly as new evidence emerges

Technical

  • Very comfortable with React Native, plus native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin) development
  • Familiar with the full mobile release process for both iOS and Android, including store submission and review
  • Solid integrating against REST / backend APIs and handling auth, tokens, and SSO on device
  • Comfortable collaborating across mobile, web, and backend boundaries to create one coherent product experience
  • You adopt the existing patterns and conventions of the mobile codebase rather than introducing your own
  • You know how to code and understand good software design. You are not strictly a "vibe coder": you can reason about architecture and trade-offs, not just prompt your way to output

AI-Native Mindset

  • You've adopted modern AI development workflows and use tools like Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot as part of how you ship
  • You understand AI skills, agents, and code-spec workflows, and how to use them without losing engineering rigour
  • You lean on AI to move faster on prototypes and to hold quality up during hardening

Bonus (nice to have)

  • Ability to flex onto the Portal stack (TypeScript / Next.js / NestJS / PostgreSQL) when a bet calls for it

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

What we offer in return for you bringing your best:

  • Remote work and flexible working hours
  • Mentorship and development opportunities (to help you achieve your career goals!)
  • Extended medical & dental benefits
  • Healthcare spending account
  • $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off: No annual cap on vacation, supported by a trust-based, flexible approach to time away.

Cardata is an equal opportunity employer. All candidates will be equally considered without regard to race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, language, citizenship, creed, religion, gender/gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, physical and/or mental handicap or financial ability. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to bring their authentic selves to work.

If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know.

POSITION SUMMARY:


Conducts CPT and ICD-10 coding reviews by detailed examination of each line item in the physician medical record and charge session. Performs chart audits to ensure correct coding and charge capture have been applied appropriately. Works closely with key revenue cycle stakeholders to understand reasons for denials, root cause analysis, and feedback to providers.

Position: Physician Practice Coder

Department: BUMG Corporate PBO General

Schedule: Full Time


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

Coding support

  • Reviews patient medical records and abstracts medical data that identifies all diagnoses and procedures. Codes diagnoses, procedures, and appropriate modifiers from the medical record documentation using ICD-10-CM, CPT4/HCPCS classification systems. Refers to a computerized encoding system, written coding aids and other reference materials to ensure accurate coding for billing.
  • Sequences diagnoses, procedures and complications by following ICD-10-CM, CPT-4, and the Uniform Hospital Discharge Data Set (UHDDS); adheres to the Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, Coding Clinic guidelines and other regulatory guidelines as appropriate. Consults with the CDCI team to request appropriate physician or appropriate medical staff to clarify medical record information.
  • Maintains productivity standards set forth in Departmental Policies and procedures.
  • Maintains knowledge of coding and professional skills, including maintaining yearly coding credentials through attendance at in-service programs, conferences, workshops, review of current literature and other educational programs.
  • Utilizes hospital’s cultural values as the basis for decision making and to facilitate the hospital’s goals and mission.
  • Follows established Hospital infection control and safety procedures.
  • Review and respond to coding questions.
  • Ensure billed service is being accurately coded.
  • Perform random chart audits.
  • Provide continual coding updates.
  • Research coding issues that arise.
  • Codes diagnoses and procedures from the medical record using ICD-10-CM and CPT-4/HCPCS classification systems.
  • Sequences diagnoses, procedures and complications by following ICD-10-CM, Medicare, Medicaid, and other fiscal intermediary guidelines.
  • Reviews charts for documentation and signature.
  • Performs other duties as needed.
  • Must adhere to all of BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.

JOB REQUIREMENTS


EDUCATION:

  • Associates Degree (or direct work experience equivalent to at least 2 years)

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

  • CPC/CCS – Certified Professional Coder

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2-5 years experience required in a multi-specialty physician coding environment to include coding, compliance, and billing processes.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Work requires in-depth knowledge of medical terminology, ICD-10-CM and CPT-4 Work also requires basic concepts of human anatomy, physiology and pathology.
  • Strong knowledge of health records, computerized billing and charging systems, Microsoft applications, data integrity, and processing techniques required.
  • Excellent organizational skills, including ability to multi-task, prioritize essential tasks, follow-through and meet timelines.
  • Ability to work with accuracy and attention to detail
  • Ability to solve problems appropriately using job knowledge and current policies/procedures.
  • Ability to work cooperatively with members of the healthcare delivery team and staff, ability to handle frequent interruptions and adapt to changes in workload and work schedule and to respond quickly to urgent requests.
  • Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information and ensure compliance of HIPAA rules and regulations.
  • Reviews and analyzes coding-related claim denials to determine the underlying cause, including incorrect CPT, ICD-10-CM, modifier, sequencing, medical necessity, documentation, or charge capture issues.
  • Performs detailed review of denied claims, physician medical records, charge sessions, payer information, and applicable coding guidelines to determine whether the claim was coded and billed appropriately.
  • Identifies trends and recurring denial patterns and performs root cause analysis to determine opportunities for coding, documentation, workflow, or system improvements.
  • Determines appropriate coding corrections and recommends resolution of coding-related denials in accordance with CPT, ICD-10-CM, payer, Medicare, Medicaid, and other applicable guidelines.

Compensation Range:

$24.04- $33.65

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensures as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), discretionary annual bonuses and merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family well-being.

NOTE: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.

raw.excerpt: Cazoo, is the ultimate destination for car enthusiasts and buyers alike!
raw.description:
Cazoo, is the ultimate destination for car enthusiasts and buyers alike! As a leader in the market, we pride ourselves on providing unparalleled search tools, expert car guides, insightful reviews, and a comprehensive vehicle price guide. Our mission is simple: to empower buyers to find their perfect car efficiently and with confidence, while also helping automotive retailers reach millions of eager buyers.

At Cazoo, you'll be part of a team that's revolutionising the way people buy and sell cars. If you're ready to drive your career forward in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, Cazoo is the place for you. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of automotive retail!

We are looking for Principal Software Engineer

Reports To: Director of Technology

Contract Type: Permanent

Location: Remote, UK based

About the role:

We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help shape the next generation of Cazoo's technology platform.

We're undertaking a significant modernisation of our existing Azure-based architecture, moving towards more scalable, cloud-native and event-driven services. This is an opportunity to influence how our core platform evolves, improve the experience of our engineering teams and build the foundations that support our customer-facing products.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role, combining software engineering, architecture and platform strategy. You'll spend around half your time actively contributing to engineering delivery, while also helping set technical direction, mentoring engineers and driving initiatives across teams.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Building and modernising software: Design, develop and deliver scalable backend services, APIs and event-driven systems, including the safe migration and retirement of legacy applications.

  • Shaping software architecture: Make key decisions around service boundaries, distributed systems, cloud-native design and how our platform evolves.

  • Remaining hands-on: Write production code, solve complex engineering problems, review pull requests and work directly alongside other engineers.

  • Driving technical direction: Help shape and deliver our engineering roadmap, balancing long-term architectural improvements with commercial and product priorities.

  • Improving developer experience: Design and evolve shared services, reusable components and engineering tooling that make it easier for teams to build, test and deliver software.

  • Leading engineering practices: Establish consistent engineering standards, contribute to engineering guilds or chapters and drive technical improvements across multiple squads.

  • Championing engineering excellence: Improve reliability, scalability, observability, performance and maintainability across our production systems.

  • Developing engineers: Mentor and support engineers, facilitate technical discussions and help teams make sound architectural decisions.

  • Embracing AI-assisted engineering: Help establish effective practices for AI development tools, improving engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate quality and security standards.

You'll have genuine ownership and influence, with the opportunity to make meaningful architectural decisions while remaining close to the technology and people delivering them.

What we ideally looking for;

  • Extensive hands-on backend software engineering experience, designing, building and operating business-critical production systems, ideally within a product-led technology environment.

  • Proficiency in a modern backend language, ideally TypeScript/Node.js, although we're open to engineers with strong transferable experience in languages such as Java.

  • Strong software architecture expertise, with experience designing distributed systems, microservices, APIs and event-driven applications.

  • Experience modernising complex software platforms, including decomposing legacy applications, introducing new architectural patterns and migrating production workloads safely.

  • Experience building cloud-native applications and services, preferably on Azure, although strong AWS or GCP experience is also relevant.

  • Demonstrable Principal-level technical leadership, setting architectural direction, establishing engineering standards and influencing technical decisions across multiple engineering teams. Experience leading engineering chapters, guilds or equivalent communities would be particularly valuable.

  • A strong understanding of modern engineering practices, including automated testing, CI/CD, observability, performance optimisation and maintaining production reliability.

  • Familiarity with cloud platform technologies, such as Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform and managed cloud services, with an understanding of how these support software development and delivery.

  • Sound engineering judgement, including balancing technical debt against delivery priorities, evaluating build-versus-buy decisions and making pragmatic architectural trade-offs.

  • An interest in AI-assisted software development, including tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot, and how they can be used responsibly to improve engineering productivity.

Experience working with high-traffic consumer products, marketplaces, classifieds or automotive platforms would be advantageous.

We're particularly interested in engineers who have progressed into broader architectural and technical leadership responsibilities while remaining actively involved in building software.

Perks & Benefits

Here’s how we back you:

Financials💰

  • We more than match your commitment to your pension, so when you contribute 6% , we put in 9%, taking your total up to 15% of your base salary.

  • Quarterly value-led awards with generous cash prizes.

  • Referral Bonus: Recommend a colleague, get £2,000.

Work-Life 🏖️

  • 25 days (plus bank holidays)

  • Family Enhanced leave after 6 months of service:

  • Maternity/Pregnant Parent Leave: 20 weeks at 100% pay,.

  • Paternity/Non-birth Parent Leave: 12 weeks at 100% pay.

  • Volunteer Days: We offer 2 volunteer days a year so you can help out wherever matters to you.

Health & Peace of Mind 🏩

Comprehensive cover so you (and your favourite people) have the care you need.

  • AXA Private Healthcare: High-level coverage for you, partners, and dependents—including pre-existing conditions.

  • Bupa Dental: Level 2 coverage for cashback on preventative, restorative and emergency care.

  • Private GP: 24/7 digital access via Help@Hand.

  • Income Protection: 13 weeks of sick pay, before going onto Long term Illness cover with Canada Life

  • Life Assurance: 4x basic salary covered by Unum.

  • Specialist Support: Free counseling and menopause/fertility support via Peppy.

Your Growth 🌱

We hired you for your talent, and we’re committed to helping you expand it.

  • Learning budget and continuous development opportunities. Every manager has a dedicated budget for your specific role development.

The Extras 🔍

  • Company issued laptop.

  • Perks@Work: Discounts at over 30,000 retailers and entertainment venues.

  • Annual conference with top tier industry guest speakers. Past guests include names like Matthew Syed and Damian Hughes.

  • Whether it’s our Summer bash or the annual festive party, we make sure we take the time to bring everyone together and celebrate in style.

  • Free food & drinks in the office.

  • We’re proud partners of Brentford FC, and we share the rewards with you. From tickets to matches to the bucket-list opportunity to actually play on the pitch yourself, we bring you closer to the action.

Diversity & Inclusion at Cazoo

The best ideas come from people with different backgrounds, experiences and ways of thinking. At Cazoo we are a place where people feel comfortable speaking up, contributing and growing. Bring your perspective. Bring your experience. Be yourself.

raw.description:
Everlywell is a digital health company pioneering the next generation of biomarker intelligence—combining AI-powered technology with human insight to deliver personalized, actionable health answers. We transform complex biomarker data into life-changing insights—seamlessly integrating advanced diagnostics, virtual care, and patient engagement to reshape how and where health happens.

Over the past decade, Everlywell has delivered close to 1 billion personalized health insights, transforming care for 60 million people and powering hundreds of enterprise partners. In 2025, an estimated 1 in 94 U.S. adults received an Everlywell test, solidifying our spot as the #1 at-home testing company in the country. Fueled by AI and built for scale, we’re breaking down barriers, closing care gaps, and unlocking a more connected healthcare experience that is smarter, faster, and more personalized.

Everly Provider Group DE, P.A., and its affiliated professional entities (collectively, Everly Provider Group or EPG) are virtual, multi‑state medical practices facilitating access to high‑quality, diagnostic‑driven patient care. EPG is the claims‑based provider network for EverlyCare and health plan programs affiliated with Everlywell, a leading remote‑based healthcare company. Our mission is to enable access to diagnostic testing, treatment, and professional guidance that empowers individuals to improve their health. Our suite of services enables a broad spectrum of health industry and health plan clients to provide seamless access to diagnostic testing and related care interventions. We are a national physician and advanced practice clinician network with a strong care coordination and patient support team and technology infrastructure.

Our model integrates genetic counselors, physicians, and technology to ensure clinically appropriate and compliant genetic testing services. We are seeking physicians within Everly Provider Group to support asynchronous medical necessity review following a completed genetic counseling session. Services rendered under this role will support claims submitted to federal payers. As such, strict adherence to documentation standards, medical necessity criteria, and applicable state and federal regulations is required.

Responsibilities

  • Deliver synchronous telehealth visits (video and/or phone) to patients as part of care programs in partnership with health plans.

  • Conduct focused, efficient clinical assessments aligned to visit type (e.g., treatment-focused, condition-specific, and preventive/wellness visits).

  • Interpret diagnostic results (including at-home lab results) and provide clear, actionable recommendations, including treatment, follow-up care, and referrals as appropriate.

  • Develop and implement evidence-based care plans within scope and in accordance with program protocols and payer requirements.

  • Provide patient education and counseling on diagnoses, treatment options, preventive care, and next steps.

  • Ensure compliance with state telemedicine regulations, payer guidelines, and internal clinical protocols.

  • Document all patient interactions accurately and in a timely manner in accordance with organizational and regulatory standards.

Qualifications

  • MD or DO, Board Certified in Internal Medicine or Family Medicine (required).

  • Active, unrestricted medical licenses in good standing; licensure in 10+ states highly preferred (priority states: AR, GA, MS, TX, WI, LA, AL).

  • Medicaid enrollment in multiple states highly preferred; must be in good standing where enrolled.

  • Must be enrolled in and in good standing with Medicare.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality, efficient virtual care, including diagnostic interpretation and care planning.

  • Strong webside manner with the ability to build trust and communicate effectively in a telehealth setting.

  • 1+ year of telehealth experience preferred.

  • Comfortable with digital health tools; tech-savvy and adaptable to evolving workflows and protocols.

  • Maintains compliance with HIPAA and all applicable privacy and security regulations.

  • Ability to work within structured care models and clinical protocols while exercising sound clinical judgment.

Ideal Experience

  • Prior experience with genetic testing.

  • Familiarity with payer medical necessity criteria.

  • Experience working with Medicaid populations.

Benefits

  • Fixed payment per review

  • Flexible schedule

  • 100% Remote

  • Professional Liability Insurance

Security Notice: Everlywell never requests fees, payment, or banking information at any stage of the recruitment process. Official communications and interview invitations will only come from verified email addresses ending in @everlywell.com or @everlyhealth.com. To ensure your application is secure, always apply directly through our official careers page at .
