raw.description:
Builders FirstSource (BFS) is executing Project Elevate, a multi-year business transformation that is standardizing core operations on SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition and connected enterprise applications. The Senior Engineer, SAP Application Development, is a hands-on technical resource responsible for the quality, maintainability, security, and delivery of Project Elevate custom development. This role partners with business analysts, functional leads, architects, security, Basis, testing teams, and systems-integration partners to translate business requirements into clean-core, scalable solutions across SAP S/4HANA and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Serve as a BFS technical owner for Project Elevate application development, providing hands-on engineering leadership from requirements and solution design through build, test, deployment, stabilization, and transition to support. Review functional specifications and translate approved requirements into complete technical designs, estimates, development tasks, unit-test plans, deployment dependencies, and support documentation. Design, develop, enhance, and troubleshoot RICEFW objects, including reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, Fiori applications, CDS views, OData services, APIs, and related SAP extensions. Apply Project Elevate development standards, naming conventions, documentation templates, security requirements, and code-review checklists across BFS and vendor-delivered work. Champion SAP clean-core principles by prioritizing fit-to-standard, released APIs, zero modification, in-app extensibility, ABAP Cloud/on-stack extensibility, and side-by-side BTP solutions before classical extensions. Develop and support solutions using SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, RAP, CDS, SAP Fiori/UI5, SAP Gateway/OData, SAP BTP, CAP, SAP Build, HANA Cloud, workflows, events, and API-based integration patterns as applicable. Perform or approve peer code reviews and quality checks using tools such as ABAP Test Cockpit, runtime analysis, SQL Monitor, SQL Performance Tuning Worklist, and HANA query-plan analysis; ensure defects, performance issues, security findings, and technical debt are resolved before release. Own development quality for assigned objects and vendor-delivered components, including technical-specification approval, code-review outcomes, documentation completeness, test evidence, transport readiness, and adherence to BFS architecture and engineering policies. Partner with functional leads and business analysts early in solution discussions to evaluate standard capabilities, identify gaps, compare extensibility options, and recommend solutions that balance business value, maintainability, risk, cost, and upgrade compatibility. Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Integration, Security, Basis, Data, Testing, Release Management, and application owners to resolve cross-system dependencies and deliver integrated end-to-end business capabilities. Work with Security teams to incorporate authorization checks, secure coding, sensitive-data handling, workflow controls, segregation-of-duties considerations, and required role or authorization-object changes. Coordinate with Basis and platform teams on environments, connectivity, system performance, background jobs, transports, runtime capacity, monitoring, and technical issue resolution across development, quality, training, pre-production, and production landscapes. Create and execute technical unit tests and support functional unit testing, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, performance testing, regression testing, defect triage, retesting, and release-readiness activities. Prepare solutions for controlled deployment through approved transport and change processes; support cutover, production validation, hypercare, root-cause analysis, and timely remediation of production defects. Maintain traceability and status in approved delivery tools, including requirements, technical designs, build tasks, defects, risks, dependencies, test evidence, approvals, and deployment milestones. Review vendor estimates, designs, code, test results, and delivery plans; hold systems-integration partners and contractors accountable for quality, schedule, knowledge transfer, and compliance with BFS standards. Contribute to reusable engineering patterns, templates, accelerators, automation, technical roadmaps, and continuous improvements to the software-development lifecycle, DevSecOps practices, and release processes. Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-transfer materials; share best practices with BFS developers, analysts, support teams, and partners. Provide technical mentoring and guidance to other engineers and development partners while remaining accountable for individual delivery; perform hands-on coding for complex, high-risk, or business-critical work. Communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to project leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Four or more years of SAP application-development experience, including hands-on ABAP development in SAP S/4HANA or SAP ERP environments. Experience delivering custom SAP objects through requirements, technical design, development, code review, testing, transport, deployment, and production support. Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA extensibility, ABAP, CDS, enhancements, workflows, interfaces, forms, OData services, and Fiori/UI5 development. Experience applying secure coding, performance optimization, source/version control, peer review, testing, and software-development lifecycle practices. Experience working with systems integrators, offshore development teams, vendors, and cross-functional enterprise delivery teams. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

COMPETENCIES

Evaluates Problems: Evaluates and analyzes different types of information objectively to identify appropriate solutions; writes fluently, establishing the key facts clearly and interprets numerical data effectively. Technical Communication/ Presentation: Communicates with clarity and precision, presenting complex information in a concise format that is audience appropriate. Adjusting and Driving Change: Takes a positive approach to tackling work and embraces change; invites feedback relating to performance and deals constructively with criticism. Identifies the need for and drives change when required to achieve objectives. Focuses on Customers: Understands and anticipates customer needs and takes action to provide high-quality products and services to exceed expectations. Demonstrates Business Acumen: Demonstrates working knowledge of market, economic, legal, and regulatory environments and how they impact the business. Agile Best Practices: Understands how agility is leveraged in IT ways of working. Adopts agile best practices as appropriate throughout the assigned work lifecycle. Responds to feedback quickly based on comments of internal and external customers and needs of the market. Bias for Action: Takes initiative and identifies what needs to be done and acts without waiting to be asked. Executes work in a timely manner. Suggests improvements to current ways of working.

BFS COMPETENCIES

Business and Financial Acumen

Demonstrates depth of understanding for the P&L and financial analysis Teaches business and financial acumen to others. Understands KPIs and how BFS makes money. Knows the different business segments and how they relate to one another. Understands customer sales and engagement. Demonstrates functional and/or technical expertise. Understands complex issues and demonstrates problem solving skills. Understands how to maximize business results regardless of industry cycle.

Results Driven

Holds self and others accountable. Communicates and sets clear goals with plans to deliver. Manages competing priorities effectively. Demonstrates appropriate urgency. Drives to exceed expectations in alignment with our BFS SPICE values. Embraces and follows best practices. Demonstrates self-starter, can-do attitude.

Strategic Thinking and Decision Making

Leverages resources and teams around them to solve problems and create mutually beneficial outcomes. Demonstrates willingness and courage to make tough decisions in a timely manner. Balances short-and-long term priorities Demonstrates proactive versus reactive thinking. Asks questions to identify root cause and analyze situations more accurately.

Servant Leadership

Demonstrates humility by putting others first. Builds trust-based relationships. Leads by example with kindness and respect. Collaborates well across all areas of the business. Advocates for others Actively listens to understand the meaning and intent of what the other person is communicating. Demonstrates authenticity and encourages others to do the same.

Emotional Intelligence

Demonstrates situational awareness – knows when and how to adjust leadership style in different situations. Demonstrates self-awareness – understands strengths and weaknesses. Demonstrates empathy – puts themselves in other’s shoes. Assumes positive intent.

Develops and Leads Others

Drives alignment through clear communication of vision, goals, and expectations. Invests time on a regular basis in performance feedback and developmental conversations. Fosters a respectful and inclusive environment. Empowers, motivates, and inspires others. Coaches and mentor others for their development. Guides and persuades others to deliver positive outcomes.

Growth Mindset

Demonstrates a growth mindset; takes appropriate risks, fails fast and forward, learns from mistakes. Perseveres and champions growth, even in the face of resistance, ambiguity, or possible failure. Thinks like an owner with an entrepreneurial spirit. Demonstrates and encourages intellectual curiosity. Continuous learner; seeks opportunities and knowledge for personal and professional growth. Sees possibilities over problems – actively seeks solutions.

Innovation

Encourages out-of-the box thinking to create new ways of doing things. Continuously seeks to improve and simplify pain points in the business. Anticipates, embraces, and leads change. Develops and executes breakthrough strategies.

Integrity

Does the right thing even under challenging circumstances? Communicates with honesty. Consistently treats others fairly and equitably. Demonstrates reliability and does what they say they will do. Conducts tough conversations and delivers difficult messages with kindness and respect.

WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL ACTIVITY

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Subject to both typical office environment and outside locations with temperature and weather variations. Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 pounds. Occasional travel may be required to attend program specific working session.

raw.description:
Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.

The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.

As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

3. Financial Planning & Performance Management

Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.

Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

4. Insurance Finance

Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.

Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.

Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.

Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.

5. Investment & Asset Management Finance

Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.

Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.

Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.

Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.

Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

Partner with Risk and Actuarial leadership on capital and solvency assessments.

7. Asset-Liability Management

Provide executive oversight of asset-liability management (ALM) across relevant insurance and investment businesses.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support balance-sheet optimization and financial stress-testing initiatives.

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Lead Group treasury, liquidity, cash management, and banking relationships.

Establish Group-wide liquidity policies and funding strategies.

Optimize cash across subsidiaries while maintaining appropriate regulatory and operational liquidity.

Oversee debt facilities, guarantees, intercompany funding, and treasury risk.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Lead Group-level financing and capital-raising initiatives.

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

Oversee Group-wide tax planning, compliance, reporting, and risk management.

Ensure appropriate tax governance across subsidiaries and jurisdictions.

Identify opportunities for legitimate tax efficiency.

Monitor changes in tax and regulatory requirements affecting the Group.

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, lenders, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

Support investor presentations, annual reports, strategic reviews, and capital-market activities.

Clearly communicate the Group's financial strategy, performance, and outlook.

16. Finance Transformation

Modernize the Group's finance operating model, systems, processes, and reporting infrastructure.

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

Drive automation and digital transformation across finance.

Improve transparency and real-time visibility across subsidiaries and business units.

17. Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the Group Finance function and senior finance leadership across subsidiaries.

Develop a high-performing, commercially focused finance organization.

Establish common standards, talent-development programs, and succession plans.

Build strong relationships with subsidiary CFOs and Finance Directors.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and value creation.

Key Performance Indicators

The Group CFO will be accountable for:

Group revenue and earnings growth

Group EBITDA / net income performance

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Insurance underwriting profitability

Combined ratio / loss ratio performance

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow strength

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Capital-raising effectiveness

M&A and strategic-investment performance

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and reporting compliance

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

18+ years of progressive finance experience, including substantial Group or enterprise-level leadership.

Previous experience as Group CFO, CFO, Deputy Group CFO, Group Finance Director, Finance Director, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience managing complex group structures, subsidiaries, investment entities, and regulated businesses.

Strong understanding of insurance financial reporting, capital and solvency requirements, investment portfolios, and balance-sheet management.

Demonstrated experience in capital allocation, treasury, liquidity, financial planning, and enterprise risk.

Experience working directly with Boards, CEOs, regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, and rating agencies.

Preferred Experience

Previous Group CFO experience within a diversified insurance or investment group.

Experience covering both insurance operations and investment/asset-management businesses.

Exposure to life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, pensions, or institutional investment.

Experience managing significant investment portfolios and ALM.

Proven experience with M&A, capital raising, restructuring, strategic investments, or international expansion.

Experience across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

Experience working with international institutional investors or rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is advantageous.

Additional insurance, investment, actuarial, or risk-management qualifications are desirable.

Core Competencies

Group Financial Leadership

Corporate Finance

Insurance Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Capital Allocation

M&A & Corporate Development

Regulatory Reporting

Risk Management

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Finance Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful Group CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially astute, and financially rigorous

Comfortable operating across complex group structures

Strong in capital allocation and investment decisions

Experienced in highly regulated environments

A sophisticated communicator at Board and investor level

Strong in balance-sheet and liquidity management

Comfortable challenging business leaders and driving accountability

Able to balance growth, profitability, capital, liquidity, and risk

An effective partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, Chief Actuary, and subsidiary CEOs

A transformational leader capable of building a world-class Group Finance function

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

Senior Quality Automation Engineer

About Authenticx
Authenticx is a fast-growing, venture-backed, enterprise AI company transforming healthcare through conversation intelligence. We help healthcare organizations uncover insights hidden in millions of customer interactions to improve patient, member, and business outcomes.

Role Summary
The Senior Quality Automation Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and integrating automated tests across Authenticx's healthcare conversation intelligence platform. You will translate customer workflows, product requirements, user personas, and healthcare realities into automated coverage that protects the experiences that matter most. You will own automation for critical product areas and prioritize coverage based on customer impact, product risk, release frequency, and business value.
You will partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to improve product quality, testability, and release confidence. We are looking for someone who brings strong technical judgment, product sense, curiosity, and ownership to quality engineering in a fast-paced startup environment.

What You'll Do
Build Automation Around Real Customer Use Cases
• Learn how Authenticx customers use the platform across healthcare quality, coaching, compliance, operations, analytics, and customer experience workflows.
• Translate workflows, acceptance criteria, production issues, and known risk areas into meaningful automated test scenarios.
• Determine what should be automated, which testing layer is most appropriate, and the level of coverage needed.
• Balance UI, API, integration, and data-level testing to create reliable and maintainable coverage.

Build and Maintain Automated Coverage
• Design, write, maintain, and troubleshoot automated tests for UI workflows, APIs, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, reporting, and AI-powered features.
• Build and maintain smoke, regression, acceptance, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
• Use Playwright to automate critical user journeys and product workflows.
• Use Bruno/Postman to validate APIs, payloads, integrations, authentication, error handling, and backend behavior.
• Use SQL to validate data accuracy, workflow integrity, processing outcomes, reporting outputs, and customer-facing analytics.
• Build reusable automation utilities, fixtures, helpers, and test data patterns.
• Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide earlier and more reliable quality signals.
• Investigate flaky tests, environmental issues, timing problems, and test-data failures, and distinguish them from true product defects.
• Identify high-risk coverage gaps and build automation to address them.

Partner Cross-Functionally to Improve Quality
• Work with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to understand requirements, risks, and real-world usage.
• Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, logging, test data setup, and API contracts.
• Use logs, monitoring tools, database queries, API responses, and product data to investigate failures and validate system behavior.
• Communicate defects, automation gaps, and release risks clearly.
• Share automation patterns and testing practices that strengthen the broader quality engineering discipline.

Validate AI-Powered Product Experiences
• Build automated validation for classifications, model outputs, prompt and configuration changes, structured responses, extraction workflows, and downstream behavior.
• Develop repeatable test scenarios for deterministic and semi-deterministic AI behaviors.
• Validate expected outputs, required fields, edge cases, failure conditions, and downstream workflow impacts.
• Use representative test data and known expected outcomes to detect regressions.
• Partner with Data Science and Engineering to improve the testability and regression coverage of AI-powered features.

Required Qualifications
• 5+ years in test automation, SDET, or software engineering, with hands on ownership of automated suites
• Production level coding in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, or Python
• Playwright or equivalent modern UI automation on complex web applications
• REST API testing (Bruno, Postman, or code based), covering authentication, payload validation, and error handling
• SQL proficiency to validate data integrity and processing outcomes
• CI/CD integration, including failure triage, flaky test diagnosis, and test data management
• Ability to assess product risk and choose the right test layer (UI, API, or data) without having every case defined for you

raw.description:
We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About this role

As an Equipment Procurement Transaction Lead on Intersect's Procurement team, you'll take complete ownership of high-value equipment supply and EPC transactions across our portfolio of power for data centers: solar, battery storage, wind, gas generation, and high-voltage projects. Reporting to the Senior Director of Procurement, you will serve as the quarterback for major commercial deals—structuring RFPs, negotiating complex equipment supply agreements, and orchestrating inputs across Development, Engineering, Construction, Project Finance, and Legal to bring bankable contracts across the finish line.


Success here hinges on decisive inter-departmental leadership, meticulous organization, and commercial composure under pressure. You will cultivate deep, respectful partnerships with OEMs, suppliers, and EPC contractors while driving rigorous quantitative analysis and clear executive alignment to secure long-run value for Intersect's power infrastructure fleet.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition and power critical digital infrastructure. The Procurement team negotiates major equipment, construction, and O&M contracts while building enduring partnerships with top-tier OEMs and execution partners. Joining this tight-knit group means stepping into a high-ownership environment where your commercial judgment directly unlocks multi-billion-dollar power and data center projects.

What you'll do

Own and Execute Equipment Supply Transactions

  • Structure, negotiate, and execute major equipment supply agreements—with a primary focus on solar and BESS equipment for data center construction alongside gas generation, wind, and high-voltage assets—ensuring alignment with project schedules and financial targets.

  • Lead end-to-end Request for Proposal (RFP) processes, including scope definition, commercial and quantitative bid leveling in Google Sheets, and final award recommendations.

  • Support secondary EPC contract negotiations and manage post-execution contract actions, including amendments, change orders, warranty administration, performance monitoring, and commercial claims.

Drive Cross-Functional Deal Leadership

  • Take full accountability for transaction task lists, timelines, and deliverables, leading stakeholders across Development, Engineering, Construction, Project Finance, and Legal to contribute effectively to final deal execution.

  • Translate complex technical, legal, and financial requirements into cohesive commercial contract structures in Google Docs that satisfy project finance bankability standards.

  • Distill multi-faceted commercial tradeoffs, risk allocations, and pricing models into crisp, persuasive executive presentations in Google Slides to drive rapid leadership decisions.

Cultivate Strategic Supplier & Counterparty Partnerships

  • Build and maintain trusted, respectful relationships with key gas generation OEMs, major equipment suppliers, and tier-one EPC contractors to secure manufacturing capacity and competitive commercial terms.

  • Maintain calmness and constructive focus under adversity, resolving commercial deadlocks, supply chain bottlenecks, and schedule pressures without sacrificing long-term partnership value.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Business, or a related field; an engineering background is preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience procuring major equipment (specifically gas generation equipment, turbines, transformers, BESS, wind, or solar) and negotiating EPC or equipment supply contracts for utility-scale power or data center projects.

  • Demonstrated transaction leadership with the ability to take complete ownership of a deal, manage complex task lists with accuracy and attention to detail, and guide cross-functional teams without formal authority.

  • Advanced commercial contracting and negotiation skills, including deep familiarity with equipment warranties, liquidated damages, performance guarantees, limitation of liability, and delivery schedules.

  • Strong quantitative analysis and executive communication skills, with high proficiency in Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Excel, and Slack to model commercial scenarios and present clear recommendations.

  • Strategic thinking paired with calmness under adversity, bringing structure, organization, and respect to both internal colleagues and external counterparties.

  • Commitment to collaborative execution and principled deal-making, aligned with Intersect's core values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

Total Rewards

Compensation: USD $182, 000 to USD $195,000 (total compensation includes base salary AND bonus)

Equity: Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company.

Health & wellness: 100% premium coverage for you and your dependents on medical, dental, and vision

Time to recharge: Unlimited PTO, plus two company-wide breaks (Fourth of July & end of year)

Family support: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, plus 6 additional weeks for birth parents; access to family planning and family care support through Carrot and Maven

Mental health: Free access to Spring Health, including 5 free therapy and psychiatry sessions, plus a Headspace account for mindfulness and meditation through our physical health vendor, Wellhub+

Perks & extras: $150 monthly food stipend, $150 monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet, pet insurance allowance, full home office setup, free access to UrbanSitter with $625 in quarterly company-paid credits, ActiveHero, and One Medical

All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling Intersect's commitment to equal employment opportunity. The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in commercial construction project management, organizational change management, business transformation, stakeholder engagement, communications, and adoption planning. This role requires close collaboration with project teams, business leaders, and key stakeholders to ensure the people side of change is effectively managed and aligned with project objectives.

As a key member of the Program Management Office, the Change Management Manager will help navigate delivery partner integration, ensure workstream cohesion, and achieve business objectives while promoting Turner & Townsend's values, methodologies, and commitment to delivering better outcomes.

Engage and influence executive sponsors, project teams, and stakeholders to build alignment and drive successful change outcomes.

Conduct stakeholder assessments, change impact assessments, organizational readiness evaluations, and adoption planning activities.

Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned, and continuous improvement across programs and projects.

raw.excerpt: Builders FirstSource (BFS) is executing Project Elevate, a multi-year business transformation that is standardizing core operations on SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition and connected enterprise applications.
raw.description:
Builders FirstSource (BFS) is executing Project Elevate, a multi-year business transformation that is standardizing core operations on SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition and connected enterprise applications. The Senior Engineer, SAP Application Development, is a hands-on technical resource responsible for the quality, maintainability, security, and delivery of Project Elevate custom development. This role partners with business analysts, functional leads, architects, security, Basis, testing teams, and systems-integration partners to translate business requirements into clean-core, scalable solutions across SAP S/4HANA and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Serve as a BFS technical owner for Project Elevate application development, providing hands-on engineering leadership from requirements and solution design through build, test, deployment, stabilization, and transition to support. Review functional specifications and translate approved requirements into complete technical designs, estimates, development tasks, unit-test plans, deployment dependencies, and support documentation. Design, develop, enhance, and troubleshoot RICEFW objects, including reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, workflows, Fiori applications, CDS views, OData services, APIs, and related SAP extensions. Apply Project Elevate development standards, naming conventions, documentation templates, security requirements, and code-review checklists across BFS and vendor-delivered work. Champion SAP clean-core principles by prioritizing fit-to-standard, released APIs, zero modification, in-app extensibility, ABAP Cloud/on-stack extensibility, and side-by-side BTP solutions before classical extensions. Develop and support solutions using SAP S/4HANA, ABAP, RAP, CDS, SAP Fiori/UI5, SAP Gateway/OData, SAP BTP, CAP, SAP Build, HANA Cloud, workflows, events, and API-based integration patterns as applicable. Perform or approve peer code reviews and quality checks using tools such as ABAP Test Cockpit, runtime analysis, SQL Monitor, SQL Performance Tuning Worklist, and HANA query-plan analysis; ensure defects, performance issues, security findings, and technical debt are resolved before release. Own development quality for assigned objects and vendor-delivered components, including technical-specification approval, code-review outcomes, documentation completeness, test evidence, transport readiness, and adherence to BFS architecture and engineering policies. Partner with functional leads and business analysts early in solution discussions to evaluate standard capabilities, identify gaps, compare extensibility options, and recommend solutions that balance business value, maintainability, risk, cost, and upgrade compatibility. Collaborate with Enterprise Architecture, Integration, Security, Basis, Data, Testing, Release Management, and application owners to resolve cross-system dependencies and deliver integrated end-to-end business capabilities. Work with Security teams to incorporate authorization checks, secure coding, sensitive-data handling, workflow controls, segregation-of-duties considerations, and required role or authorization-object changes. Coordinate with Basis and platform teams on environments, connectivity, system performance, background jobs, transports, runtime capacity, monitoring, and technical issue resolution across development, quality, training, pre-production, and production landscapes. Create and execute technical unit tests and support functional unit testing, system integration testing, user acceptance testing, performance testing, regression testing, defect triage, retesting, and release-readiness activities. Prepare solutions for controlled deployment through approved transport and change processes; support cutover, production validation, hypercare, root-cause analysis, and timely remediation of production defects. Maintain traceability and status in approved delivery tools, including requirements, technical designs, build tasks, defects, risks, dependencies, test evidence, approvals, and deployment milestones. Review vendor estimates, designs, code, test results, and delivery plans; hold systems-integration partners and contractors accountable for quality, schedule, knowledge transfer, and compliance with BFS standards. Contribute to reusable engineering patterns, templates, accelerators, automation, technical roadmaps, and continuous improvements to the software-development lifecycle, DevSecOps practices, and release processes. Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-transfer materials; share best practices with BFS developers, analysts, support teams, and partners. Provide technical mentoring and guidance to other engineers and development partners while remaining accountable for individual delivery; perform hands-on coding for complex, high-risk, or business-critical work. Communicate technical decisions, progress, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to project leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This job has no supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Four or more years of SAP application-development experience, including hands-on ABAP development in SAP S/4HANA or SAP ERP environments. Experience delivering custom SAP objects through requirements, technical design, development, code review, testing, transport, deployment, and production support. Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA extensibility, ABAP, CDS, enhancements, workflows, interfaces, forms, OData services, and Fiori/UI5 development. Experience applying secure coding, performance optimization, source/version control, peer review, testing, and software-development lifecycle practices. Experience working with systems integrators, offshore development teams, vendors, and cross-functional enterprise delivery teams. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

COMPETENCIES

Evaluates Problems: Evaluates and analyzes different types of information objectively to identify appropriate solutions; writes fluently, establishing the key facts clearly and interprets numerical data effectively. Technical Communication/ Presentation: Communicates with clarity and precision, presenting complex information in a concise format that is audience appropriate. Adjusting and Driving Change: Takes a positive approach to tackling work and embraces change; invites feedback relating to performance and deals constructively with criticism. Identifies the need for and drives change when required to achieve objectives. Focuses on Customers: Understands and anticipates customer needs and takes action to provide high-quality products and services to exceed expectations. Demonstrates Business Acumen: Demonstrates working knowledge of market, economic, legal, and regulatory environments and how they impact the business. Agile Best Practices: Understands how agility is leveraged in IT ways of working. Adopts agile best practices as appropriate throughout the assigned work lifecycle. Responds to feedback quickly based on comments of internal and external customers and needs of the market. Bias for Action: Takes initiative and identifies what needs to be done and acts without waiting to be asked. Executes work in a timely manner. Suggests improvements to current ways of working.

BFS COMPETENCIES

Business and Financial Acumen

Demonstrates depth of understanding for the P&L and financial analysis Teaches business and financial acumen to others. Understands KPIs and how BFS makes money. Knows the different business segments and how they relate to one another. Understands customer sales and engagement. Demonstrates functional and/or technical expertise. Understands complex issues and demonstrates problem solving skills. Understands how to maximize business results regardless of industry cycle.

Results Driven

Holds self and others accountable. Communicates and sets clear goals with plans to deliver. Manages competing priorities effectively. Demonstrates appropriate urgency. Drives to exceed expectations in alignment with our BFS SPICE values. Embraces and follows best practices. Demonstrates self-starter, can-do attitude.

Strategic Thinking and Decision Making

Leverages resources and teams around them to solve problems and create mutually beneficial outcomes. Demonstrates willingness and courage to make tough decisions in a timely manner. Balances short-and-long term priorities Demonstrates proactive versus reactive thinking. Asks questions to identify root cause and analyze situations more accurately.

Servant Leadership

Demonstrates humility by putting others first. Builds trust-based relationships. Leads by example with kindness and respect. Collaborates well across all areas of the business. Advocates for others Actively listens to understand the meaning and intent of what the other person is communicating. Demonstrates authenticity and encourages others to do the same.

Emotional Intelligence

Demonstrates situational awareness – knows when and how to adjust leadership style in different situations. Demonstrates self-awareness – understands strengths and weaknesses. Demonstrates empathy – puts themselves in other’s shoes. Assumes positive intent.

Develops and Leads Others

Drives alignment through clear communication of vision, goals, and expectations. Invests time on a regular basis in performance feedback and developmental conversations. Fosters a respectful and inclusive environment. Empowers, motivates, and inspires others. Coaches and mentor others for their development. Guides and persuades others to deliver positive outcomes.

Growth Mindset

Demonstrates a growth mindset; takes appropriate risks, fails fast and forward, learns from mistakes. Perseveres and champions growth, even in the face of resistance, ambiguity, or possible failure. Thinks like an owner with an entrepreneurial spirit. Demonstrates and encourages intellectual curiosity. Continuous learner; seeks opportunities and knowledge for personal and professional growth. Sees possibilities over problems – actively seeks solutions.

Innovation

Encourages out-of-the box thinking to create new ways of doing things. Continuously seeks to improve and simplify pain points in the business. Anticipates, embraces, and leads change. Develops and executes breakthrough strategies.

Integrity

Does the right thing even under challenging circumstances? Communicates with honesty. Consistently treats others fairly and equitably. Demonstrates reliability and does what they say they will do. Conducts tough conversations and delivers difficult messages with kindness and respect.

WORK ENVIRONMENT / PHYSICAL ACTIVITY

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Subject to both typical office environment and outside locations with temperature and weather variations. Must be able to lift and carry up to 25 pounds. Occasional travel may be required to attend program specific working session.

Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.

The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.

As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

4. Insurance Finance

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

7. Asset-Liability Management

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

16. Finance Transformation

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

raw.description:
Senior Quality Automation Engineer

About Authenticx
Authenticx is a fast-growing, venture-backed, enterprise AI company transforming healthcare through conversation intelligence. We help healthcare organizations uncover insights hidden in millions of customer interactions to improve patient, member, and business outcomes.

Role Summary
The Senior Quality Automation Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for designing, building, maintaining, and integrating automated tests across Authenticx's healthcare conversation intelligence platform. You will translate customer workflows, product requirements, user personas, and healthcare realities into automated coverage that protects the experiences that matter most. You will own automation for critical product areas and prioritize coverage based on customer impact, product risk, release frequency, and business value.
You will partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to improve product quality, testability, and release confidence. We are looking for someone who brings strong technical judgment, product sense, curiosity, and ownership to quality engineering in a fast-paced startup environment.

What You'll Do
Build Automation Around Real Customer Use Cases
• Learn how Authenticx customers use the platform across healthcare quality, coaching, compliance, operations, analytics, and customer experience workflows.
• Translate workflows, acceptance criteria, production issues, and known risk areas into meaningful automated test scenarios.
• Determine what should be automated, which testing layer is most appropriate, and the level of coverage needed.
• Balance UI, API, integration, and data-level testing to create reliable and maintainable coverage.

Build and Maintain Automated Coverage
• Design, write, maintain, and troubleshoot automated tests for UI workflows, APIs, backend services, data pipelines, integrations, reporting, and AI-powered features.
• Build and maintain smoke, regression, acceptance, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
• Use Playwright to automate critical user journeys and product workflows.
• Use Bruno/Postman to validate APIs, payloads, integrations, authentication, error handling, and backend behavior.
• Use SQL to validate data accuracy, workflow integrity, processing outcomes, reporting outputs, and customer-facing analytics.
• Build reusable automation utilities, fixtures, helpers, and test data patterns.
• Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to provide earlier and more reliable quality signals.
• Investigate flaky tests, environmental issues, timing problems, and test-data failures, and distinguish them from true product defects.
• Identify high-risk coverage gaps and build automation to address them.

Partner Cross-Functionally to Improve Quality
• Work with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Implementation, and Customer teams to understand requirements, risks, and real-world usage.
• Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, logging, test data setup, and API contracts.
• Use logs, monitoring tools, database queries, API responses, and product data to investigate failures and validate system behavior.
• Communicate defects, automation gaps, and release risks clearly.
• Share automation patterns and testing practices that strengthen the broader quality engineering discipline.

Validate AI-Powered Product Experiences
• Build automated validation for classifications, model outputs, prompt and configuration changes, structured responses, extraction workflows, and downstream behavior.
• Develop repeatable test scenarios for deterministic and semi-deterministic AI behaviors.
• Validate expected outputs, required fields, edge cases, failure conditions, and downstream workflow impacts.
• Use representative test data and known expected outcomes to detect regressions.
• Partner with Data Science and Engineering to improve the testability and regression coverage of AI-powered features.

Required Qualifications
• 5+ years in test automation, SDET, or software engineering, with hands on ownership of automated suites
• Production level coding in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, C#, or Python
• Playwright or equivalent modern UI automation on complex web applications
• REST API testing (Bruno, Postman, or code based), covering authentication, payload validation, and error handling
• SQL proficiency to validate data integrity and processing outcomes
• CI/CD integration, including failure triage, flaky test diagnosis, and test data management
• Ability to assess product risk and choose the right test layer (UI, API, or data) without having every case defined for you
• Experience validating asynchronous, multi service workflows

Preferred Qualifications

• C#/.NET, PostgreSQL, and Azure

  • Experience testing LLM or ML features using representative datasets, expected outcomes, and threshold based regression checks
    • Ingestion pipelines, event driven systems, and third party integrations
    • Healthcare, contact center, or regulated environment experience
    • AI assisted development tools for test creation and debugging

raw.description:
We’re a team of friends bound together by a mission to preserve our planet for future generations through innovative energy solutions and modern infrastructure. Intersect develops, constructs, and operates the most ambitious power and data center infrastructure in the country by co-locating industrial demand with dedicated gas and renewable power generation.

Intersect was acquired by Google in March 2026 and operates as an independent subsidiary. We are developing and constructing multiple gigawatts of energy and data center projects in the U.S., enabling more data center and generation capacity to come online faster. We’re on an aggressive growth trajectory and looking for people hungry to tackle the largest energy challenges on the planet.

Location & Team Gatherings

Intersect has been a fully flexible workplace since its founding in 2016. We’ve been very intentional about the way we do things. We are not work-from-home, hybrid, or in-office - we are any and all of those options! Deepening social connections and offering shared experiences is a cornerstone of the way we work. We connect as a team at our Team Week experiences four times a year and at our recently established Hub locations - SF Bay Area, NYC Metro Area, NY; Denver, CO; Austin, TX; Calgary, AB; and Toronto, ON.

We are currently looking for candidates located within 60 miles of any of the listed hubs to foster more in-person connections while maintaining our flexible remote culture.

About this role

As an Equipment Procurement Transaction Lead on Intersect's Procurement team, you'll take complete ownership of high-value equipment supply and EPC transactions across our portfolio of power for data centers: solar, battery storage, wind, gas generation, and high-voltage projects. Reporting to the Senior Director of Procurement, you will serve as the quarterback for major commercial deals—structuring RFPs, negotiating complex equipment supply agreements, and orchestrating inputs across Development, Engineering, Construction, Project Finance, and Legal to bring bankable contracts across the finish line.


Success here hinges on decisive inter-departmental leadership, meticulous organization, and commercial composure under pressure. You will cultivate deep, respectful partnerships with OEMs, suppliers, and EPC contractors while driving rigorous quantitative analysis and clear executive alignment to secure long-run value for Intersect's power infrastructure fleet.

Team overview

This team plays a critical role in advancing Intersect's mission to accelerate the clean energy transition and power critical digital infrastructure. The Procurement team negotiates major equipment, construction, and O&M contracts while building enduring partnerships with top-tier OEMs and execution partners. Joining this tight-knit group means stepping into a high-ownership environment where your commercial judgment directly unlocks multi-billion-dollar power and data center projects.

What you'll do

Own and Execute Equipment Supply Transactions

  • Structure, negotiate, and execute major equipment supply agreements—with a primary focus on solar and BESS equipment for data center construction alongside gas generation, wind, and high-voltage assets—ensuring alignment with project schedules and financial targets.

  • Lead end-to-end Request for Proposal (RFP) processes, including scope definition, commercial and quantitative bid leveling in Google Sheets, and final award recommendations.

  • Support secondary EPC contract negotiations and manage post-execution contract actions, including amendments, change orders, warranty administration, performance monitoring, and commercial claims.

Drive Cross-Functional Deal Leadership

  • Take full accountability for transaction task lists, timelines, and deliverables, leading stakeholders across Development, Engineering, Construction, Project Finance, and Legal to contribute effectively to final deal execution.

  • Translate complex technical, legal, and financial requirements into cohesive commercial contract structures in Google Docs that satisfy project finance bankability standards.

  • Distill multi-faceted commercial tradeoffs, risk allocations, and pricing models into crisp, persuasive executive presentations in Google Slides to drive rapid leadership decisions.

Cultivate Strategic Supplier & Counterparty Partnerships

  • Build and maintain trusted, respectful relationships with key gas generation OEMs, major equipment suppliers, and tier-one EPC contractors to secure manufacturing capacity and competitive commercial terms.

  • Maintain calmness and constructive focus under adversity, resolving commercial deadlocks, supply chain bottlenecks, and schedule pressures without sacrificing long-term partnership value.

What you'll bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Business, or a related field; an engineering background is preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience procuring major equipment (specifically gas generation equipment, turbines, transformers, BESS, wind, or solar) and negotiating EPC or equipment supply contracts for utility-scale power or data center projects.

  • Demonstrated transaction leadership with the ability to take complete ownership of a deal, manage complex task lists with accuracy and attention to detail, and guide cross-functional teams without formal authority.

  • Advanced commercial contracting and negotiation skills, including deep familiarity with equipment warranties, liquidated damages, performance guarantees, limitation of liability, and delivery schedules.

  • Strong quantitative analysis and executive communication skills, with high proficiency in Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Slides, Excel, and Slack to model commercial scenarios and present clear recommendations.

  • Strategic thinking paired with calmness under adversity, bringing structure, organization, and respect to both internal colleagues and external counterparties.

  • Commitment to collaborative execution and principled deal-making, aligned with Intersect's core values of Equity, Humility, Authenticity, Long-run Value, and People Come First.

Total Rewards

Compensation: USD $182, 000 to USD $195,000 (total compensation includes base salary AND bonus)

Equity: Beyond your salary, you’ll receive an Equity Grant, giving you a meaningful stake in our parent company.

Health & wellness: 100% premium coverage for you and your dependents on medical, dental, and vision

Time to recharge: Unlimited PTO, plus two company-wide breaks (Fourth of July & end of year)

Family support: Up to 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, plus 6 additional weeks for birth parents; access to family planning and family care support through Carrot and Maven

Mental health: Free access to Spring Health, including 5 free therapy and psychiatry sessions, plus a Headspace account for mindfulness and meditation through our physical health vendor, Wellhub+

Perks & extras: $150 monthly food stipend, $150 monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet, pet insurance allowance, full home office setup, free access to UrbanSitter with $625 in quarterly company-paid credits, ActiveHero, and One Medical

Intersect maintains a work environment free from discrimination, one where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling Intersect's commitment to equal employment opportunity. Intersect does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by and consistent with applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. We adhere to these principles in all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, benefits, social and recreational programs, and discipline.

raw.description:
RemoFirst is transforming the way businesses hire and manage global teams. Our mission is to enable Freedom of Work by providing an all-in-one global HR platform that simplifies hiring, compliance, payroll, and benefits management. We partner with some of the world’s most innovative companies, including Fortune 500 businesses and leading startups.

We are a small but strong team of 200+ people (and growing) hyper-focused on delivering a world-class platform and unparalleled service with our industry-leading partnerships.

As Global Legal Associate, Fintech & Compliance, you'll be the legal partner to our Product, Engineering and Finance teams on everything that moves money: payroll funding, contractor payouts, cross-border payments, deposits and FX. You'll get involved early, turn regulation into clear product requirements and help us launch quickly without creating regulatory risk. You'll also help run the fintech compliance programme that keeps those products sound once they're live.

What you'll do

Product:

  • Work with Product and Engineering from discovery through launch on payments, payroll and payout features.
  • Assess how money flows should be structured, for example whether a flow triggers licensing requirements (money transmission, e-money or payment services) and how to meet or design around them.
  • Turn regulatory requirements into clear, practical product requirements.
  • Draft and maintain product terms, payment terms, disclosures and in-product legal text.
  • Draft, review and help negotiate agreements with partner banks, payment providers and FX partners.
  • Carry out legal reviews for launches in new markets and for new payment features.
  • Help make balanced risk calls and propose compliant alternatives rather than simply blocking work.

Fintech compliance:

  • Support the development and day-to-day running of the compliance framework for our payment activities, including AML/CTF, KYC/KYB and sanctions screening.
  • Help assess licensing and registration needs across markets and our obligations under partner bank and financial institutions arrangements.
  • Help draft and maintain policies, controls, transaction monitoring and regulatory reporting.
  • Support engagement with regulators, auditors, financial institutions and banks' compliance teams.
  • Keep track of regulatory change in payments, data protection and AI, and assess the impact on our products.
  • Train internal teams on compliance obligations and build a culture where risk is raised early.

Requirements

  • A law degree and qualification to practise in at least one jurisdiction.
  • 3-5 years of legal experience in payments or fintech, either in-house or at a law firm with a strong payments practice.
  • Hands-on experience advising product teams, including at least one product or market launch you supported from design to go-live.
  • Solid knowledge of payments regulation (e.g. PSD2/EMD in the EU and UK, US money transmission rules) and AML/CTF requirements.
  • Experience working with banks or payment providers and negotiating the related agreements.
  • The ability to explain complex rules in plain language and give clear, practical advice.
  • Good judgement on risk, and comfort making decisions with incomplete information in a fast-moving environment.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have

  • Experience in payroll, EOR, HR tech or global workforce platforms.
  • Experience with license applications or regulator engagement.
  • Knowledge of data protection (GDPR) and AI regulation as they apply to financial and HR products.
  • Experience building a compliance function from an early stage.

Benefits

  • Startup environment: RemoFirst is an early-stage startup. You have a voice that can influence, and grow rapidly. An opportunity to build a tech unicorn.
  • Growth opportunity: This is a chance to join an AI-forward company driving innovation through artificial intelligence.
  • Direct impact: Your work will be at the center of how we grow revenue, support customers, and differentiate in the market.
  • Autonomy and Accountability: We value autonomy and accountability — there’s no bureaucracy or lengthy approval process. We prioritize speed and results to keep moving forward effectively.
  • Work for a Market Leader: Scale a project that counts market-leading companies like Microsoft, Mastercard, and more as happy customers.
  • Leadership visibility: Reporting into the Senior Global Product Operations Manager which means your projects will be strategic and business-critical.

raw.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for US-based, actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation program. General and internal medicine are our main focus. While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, join us!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-based physicians open to part-time, non-permanent projects. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified with the issuing medical board);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not fit to medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $70/hr. Because payment is per approved task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

raw.title: Hospital Inpatient Coder
raw.excerpt: Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence.
raw.description:
Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence. Cedars Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 years in a row for providing the highest-quality medical care in Los Angeles. We were also awarded the Advisory Board Company’s Workplace of the Year. This annual award recognizes hospitals and health systems nationwide that have outstanding levels of employee engagement. We offer an amazing benefits package that includes paid time off, health care and a 403(B). Join us! Discover why U.S. News & World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals.

What you will be doing in this role:

Working under the general direction of a coding supervisor, the Hospital Inpatient Coder is responsible for the assignment of ICD-10-CM and ICD-10-PCS codes by reviewing all appropriate documentation in accordance with standard coding guidelines. The Facility Inpatient Coder identifies the principal diagnosis, comorbidities/complications, present on admission indicators, and determines sequencing of codes to calculate the most appropriate DRG representing the patient stay. The role maintains knowledge of both Medicare Severity Diagnosis Related Groups (MS-DRG) and All Patient Refined Diagnosis Related Groups (APR-DRG) is required. Additionally, the incumbents maintain knowledge of appropriate capture of codes for statistical purposes such as Social Determinants of Health (SDOH), Hierarchical Conditions (HCC), and severity impacting conditions.

  • Reviews medical documentation/health information within various electronic medical/health system(s) and assigns applicable codes (ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS) within productivity and quality standard for area(s) of assignment/specialty (Facility or Professional).
  • Abstracts all required data elements for reporting and statistical capture in a timely and accurate manner into the applicable system using the applications appropriate to the work assignment. This may include but not limited to: EPIC (CS-Link), EPIC HB and PB modules, Solventum 360Encompass, Solventum Standalone Encoder, Select Coder, etc.
  • Applies basic knowledge of industry requirements of specific category coding and the impact (SDOH, PSI).
  • Resolves complex inpatient edits/alerts with consistent accuracy using current guidelines within area(s) of assignment/specialty
  • Communicates with Clinical Documentation Integrity Team members regarding complex clinical scenarios to ensure all relevant codes are assigned
  • Focuses learning on advanced level concepts
  • Translates medical records/health information including diagnoses, procedures and treatment and assigns standardized codes (International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, Clinical Modification (ICD-10-CM), International Classification of Diseases, Tenth Revision, and Procedure Coding System (ICD-10-PCS) for patients receiving services within the Cedars Sinai Health System and its affiliates.
  • Communicates collaboratively with the Clinical Documentation Integrity (CDI) team to align both clinical and coding approaches to ensure a complete coding profile. References anatomy, physiology, and clinical practice to support code assignment and contribute to CDI discussions.
  • Abstracts data elements to satisfy statistical requests by the health system, medical staff, and enters all coded/abstracted information into the assigned system. Identifies opportunities for documentation improvement and seeks clarity by the physicians.

*Approved Remote States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Minnesota, Nevada, Oregon, Texas*

The opportunity

At Valtech, you’ll find an environment designed for continuous learning, meaningful impact, and professional growth. Whether you're pioneering new digital solutions, challenging conventional thinking or building the next generation of customer experiences, your work will help transform industries.
