The role

We are looking for a SAP Integration Engineer with hands-on SAP CPI/BTP development experience and familiarity with SAP S/4HANA supplier invoice APIs.

You will work alongside our Azure development team to build the SAP integration for an AI-powered invoice booking solution. Your focus will be connecting the Azure application with SAP and ensuring reliable, traceable supplier invoice processing.

This is a part-time engagement for an initial three months, with the possibility of extension.

You will thrive in this role if you are:

  • A curious problem solver who challenges the status quo
  • A collaborator who values teamwork and knowledge-sharing
  • Excited by the intersection of technology, creativity and data
  • Experienced in Agile methodologies and consulting (a plus)

Role responsibilities

  • Design, develop and test integrations using SAP Cloud Integration (CPI) within SAP BTP.

  • Integrate the Azure-based solution with SAP S/4HANA supplier invoice APIs.

  • Work alongside the Azure development team throughout the build to define interfaces, data mappings and integration flows.

  • Implement authentication, validation, error handling, monitoring and retry mechanisms.

  • Prevent duplicate invoice submissions and ensure consistent processing across systems.

  • Support auditability and implement approval checkpoints for automated financial actions.

  • Troubleshoot integration issues and support end-to-end testing.

  • Document interfaces, configurations, dependencies and recovery procedures.

Must have qualifications

To be considered for this role, you must meet the following essential qualifications:

  • Hands-on development experience with SAP CPI and SAP BTP.

  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA supplier invoice APIs.

  • Experience integrating SAP with external applications or cloud platforms.

  • Practical experience with API-based integrations, including OData and REST.

  • Understanding of SAP FI invoice processing and financial posting workflows.

  • Experience handling integration failures, retries, duplicate prevention and transaction consistency.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate closely with an Azure development team.

  • Working proficiency in English.

Nice to have qualifications

  • Experience with SAP CIM and/or SAP Ariba.

  • Experience integrating SAP with Microsoft Azure services.

  • Familiarity with AI-driven invoice processing or financial automation.

If you do not meet all the listed qualifications or have gaps in your experience, we still encourage you to apply. At Valtech, we recognize that talent comes in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and a willingness to learn.

At Valtech, we’re intentional about building an inclusive culture where everyone feels supported to grow, thrive and achieve their goals. No matter your background, you belong here. Explore our Diversity & Inclusion site to see how we’re creating a more equitable Valtech for all.

Once you apply, our Talent Acquisition team will review your application. Your CV should cover key information on relevant experiences and expertise. We do not require information such as age, gender, marital status, or a headshot in your application. We review all candidates based on skills, experience, and potential.

⚠️ Beware of recruitment fraud!

We are committed to inclusion and accessibility. If you need reasonable accommodations during the interview process, please either indicate it in your application or let your Talent Partner know.

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, we help brands unlock new value in an increasingly digital world.

At the intersection of data, AI, creativity, and technology, we drive transformation for leading organizations, including L’Oréal, Mars, Audi, P&G, Volkswagen Dolby, and more.

At Valtech, we don’t just talk about transformation. We make it happen. Our people are the heart of our success, and we foster a workplace where everyone has the support to thrive, grow and innovate.

Trading since 2017, Gravity Team is one of the leading crypto market makers and liquidity providers, with more than $500 billion in cumulative spot trading volume and connectivity to over 40 exchanges. We recently launched our institutional OTC desk, which pairs deep digital-asset liquidity with direct local banking relationships to deliver stablecoin settlement in under 60 seconds and T+0 fiat settlement across 20+ currencies.

The Role

Our OTC desk serves institutional clients, mostly in Southeast Asia. Our desk team handles day-to-day quoting with clients. We're looking for an OTC Sales Trader to own those client relationships, supervise the quoting process, and be the main point of contact between clients, the desk team, and management.

This role is about sales and client relationships. Technical trading skills are a plus.

What You'll Do

  • Be the main contact for OTC clients and manage communication and quoting through our chat channels

  • Supervise and support the junior desk staff who handle daily quoting

  • Act as the go-to person for management on everything happening on the desk

  • Build and grow relationships with counterparties such as brokerages, treasury desks, payment providers, and fintechs

  • Keep the desk process running smoothly and reliably during Southeast Asian trading hours

What We're Looking For

  • Experience in a client-facing sales or relationship role in finance, for example at a brokerage or on a bank's treasury or brokerage desk

  • Strong communication skills and comfort managing client relationships from start to finish

  • A good understanding of financial products and how trading and execution work

  • Ability to work hours that match Southeast Asian markets

  • Organized and dependable, with the ability to take ownership of a process and the people running it

Nice to Have

  • Experience with crypto, digital assets, or FX

  • A technical or trading background

What We Offer

  • A competitive fixed salary

  • Direct ownership of client relationships at a fast-growing institutional OTC desk

  • Close collaboration with the trading and management team

Hiring Process

  1. Interview with our recruitment team

  2. Interview with the head of the OTC desk

  3. Final interview
